parent:5d6e00df325193d6366c2a2c37ac16057.title: Steam Mephit Core Rules and Concepts
parent:5d6e00df325193d6366c2a2c37ac16057.summary: The Steam Mephit is a small, neutral evil elemental with AC 10, 17 HP, and a speed of 30 ft. on the ground and in flight, possessing stealth and immunities to fire and poison; it has darkvision, speaks Primordial, and a CR of 1/4; notable traits include Blurred Form and Death Burst, with actions including claw attacks and steam breath that deals fire damage and reduces speed.

parent:e88aa583fad5c8107874a73f7b20659ee.title: Grick Core Rules and Concepts
parent:e88aa583fad5c8107874a73f7b20659ee.summary: The Grick is a medium aberration with AC 14, initiative +2, 54 HP, and a speed of 30 ft., capable of climbing; it has Stealth +4, darkvision 60 ft., passive perception 12, and no language skills; it has a CR of 2, granting 450 XP, and can perform a multiattack with a Beak attack causing 9 piercing damage and a Tentacles attack causing 7 slashing damage, with the latter grappling Medium or smaller creatures at an escape DC of 12.

parent:5cbb02ad9305788cd5e70705d0a168c60.title: D&D Magic Item Activation Rules
parent:5cbb02ad9305788cd5e70705d0a168c60.summary: Magic items in D&D are activated using a Magic action, often requiring a command word, and may be consumable or have charges; some allow spell casting without using the user's spell slots, with specific rules for casting time, duration, and spellcasting ability.

parent:63dd342cf669fb04cbb9c183ced89622c.title: Awakened Tree
parent:63dd342cf669fb04cbb9c183ced89622c.summary: The Awakened Tree is a Huge Plant with AC 13, Initiative -2, 59 HP, 20 ft. speed, vulnerabilities to fire, resistances to bludgeoning and piercing, passive perception 10, and can speak Common plus one other language, using a slam attack that deals 14 bludgeoning damage at a reach of 10 ft.

parent:de810d7d7ed4a9cf30c978fdf7a8bf73b.title: Pteranodon Creature Summary
parent:de810d7d7ed4a9cf30c978fdf7a8bf73b.summary: The Pteranodon is a Medium Beast with AC 13, initiative +2, 13 HP, speeds of 10 ft. and 60 ft. flying, a Perception skill of +1, passive Perception of 11, no languages, and a CR of 1/4; it has a 'Flyby' trait to avoid Opportunity Attacks when flying out of reach and a 'Bite' attack dealing 6 piercing damage.

parent:b058f4fbb499efdf5c19a4bc0013e7bb3.title: Reef Shark D&D Rulebook Snippet
parent:b058f4fbb499efdf5c19a4bc0013e7bb3.summary: The Reef Shark is a medium-sized, unaligned beast with blindsight and a perception skill, capable of breathing only underwater, using pack tactics for combat advantage, and attacking with a bite that deals piercing damage.

parent:dfbd61f98b178350ac06c453596d19aef.title: Animated Rug of Smothering
parent:dfbd61f98b178350ac06c453596d19aef.summary: The Animated Rug of Smothering is a large construct that can smother a single Medium or smaller creature, causing it to be grappled, blinded, restrained, suffocating, and take damage at the start of each turn, while the rug itself takes reduced damage and cannot perform this action while grappling.

parent:1c3c26becd157f9f1151b293c8dd7eb03.title: Merfolk Skirmisher Overview
parent:1c3c26becd157f9f1151b293c8dd7eb03.summary: The Merfolk Skirmisher is a Medium Elemental creature with an AC of 11, 11 HP, and the ability to breathe air and water, using an Ocean Spear that deals piercing and cold damage, reduces a target's speed, and returns to the merfolk after use.

parent:ab6e867bab1def110f592b4aaae966667.title: D&D Cleric Spells Overview
parent:ab6e867bab1def110f592b4aaae966667.summary: The D&D rulebook snippet categorizes cleric spells by level, detailing their magical school and special casting requirements, showcasing a wide range of abilities from protection and healing to necromancy and transmutation.

parent:3a61a594d463ad15723d236a7e434ead4.title: D&D Spellcasting Rules Summary
parent:3a61a594d463ad15723d236a7e434ead4.summary: In D&D, a spellcaster cannot use multiple spell slots in one turn, must respond to triggers for Reaction or Bonus Action spells, maintain concentration for longer casting times, adhere to specified ranges, and meet Verbal, Somatic, and Material component requirements to successfully cast a spell.

parent:20bcada3de790d0669807a5693fd403cc.title: The Next Dawn
parent:20bcada3de790d0669807a5693fd403cc.summary: Magic items with rechargeable properties recharge at a specified event like dawn, but if such an event doesn't occur in the current world or plane, the GM decides when they recharge.

parent:90624020c091668c7c32252027177c168.title: Griffon Core Rules and Concepts
parent:90624020c091668c7c32252027177c168.summary: The Griffon is a large, unaligned monstrosity with an AC of 12, initiative +2, 59 HP, and can move 30 ft. or fly 80 ft., possessing darkvision and a Perception skill of +5; it attacks with two Rend attacks that deal 8 piercing damage and can grapple Medium or smaller targets with an escape DC of 14.

parent:b19a391faa5ecee7d4bb14344ffe1b14d.title: Rat Creature Summary
parent:b19a391faa5ecee7d4bb14344ffe1b14d.summary: The Rat is a tiny, unaligned beast with AC 10, initiative +0, 1 HP, speeds of 20 ft. on the ground and climbing, darkvision, no languages, and a challenge rating of 0, featuring agility to avoid opportunity attacks and a bite attack dealing 1 piercing damage.

parent:0503c130352f925992a465850a507708c.title: Rhinoceros Creature Summary
parent:0503c130352f925992a465850a507708c.summary: The Rhinoceros is a Large Beast with an AC of 13, initiative of -1, 45 HP, 40 ft. speed, and a passive perception of 11, capable of a 'Gore' attack that deals 14 piercing damage, with an additional 9 damage and the Prone condition if it moved 20+ feet straight toward a Large or smaller target before hitting.

parent:64297998d14ac2db2ea04e287d445266c.title: Swarm of Venomous Snakes
parent:64297998d14ac2db2ea04e287d445266c.summary: The Swarm of Venomous Snakes is a medium-sized, unaligned swarm with high AC and initiative, capable of occupying spaces, resisting multiple damage types, and attacking with bites that deal piercing and poison damage, while being immune to several conditions.

parent:d945bc779e085c0a4f29d3df350afeb91.title: Magic Items
parent:d945bc779e085c0a4f29d3df350afeb91.summary: Magic items in D&D are rare objects obtained from defeating monsters or hidden vaults, granting characters extraordinary abilities or enhancing their existing skills.

parent:beed36216650922894df4558a76f76d2c.title: Core Rules and Concepts from D&D Rulebook Snippet
parent:beed36216650922894df4558a76f76d2c.summary: The snippet describes conditions like Poisoned and Prone that impose disadvantages on ability checks and attack rolls, Possession countered by specific spells, Proficiency allowing bonuses to D20 tests, and mechanics of Reaction, Ready action, and Reach affecting gameplay.

parent:34424a9c2369e84da36d262c51de75a23.title: Merrow Core Rules and Concepts
parent:34424a9c2369e84da36d262c51de75a23.summary: The Merrow is a Large Monstrosity with Chaotic Evil alignment, capable of breathing air and water, and can attack with Bite, Claw, or Harpoon, with the Harpoon also allowing it to pull smaller creatures towards itself.

parent:35451496cbbc44c48e8829b85a98498e7.title: Grimlock Overview
parent:35451496cbbc44c48e8829b85a98498e7.summary: Grimlock is a Medium Aberration with AC 11, Initiative +1, 11 HP, 30 ft. speed, skills in Athletics, Perception, and Stealth, blindsight, no languages, CR 1/4, and uses a Bone Cudgel for melee attacks causing Bludgeoning and Psychic damage.

parent:06113dcaec715d87697e83ca13e3160ee.title: Cursed Items
parent:06113dcaec715d87697e83ca13e3160ee.summary: Cursed items in D&D are not revealed by standard identification methods, and attunement to them cannot be voluntarily ended unless the curse is first broken.

parent:28cbfba327d98c1e2cee07a40718467cb.title: Raven Core Rules and Concepts
parent:28cbfba327d98c1e2cee07a40718467cb.summary: The Raven is a tiny, unaligned beast with mimicry abilities, capable of imitating sounds and attacking with its beak, having an Armor Class of 12, 2 hit points, and a challenge rating of 0.

parent:fea9bc2401f592cc631eb56e571495b1a.title: Riding Horse Attributes and Combat Abilities
parent:fea9bc2401f592cc631eb56e571495b1a.summary: The Riding Horse is a Large Beast with AC 11, Initiative +1, 13 HP, 60 ft. speed, Passive Perception 10, no languages, CR 1/4, and can attack with hooves dealing 7 Bludgeoning damage.

parent:fd33ffe49aa3c2dfae7969e420ce9f152.title: D&D Tiger Creature Summary
parent:fd33ffe49aa3c2dfae7969e420ce9f152.summary: The Tiger is a Large Beast with AC 13, 30 HP, and a +3 initiative, skilled in Perception and Stealth, capable of Rend attacks causing Prone conditions, and can Disengage or Hide as a bonus action.

parent:7ac5e825abf71d1c25cebb96cd070f9f6.summary: Each tool set in the D&D rulebook snippet is associated with a specific ability (Intelligence, Strength, Dexterity, Charisma, Wisdom), has a defined weight, and offers unique utilization and crafting capabilities, ranging from crafting weapons and armor to identifying plants and detecting poison.

parent:48c77cf8f461659ec68652cf01a42822d.title: D&D Sorcerer Metamagic and Spell List
parent:48c77cf8f461659ec68652cf01a42822d.summary: Sorcerers can use 'Subtle Spell' to cast without components, 'Transmuted Spell' to change damage types, and 'Twinned Spell' to target more creatures, alongside a structured list of spells by level, school, and special requirements.

parent:0ed288484b46f5460f852fed77eea98ba.title: Magic Item Categories in D&D
parent:0ed288484b46f5460f852fed77eea98ba.summary: Magic items in D&D are categorized into nine types—Armor, Potions, Rings, Rods, Scrolls, Staffs, Wands, Weapons, and Wondrous Items—with specific rules for each, particularly for potions, which are consumable, can be mixed with unpredictable results, and require a Bonus Action to use.

parent:ccf4081074cfd820487729e7510d278dd.title: Magic Item Resilience
parent:ccf4081074cfd820487729e7510d278dd.summary: Magic items are as durable as nonmagical ones, with most having resistance to all damage except Potions and Scrolls, while Artifacts are impervious to damage unless destroyed through specific means requiring research or a quest.

parent:afd634d1a7ba0f5e2aca1991108f1eb06.title: Core Rules and Concepts from D&D Rulebook Snippet
parent:afd634d1a7ba0f5e2aca1991108f1eb06.summary: In D&D, spells can be cast as rituals, taking longer but not using spell slots; numbers are rounded down unless specified otherwise; saving throws represent attempts to resist threats, with automatic failure if lacking the required ability score; the Search action involves a Wisdom check to find hidden things; shape-shifting retains ongoing effects across forms; a Short Rest allows regaining Hit Points and recharging features, but is interrupted by certain actions; and simultaneous effects are resolved in the order decided by the player or GM whose turn it is.

parent:8f822472fdec4f4dad1a418d3d3e50f6f.title: Guardian Naga Core Rules and Concepts
parent:8f822472fdec4f4dad1a418d3d3e50f6f.summary: The Guardian Naga is a large celestial creature with high AC, initiative, and HP, immune to poison and certain conditions, capable of celestial restoration, and can attack with bites and poisonous spittle, while also casting spells like Thaumaturgy and Flame Strike.

parent:5a2ab106f3efc124abd55c3fa2c2574c5.title: D&D Bardic Inspiration and Level Progression
parent:5a2ab106f3efc124abd55c3fa2c2574c5.summary: Bards can use Bardic Inspiration to modify damage or ability rolls within 60 feet, learn and replace spells at level 6, and turn failed rolls into successes at level 14.

parent:567baaf760d26e7789b3545c1be864cdc.title: D&D Magical Items Summary
parent:567baaf760d26e7789b3545c1be864cdc.summary: The Cloak of the Bat enables shape-shifting into a bat in dim light or darkness, retaining key mental attributes; the Cloak of the Manta Ray allows underwater breathing and swimming; Crystal Balls offer scrying with additional abilities like mind reading, telepathy, and true seeing; the Cube of Force casts spells based on its faces with a recharge mechanism; the Cubic Gate facilitates travel between planes using charges.

parent:affdbd15933dd4fe1dc25911251f2c98b.title: Saber-Toothed Tiger
parent:affdbd15933dd4fe1dc25911251f2c98b.summary: The Saber-Toothed Tiger is a large, unaligned beast with a combat style focused on agility and stealth, capable of making a running leap, performing multiple rending attacks, and using a bonus action to disengage or hide.

parent:1480852891ecebe3e61ffe6a40df3a967.title: Triceratops Creature Summary
parent:1480852891ecebe3e61ffe6a40df3a967.summary: The Triceratops is a Huge Beast with an AC of 14, initiative of -1, 114 HP, 50 ft. speed, and passive perception of 10, capable of making two Gore attacks with a melee attack roll of +9, dealing 19 Piercing damage, and inflicting extra damage and the Prone condition if it charges.

parent:a09c5630c46a29636b01b29d54d5dbf89.title: Core Rules and Concepts of Magic Items in D&D
parent:a09c5630c46a29636b01b29d54d5dbf89.summary: Scrolls are consumable items activated by reading, staffs and wands serve as Arcane Focuses, magic weapons may have specific types or be chosen randomly, and wondrous items vary widely, with rarity determining their value and availability.

table:33210b5622ee12225ea1efbb0cb125d0d5.summary: The table explains that the value of a magic item in the 'Equipment' category is determined by adding the item's base magic value to the cost of the associated equipment, exemplified by _+1 Armor_ (Plate Armor) having a total value of 5,500 GP.
prose_rows: The value of a +1 Armor (Plate Armor) is 5,500 GP, calculated by adding the cost of Plate Armor (1,500 GP) to the value of a Rare magic item (4,000 GP).

table:7056881589b72a3315e785840370e7c698.summary: The table lists magic item rarities from common to artifact, assigning values from 100 GP to priceless, with intermediate rarities valued at 400 GP, 4,000 GP, 40,000 GP, and 200,000 GP respectively.
prose_rows: Common magic items are valued at 100 GP.
Uncommon magic items are valued at 400 GP.
Rare magic items are valued at 4,000 GP.
Very Rare magic items are valued at 40,000 GP.
Legendary magic items are valued at 200,000 GP.
Artifact magic items are considered priceless.

parent:aecba62906e2f73f01e5ab0d8f8da05c3.title: D&D Staffs: Core Rules and Concepts
parent:aecba62906e2f73f01e5ab0d8f8da05c3.summary: The Staff of the Woodlands, a rare druidic staff, allows mental command of a snake, casting spells, transforming into a tree, and regaining charges daily, while the Staff of Thunder and Lightning, a very rare staff, enhances melee attacks with lightning damage and thunder effects, both requiring attunement and having unique daily rechargeable properties.

parent:8530e58441703b3073f6985db3e4facb2.title: D&D Level 14 and 18 Features
parent:8530e58441703b3073f6985db3e4facb2.summary: At level 14, characters can manifest wings for flight with a cooldown, and at level 18, they can cast 'Summon Dragon' without components or slots, with an option to reduce its duration by not requiring concentration.

parent:432462d8d21444fa58878b0cbdf2ac12a.title: Mammoth Core Rules and Concepts
parent:432462d8d21444fa58878b0cbdf2ac12a.summary: The mammoth, a huge beast with an AC of 13 and initiative of +2, has 126 HP and a speed of 50 ft., using its multiattack to make two Gore attacks that can knock smaller creatures prone, and it can trample prone targets for up to 29 bludgeoning damage.

parent:c5a10e4d25421f5793ac38d2f2abd2eff.title: D&D Rulebook Snippet Summary
parent:c5a10e4d25421f5793ac38d2f2abd2eff.summary: The snippet explains how to create and use permanent teleportation circles, details the Thaumaturgy cantrip's minor effects, describes the Thunderwave spell's damage and push mechanics, and introduces the Time Stop spell's ability to halt time momentarily.

parent:02ac4adbf310a3ebd6bbb805a239fa41d.title: D&D Spellcasting Mechanics
parent:02ac4adbf310a3ebd6bbb805a239fa41d.summary: In D&D, spells are categorized by levels from 0 to 9, with cantrips at level 0, and spellcasters use limited spell slots to cast spells, which are restored after a long rest; spells can also be cast without slots through cantrips, rituals, special abilities, or magic items, and each spell belongs to a school of magic that describes its typical effects.

parent:20e7be914ba266bbe762c15cd3aa0dcf6.title: Crafting Magic Items in D&D
parent:20e7be914ba266bbe762c15cd3aa0dcf6.summary: To craft a magic item in D&D, you must have Arcana proficiency, use the appropriate tools, prepare necessary spells, and account for time and cost based on rarity, while considering material availability and potential assistance.

table:a8bf51026ea818e46cabcedc3961678086.summary: The table lists the cost options for crafting _+1 Armor_ (Plate Armor), either by paying 3,500 GP outright or by paying 2,000 GP and crafting it.
prose_rows: To create _+1 Armor (Plate Armor), you must either pay 3,500 GP or pay 2,000 GP and craft the armor according to the rules in 'Equipment.'

table:81b05568678e637cf30454d2e0c8edb02a.summary: The table lists the crafting time and cost for magic items based on their rarity, from Common to Legendary, with increasing days and gold pieces required as rarity increases.
prose_rows: Crafting a Common magic item takes 5 days and costs 50 gold pieces.
Crafting an Uncommon magic item takes 10 days and costs 200 gold pieces.
Crafting a Rare magic item takes 50 days and costs 2,000 gold pieces.
Crafting a Very Rare magic item takes 125 days and costs 20,000 gold pieces.
Crafting a Legendary magic item takes 250 days and costs 100,000 gold pieces.

parent:ebb7035ae7edd1046b8651258f4905c36.title: D&D Barbarian Class Features Summary
parent:ebb7035ae7edd1046b8651258f4905c36.summary: At Level 1, Barbarians gain Unarmored Defense and Weapon Mastery; at Level 2, they acquire Danger Sense and Reckless Attack; Level 3 introduces a Barbarian Subclass and Primal Knowledge; Level 4 offers Ability Score Improvement; Level 5 provides Extra Attack and Fast Movement; Level 7 grants Feral Instinct and Instinctive Pounce; and Level 9 enhances Brutal Strike.

parent:da903739547360e086ab60a8b6adc9057.title: D&D Guard Character Summary
parent:da903739547360e086ab60a8b6adc9057.summary: A Guard is a Medium or Small Humanoid with Neutral alignment, having an AC of 16, initiative +1, 11 HP, 30 ft. speed, Perception +2, equipped with a chain shirt, shield, and spear, and capable of a spear attack with a +3 attack roll and 4 Piercing damage.

parent:a67d4617f0e62119f715e311abe3413fc.title: Summary of D&D Rulebook Snippet
parent:a67d4617f0e62119f715e311abe3413fc.summary: The Dancing Sword allows a bonus action to attack with a hovering weapon, the Decanter of Endless Water provides varying amounts of water with command words, and the Deck of Illusions creates harmless creature illusions when cards are drawn and thrown.

parent:9f4c1242b45c73a6c5659ba97e2280853.title: Scorpion Core Rules and Concepts
parent:9f4c1242b45c73a6c5659ba97e2280853.summary: The scorpion is a tiny, unaligned beast with AC 11, initiative +0, 1 HP, 10 ft. speed, blindsight 10 ft., passive perception 9, no languages, CR 0, and a sting attack dealing 1 piercing and 3 poison damage at 5 ft. range.

parent:589e183b30694383dcf3d0e1fa538faed.title: Tyrannosaurus Rex Core Rules and Concepts
parent:589e183b30694383dcf3d0e1fa538faed.summary: The Tyrannosaurus Rex is a large, unaligned beast with high AC and HP, capable of multiattacks including a bite that can grapple and restrain smaller targets, and a tail attack that can knock down larger targets.

parent:a14e8eed72b936594ac3442217a92c21f.title: Core Rules and Concepts from D&D Rulebook Snippet
parent:a14e8eed72b936594ac3442217a92c21f.summary: Creatures have a base Speed and may possess special Speeds for different movement types, with rules for switching between them; changes to Speed affect special Speeds equally; spells and spellcasting involve specific mechanics and focuses; a Sphere defines an area of effect; creatures can be Stable with 0 Hit Points without making Death Saving Throws; and a stat block provides detailed game statistics for monsters.

parent:51672ec64cda9988c46ccba439c26b035.title: D&D Rulebook Snippet Summary
parent:51672ec64cda9988c46ccba439c26b035.summary: The snippet outlines magical items including a Thunder-emitting ability, a Staff of Withering with Necrotic damage, a Stone for summoning Earth Elementals, a Luckstone for bonuses, a radiant Sun Blade, a life-stealing Sword, and a partially described Sword of Sharpness.

parent:a969f454db421f0706dfee1a85cec3a67.title: Mastiff Core Rules and Concepts
parent:a969f454db421f0706dfee1a85cec3a67.summary: The Mastiff is a medium beast with AC 12, initiative +2, 5 HP, 40 ft. speed, +5 Perception, darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 15, no languages, CR 1/8, and a bite attack that deals 4 piercing damage and can make Medium or smaller creatures prone.

parent:03d56518cbf2bea2712d52062fe0f004f.title: Giant Crocodile Core Rules and Concepts
parent:03d56518cbf2bea2712d52062fe0f004f.summary: The Giant Crocodile is a large, unaligned beast with a combat strategy involving a bite that can grapple and restrain targets, and a tail attack that can knock them prone, possessing the ability to hold its breath for an hour and having a high health pool and moderate armor class.

parent:fc8caa61ba67567d1cb3fae55dd64cc5a.title: D&D Rulebook Spell Summary
parent:fc8caa61ba67567d1cb3fae55dd64cc5a.summary: The spells 'Emanation' creates a protective, opaque barrier that restricts spellcasting and movement, 'Tongues' enables universal language comprehension, 'Transport via Plants' links two plants for creature passage, 'Tree Stride' allows movement between trees of the same kind, and 'True Polymorph' transforms a creature or object.

parent:065e807543659dfe6475bf3d829d0c3bb.title: D&D Spell Descriptions
parent:065e807543659dfe6475bf3d829d0c3bb.summary: The snippet outlines three spells: 'Spider Climb' enables vertical movement, 'Spike Growth' creates spiked terrain causing damage, and 'Spirit Guardians' summons spirits that damage creatures entering their area, with damage scaling with higher-level spell slots.

parent:d9cf53fce17e431ec0e561c376dd310ae.title: Sentient Magic Items in D&D
parent:d9cf53fce17e431ec0e561c376dd310ae.summary: Sentient magic items in D&D possess intelligence, wisdom, and charisma, have an alignment, communicate through various means, perceive their surroundings, and may have a special purpose, with their properties and interactions controlled by the GM and influenced by the bearer's relationship with the item.

parent:32feaf189cd12a89c20bbf2da2709a180.title: Core Rules and Concepts of the Paladin Class in D&D
parent:32feaf189cd12a89c20bbf2da2709a180.summary: Paladins primarily use Strength and Charisma, gain hit points with a D10 per level, have Wisdom and Charisma saving throws, and are proficient in specific skills and weapons; they start with a choice of equipment, gain healing and combat abilities like Lay On Hands and Paladin's Smite, and access spellcasting and Channel Divinity as they level up.

Option B for starting equipment provides 150 GP.

parent:f55a39273aa6062acc4cfdc6e49e35774.title: D&D Rulebook Snippet Summary
parent:f55a39273aa6062acc4cfdc6e49e35774.summary: The snippet outlines magical items including a wisdom-enhancing book, a trident for dominating aquatic beasts, a solvent for dissolving adhesives, a weapon with extra damage, a sword that can decapitate creatures, a wand for binding spells, and a wand for detecting nearby enemies.

parent:c1377d3c896c6107cf8aaf9d73cfe7092.title: D&D Paladin Spells and Oath of Devotion
parent:c1377d3c896c6107cf8aaf9d73cfe7092.summary: Paladins have access to a range of spells across levels 2 to 5, with the Oath of Devotion providing specific spells at levels 3, 5, 9, 13, and 17, and features like Sacred Weapon and Aura of Devotion enhancing their combat abilities and embodying their commitment to justice and order.

parent:c0a389800a9c11ffff28a06c9d9fe91ec.title: D&D Rulebook Snippet Summary
parent:c0a389800a9c11ffff28a06c9d9fe91ec.summary: The snippet outlines creatures with specific challenge ratings and magical items with unique abilities, such as the Defender weapon's attack and AC bonuses, the cursed Demon Armor's Abyssal knowledge and demon disadvantage, Dimensional Shackles' extradimensional movement restriction, and the Dragon Orb's vision control through a Charisma saving throw.

parent:5eca7a7ee030c034df569a4d24ff8f873.title: Seahorse Core Rules and Concepts
parent:5eca7a7ee030c034df569a4d24ff8f873.summary: The Seahorse is a tiny, unaligned aquatic creature with a base AC of 12, initiative of +1, and 1 HP, capable of moving 5 ft. on land and 20 ft. underwater, excelling in Stealth (+5) and Perception (+2), and can only breathe underwater, using Bubble Dash to move swiftly without provoking attacks.

parent:3b2228094af1ca11145ecc9af6f5cc534.title: Venomous Snake
parent:3b2228094af1ca11145ecc9af6f5cc534.summary: The Venomous Snake is a tiny, unaligned beast with blindsight, capable of moving swiftly on land and in water, and attacks with a bite that inflicts piercing and poison damage.

parent:6db26cd325decf8dd9c2d9e9aff4bf2fa.title: D&D Rulebook Snippet Summary
parent:6db26cd325decf8dd9c2d9e9aff4bf2fa.summary: The snippet explains the structure of a monster's stat block in D&D, covering resistances, vulnerabilities, immunities, gear, senses, languages, challenge rating, traits, actions, bonus actions, reactions, attack and saving throw notations, and damage, along with the Study action and areas of knowledge related to specific skills.

parent:23b6d97b4214326d7697f32797d1a8a88.title: D&D Travel Pace Rules
parent:23b6d97b4214326d7697f32797d1a8a88.summary: In D&D, travel pace is determined by terrain and can be modified by roads, slower travelers, and extended travel, with special movement and vehicles providing alternative travel methods.

parent:e5906a97831f5b7b40649e06781f59178.title: D&D Creature Index
parent:e5906a97831f5b7b40649e06781f59178.summary: The snippet provides a list of creatures from a D&D rulebook, each associated with a specific page number for detailed information.

parent:7bae25ae38521fd5fb5da3fd9e0db3681.title: D&D Legendary Talismans and Tome
parent:7bae25ae38521fd5fb5da3fd9e0db3681.summary: The Talisman of Pure Good harms Fiends and Undead, enhances spell attacks, and allows destruction of such creatures; the Talisman of the Sphere aids in controlling a Sphere of Annihilation with movement benefits; the Talisman of Ultimate Evil harms non-Fiend and non-Undead creatures, enhances spell attacks, and allows destruction of targeted creatures; the Tome of Clear Thought is a very rare wondrous item containing memory and logs.

parent:ef50950311cc043c274753abe5d256877.title: Mule Description
parent:ef50950311cc043c274753abe5d256877.summary: The Mule is a medium, unaligned beast with AC 10, initiative +0, 11 HP, 40 ft. speed, passive perception 10, no languages, and a CR of 1/8, capable of carrying more due to its 'Beast of Burden' trait and can attack with hooves causing 4 bludgeoning damage.

parent:5d8e8eff8a7bee016f027e72d5a582eb1.title: Giant Eagle Core Rules and Concepts
parent:5d8e8eff8a7bee016f027e72d5a582eb1.summary: The Giant Eagle is a large celestial creature with a balanced mix of physical and magical attributes, capable of flying and making multiple attacks that combine slashing and radiant damage, while having resistances to necrotic and radiant damage and enhanced perception skills.

parent:537f9924cceed940d89021c857dcd638c.title: Core Rules and Concepts from D&D Rulebook Snippet
parent:537f9924cceed940d89021c857dcd638c.summary: The Dodge action grants advantage on saving throws and disadvantage on incoming attacks until the next turn, unless incapacitated or immobile; Emanations are area effects originating from creatures or objects, moving with them unless stationary; encounters involve social interaction, exploration, or combat; enemies are defined by combat or GM designation; Exhaustion is a cumulative condition affecting D20 tests, speed, and survivability; Experience Points lead to level advancement; Expertise doubles proficiency bonuses in a chosen skill; and Falling causes damage based on distance fallen, with potential to mitigate damage through specific checks.

parent:9a0cab496cb81e570454edf9c43d727a0.title: D&D Pirate Character Summary
parent:9a0cab496cb81e570454edf9c43d727a0.summary: A Pirate is a Medium or Small Humanoid with AC 14, Initiative +5, 33 HP, 30 ft. speed, and carries daggers and leather armor; it can attack with daggers or use Enthralling Panache to charm a target within 30 feet, requiring a Wisdom saving throw.

parent:3e0ad4a238ecf8cddbc35b5bb80260a43.title: Core Rules for Clerics in D&D
parent:3e0ad4a238ecf8cddbc35b5bb80260a43.summary: Clerics start with four level 1 spells, increasing their prepared spells as they level up, use Wisdom for spellcasting, and can use a Holy Symbol as a focus; they gain class features like Channel Divinity and Divine Order, with specific abilities and spellcasting mechanics.

parent:134cdc4897e5dd7423822d10f91c47057.title: Sorcerer Progression and Metamagic Options in D&D
parent:134cdc4897e5dd7423822d10f91c47057.summary: As a Sorcerer levels up, they gain subclass features, ability score improvements, and unique abilities like Sorcerous Restoration and Sorcery Incarnate, with advanced features at levels 19 and 20, and can enhance spells using Metamagic options like Careful Spell, Distant Spell, Empowered Spell, Extended Spell, and Heightened Spell by spending Sorcery Points.

parent:e7f1642007efbd58e7abe10345399b5c2.title: D&D Item Mechanics and Effects
parent:e7f1642007efbd58e7abe10345399b5c2.summary: The snippet describes items like Oil for dousing and fuel, Paper and Parchment for writing, Perfume for charisma boosts, Basic Poison for weapon damage, a Pole for jumping, an Iron Pot for storage, a Potion of Healing for hit point restoration, a Pouch for carrying items, a Quiver for arrows, and a Priest’s Pack for survival.

parent:5f06d7be3f72a6a3e3342aabf09fed41a.title: D&D Spell Summary
parent:5f06d7be3f72a6a3e3342aabf09fed41a.summary: The spells 'Stinking Cloud,' 'Stone Shape,' and 'Stoneskin' involve creating gas, reshaping stone, and granting damage resistance, respectively, while 'Storm of Vengeance' conjures a storm with escalating effects over multiple turns.

parent:4332ec895e33b1f4434c92dee507f95ef.title: Core Rules/Concepts of D&D Stat Blocks
parent:4332ec895e33b1f4434c92dee507f95ef.summary: A D&D stat block includes size, creature type, descriptive tags, alignment, armor class, and initiative, each serving distinct roles in gameplay mechanics and roleplaying.

parent:431ee6fe139814cc7eb825cc5d06aec8e.title: Hill Giant Core Rules and Concepts
parent:431ee6fe139814cc7eb825cc5d06aec8e.summary: The Hill Giant, a Huge Giant with Chaotic Evil alignment, has 105 HP, AC 13, and a +2 initiative, using a Tree Club for melee attacks that can knock targets prone, and a Trash Lob for ranged attacks that poison targets, with a challenge rating of 5.

parent:39579d6dca3dafae532a1ebc449230970.title: D&D Wand Mechanics and Features
parent:39579d6dca3dafae532a1ebc449230970.summary: Wands in D&D have varying charges and spellcasting capabilities, regaining 1d6 + 1 charges daily at dawn, with the risk of destruction if the last charge is expended and a roll of 1 on a d20.

parent:07ca900edd26b466e5a23457556f12996.title: D&D Rulebook Snippet Summary
parent:07ca900edd26b466e5a23457556f12996.summary: The snippet outlines magical effects such as shimmering light causing blindness, invisibility, gem streams dealing damage, polymorphing creatures, and petrification, along with descriptions of magic weapons and items like the 'Well of Many Worlds' that create portals.

table:f4cd3dfcd15cd91e339d32dddf49ebfdd4.summary: The table lists outcomes where casting a spell at a chosen point of origin results in no effect, instead causing the caster to become invisible or emitting a stream of gems.
prose_rows: For numbers 83 to 87, nothing happens at the chosen point of origin, and instead, you cast _Invisibility_ on yourself.
For numbers 88 to 92, nothing happens at the chosen point of origin, and instead, a stream of 1d4 × 10 gems, each worth 1 GP, shoots from the wand’s tip.

parent:e1db526c91225685448e19170f2400773.title: Ankylosaurus Core Rules
parent:e1db526c91225685448e19170f2400773.summary: The Ankylosaurus is a Huge Beast with AC 15, 68 HP, and a speed of 30 ft., capable of making two tail attacks that deal 9 bludgeoning damage and can cause smaller targets to become prone.

parent:5eeff34f47dd880b0a5ebc538bc34e1fd.title: Vulture Core Rules and Concepts
parent:5eeff34f47dd880b0a5ebc538bc34e1fd.summary: The Vulture, a medium beast with an AC of 10 and 5 HP, benefits from 'Pack Tactics,' gaining an advantage on attack rolls when allies are nearby, and can attack with its beak for 2 Piercing damage.

parent:beb2ac9470a43d220ca1af585dda6dd57.title: D&D Core Rules Summary
parent:beb2ac9470a43d220ca1af585dda6dd57.summary: The D&D rulebook snippet outlines mechanics for object hit points, damage types and thresholds, carrying capacity, and other gameplay elements, emphasizing the GM's role in determining outcomes and the absence of ability scores for objects.

parent:2844269c99110fe8199a1dbb7c5c48573.title: Creating a Background in D&D
parent:2844269c99110fe8199a1dbb7c5c48573.summary: To create a character's background in D&D, choose three abilities (Strength, Dexterity, Constitution, Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma), one Origin feat, two skill proficiencies, one tool proficiency, and assemble 50 GP worth of equipment, excluding martial weapons and armor, to reflect the character's pre-adventurer life and campaign theme.

table:9cc1d75cc6718b787a94a0e1bde75f0430.summary: The table instructs players to choose a tool proficiency and assemble a 50 GP equipment package, excluding martial weapons and armor, for their character.
prose_rows: Choose one tool proficiency that is used in the practice of your background or is often associated with it.
Assemble a package of equipment worth 50 GP, excluding any unspent gold, and do not include Martial weapons or armor, as these are provided separately.

parent:6ae1a613fa1cfc2bd979e0b39f12e43b4.title: Owl Creature Summary
parent:6ae1a613fa1cfc2bd979e0b39f12e43b4.summary: The Owl is a tiny, unaligned beast with an AC of 11, initiative of +1, 1 HP, speeds of 5 ft. and 60 ft. flying, Perception and Stealth skills of +5, darkvision of 120 ft., no languages, and a CR of 0, featuring a 'Flyby' trait to avoid opportunity attacks and a talon attack causing 1 slashing damage.

parent:c8be1be9e5d40beac90523071221f7ba3.title: Mimic Creature Summary
parent:c8be1be9e5d40beac90523071221f7ba3.summary: The Mimic is a medium monstrosity with AC 12, initiative +3, 58 HP, and a speed of 20 ft., possessing stealth skills, immunities to acid and prone conditions, and darkvision; it can adhere to and grapple creatures, deal piercing and acid damage with its bite, bludgeoning and acid damage with its pseudopod, and shape-shift into objects or revert to its blob form while retaining its stats and equipment.

parent:c18061c38b4ef11bbb54a928d0790b9cf.title: Giant Elk Core Rules and Concepts
parent:c18061c38b4ef11bbb54a928d0790b9cf.summary: The Giant Elk is a Huge Celestial creature with a neutral good alignment, notable for its high initiative, moderate armor class, and significant health points, possessing resistances to necrotic and radiant damage, enhanced perception, and darkvision, and understanding multiple languages; it uses a 'Ram' attack that deals bludgeoning and radiant damage, with increased effects against smaller targets if charging.

parent:9419599150ce3370b7f594d558f3115cd.title: D&D Rulebook Snippet Summary
parent:9419599150ce3370b7f594d558f3115cd.summary: In D&D, the Frightened condition imposes disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls when the source of fear is visible and prevents voluntary movement towards it, while the Grappled condition reduces speed to zero, imposes disadvantage on attacks against other targets, and allows the grappler to drag or carry the grappled creature, with specific rules for initiating and ending a grapple.

parent:637e4e1f2a7576d6c85ac177cc778e272.title: Pirate Captain Core Rules and Concepts
parent:637e4e1f2a7576d6c85ac177cc778e272.summary: The Pirate Captain is a versatile combatant with high AC and initiative, skilled in acrobatics and perception, wielding a rapier and pistol for multiple attacks, with abilities to charm and retaliate against melee attacks.

parent:0ba61a519edc76e635cf66c1ab644bbf6.title: D&D Sorcerer Class Core Rules
parent:0ba61a519edc76e635cf66c1ab644bbf6.summary: Sorcerers use Charisma for spellcasting, gain hit points with a D6 per level, and have saving throws in Constitution and Charisma; they are proficient in two chosen skills and simple weapons, with no armor training, and start with specific equipment options; they gain spellcasting abilities at level 1, with cantrips and spell slots increasing at specific levels, and class features evolve to enhance spellcasting and other abilities.

table:f99ccd9665ffdf14603270d1320dbcc7cc.summary: The table lists two starting equipment options: Option A with a spear, two daggers, an arcane focus, a dungeoneer’s pack, and 28 GP, or Option B with 50 GP.
prose_rows: Option A includes a spear, two daggers, an arcane focus (crystal), a dungeoneer’s pack, and 28 gold pieces.
Option B includes 50 gold pieces.

table:5bbdcea99df4af728ae89012024739fcbb.summary: The table lists the progression of a sorcerer's abilities, including class features, spell slots per level, and points from levels 1 to 20, highlighting features like Innate Sorcery, Metamagic, and Ability Score improvements.
prose_rows: At level 1, players gain a +2 bonus, have 2 cantrips, 2 spells, and access to 1 spell slot, with class features including Spellcasting and Innate Sorcery, costing 4 points.
At level 2, players receive a +2 bonus, have 4 cantrips, 4 spells, and access to 3 spell slots, with class features including Font of Magic and Metamagic, costing 2 points.
At level 3, players receive a +2 bonus, have 6 cantrips, 4 spells, and access to 4 spell slots, with class features including Sorcerer Subclass, costing 3 points.
At level 4, players receive a +2 bonus, have 7 cantrips, 4 spells, and access to 3 spell slots, with class features including Ability Score, costing 4 points.
At level 5, players receive a +3 bonus, have 9 cantrips, 4 spells, and access to 2 spell slots, with class features including Sorcerous and Restoration, costing 5 points.
At level 6, players receive a +3 bonus, have 10 cantrips, 4 spells, and access to 3 spell slots, with class features including Subclass feature, costing 6 points.
At level 7, players receive a +3 bonus, have 11 cantrips, 4 spells, and access to 3 spell slots and 1 higher-level spell slot, with class features including Sorcery Incarnate, costing 7 points.
At level 8, players receive a +3 bonus, have 12 cantrips, 4 spells, and access to 2 spell slots, with class features including Ability Score and Improvement, costing 8 points.
At level 9, players receive a +4 bonus, have 14 cantrips, 4 spells, and access to 3 spell slots and 1 higher-level spell slot, costing 9 points.

parent:9b0a79e75efe1e383e7b31efd4f988b5b.summary: The Hippogriff is a large, unaligned monstrosity with an AC of 11, initiative +1, 26 HP, and the ability to fly at 60 ft. and walk at 40 ft., possessing a Perception skill of +5 and passive perception of 15, with no language skills, a CR of 1, and a 'Flyby' trait to avoid opportunity attacks, capable of making two 'Rend' attacks dealing 7 slashing damage each.

parent:794a397736f2a5cd2a0c40954eddf9bdf.summary: The wands have 7 charges, regain 1d6 + 1 charges daily, and can be destroyed if the last charge is expended and a 1 is rolled on a d20; the 'Wand of Wonder' allows casting spells or effects from a chosen point within 120 feet, with spells having a DC of 15 and extended range, determined by rolling on a table with various outcomes.

parent:401894ef227481fc6739fd0160fac6c67.title: D&D Magical Items for Flight
parent:401894ef227481fc6739fd0160fac6c67.summary: The boots allow a character to fly for an hour by expending a charge, descending at 30 feet per round if still flying when the effect ends, while the cloak transforms into wings for an hour, providing a higher fly speed but resulting in a fall if aloft when the effect ends, with a cooldown of 1d12 hours before reuse.

parent:532ec1f617f6a9555d73f272a2ab44ca9.title: Ape Creature Summary
parent:532ec1f617f6a9555d73f272a2ab44ca9.summary: The Ape is a Medium Beast with an AC of 12, initiative of +2, 19 HP, and speeds of 30 ft. on the ground and climbing, excelling in Athletics and having a passive Perception of 13, with no language skills, a CR of 1/2, and actions including two Fist attacks or a recharging Rock attack.

parent:bdd0491c8ccdc6682020dc137b313ca3d.title: D&D Panther Creature Summary
parent:bdd0491c8ccdc6682020dc137b313ca3d.summary: The Panther is a Medium Beast with AC 13, Initiative +3, 13 HP, and speeds of 50 ft. and 40 ft. climbing; it excels in Stealth (+7) and Perception (+4), has darkvision up to 60 ft., and no language skills, with a CR of 1/4; it can attack with 'Rend' for 6 slashing damage and use 'Nimble Escape' to Disengage or Hide.

parent:82174855b690df461d337d38bd373a070.title: Minotaur of Baphomet Core Rules
parent:82174855b690df461d337d38bd373a070.summary: The Minotaur of Baphomet is a large, chaotic evil monstrosity with 85 HP, AC 14, and a speed of 40 ft., proficient in Perception and Survival, with darkvision and Abyssal language, and a CR of 3, using an Abyssal Glaive for melee attacks and a Gore attack with additional damage and a Prone condition under specific circumstances.

parent:7df1ada51421fd6c583439baa75ccb1e7.title: Constrictor Snake Core Rules
parent:7df1ada51421fd6c583439baa75ccb1e7.summary: The Constrictor Snake, a large beast with AC 13 and initiative +2, has 13 HP, can move at 30 ft. on land and swim at the same speed, possesses Perception +2 and Stealth +4 skills, has blindsight within 10 ft., and can attack with a bite causing 6 piercing damage or constrict a Medium or smaller creature within 5 ft., dealing 7 bludgeoning damage and potentially grappling them with a DC 12 saving throw.

parent:e454b55d607cd4eaa1da96c997b0c916d.title: Giant Fire Beetle Core Rules
parent:e454b55d607cd4eaa1da96c997b0c916d.summary: The Giant Fire Beetle is a small, unaligned beast with fire resistance, blindsight, and the ability to emit light, capable of a bite attack dealing 1 fire damage within a 5-foot reach.

parent:b604f1450cfd565da155de763d38e71d7.title: Pit Fiend Core Rules and Concepts
parent:b604f1450cfd565da155de763d38e71d7.summary: The Pit Fiend is a formidable Lawful Evil creature with high AC, HP, and initiative, capable of Diabolical Restoration, emitting a Fear Aura, possessing Legendary Resistance and Magic Resistance, and using powerful melee attacks and spellcasting abilities.

parent:d742c46e9a8f5ee64119bb9ec00a56504.summary: The spells 'Minor Illusion' and 'Mirage Arcane' allow the creation of auditory or visual illusions detectable by specific checks, while 'Mirror Image' is a level 2 illusion spell with unspecified effects in the snippet.

parent:6cc625ed776dacee9e5139ba96df506e2.summary: The Hobgoblin Warrior is a Medium Fey (Goblinoid) creature with Lawful Evil alignment, AC 18, Initiative +3, 11 HP, and 30 ft. speed, equipped with half plate armor, a longbow, a longsword, and a shield, benefiting from 'Pack Tactics' and capable of attacking with a longsword for 12 slashing damage or a longbow for 5 piercing and 7 poison damage.

parent:1391baad9fe044188d1eb1fe712d50797.summary: The glyph spell activates under certain conditions, affecting creatures within a 60-foot radius with effects like death, discord, fear, pain, sleep, and stunning, while the telekinesis spell allows a caster to move or manipulate creatures or objects within range, contingent on saving throws.

parent:c24c522f98fb938e0abf4dbfeab82812c.summary: The spells 'Dancing Steps' causes a target to dance comically with disadvantages, 'Invisibility' renders a creature invisible until it acts, 'Jump' allows a creature to jump further using movement, and 'Knock' opens or suppresses locks with a loud knock, while 'Legend Lore' provides lore about a named entity.

parent:12adc30e5a2268cea3a88c83c434fb57b.title: Archelon Summary
parent:12adc30e5a2268cea3a88c83c434fb57b.summary: The Archelon is a large, unaligned dinosaur with high AC and initiative, capable of both land and water movement, possessing stealth skills, and having no language abilities, with a CR of 4 and a multiattack action involving two bites that deal significant piercing damage.

parent:37aee57386138f2f790cafd36251cdd61.title: Piranha Creature Summary
parent:37aee57386138f2f790cafd36251cdd61.summary: The Piranha is a tiny, unaligned beast with an AC of 13, initiative of +3, 1 HP, speeds of 5 ft. on land and 40 ft. in water, darkvision up to 60 ft., no languages, and a CR of 0, capable of breathing underwater and attacking with a bite that deals 1 piercing damage, with advantage if the target is not at full health.

parent:93352f4d5d16a6ac4da1253f3a17e0942.title: Mummy Core Rules and Concepts
parent:93352f4d5d16a6ac4da1253f3a17e0942.summary: Mummies are Medium or Small Undead creatures with AC 11, HP 58, and speed 20 ft., vulnerable to fire, immune to necrotic and poison damage, and can attack with Rotting Fist causing necrotic damage and curses, and Dreadful Glare inducing fear, while possessing darkvision and speaking multiple languages.

parent:09ce25393e0fd9a3ce30e1ac1c813e27b.title: Crab Creature Summary
parent:09ce25393e0fd9a3ce30e1ac1c813e27b.summary: The Crab is a tiny, unaligned beast with AC 11, initiative +0, 3 HP, and speeds of 20 ft. on land and in water, possessing stealth skills, blindsight, and no language abilities, capable of breathing both air and water, and can attack with a claw dealing 1 bludgeoning damage at a reach of 5 ft.

parent:c0e47723f8a53cdeffa1ed991ced552f8.title: Giant Frog Core Rules and Concepts
parent:c0e47723f8a53cdeffa1ed991ced552f8.summary: The Giant Frog is a Medium Beast with AC 11, Initiative +1, 18 HP, and speeds of 30 ft. on land and in water, possessing Darkvision and skills in Perception and Stealth; it can breathe air and water, leap long distances, bite to grapple smaller creatures, and swallow them, causing damage over time and eventually disgorging them if they survive.

parent:d975f912c3bffc51a6b4780b505cdafe2.title: Planetar Core Rules and Concepts
parent:d975f912c3bffc51a6b4780b505cdafe2.summary: The Planetar is a large celestial being with high AC, initiative, and HP, capable of flying, possessing resistances and immunities, and having traits like Divine Awareness, Exalted Restoration, and Magic Resistance, with powerful melee attacks, area damage, spellcasting abilities, and bonus actions.

parent:fd25774aa679985ce7df89a4bc8c4a568.title: D&D Wizard Spellcasting Progression and Spell List
parent:fd25774aa679985ce7df89a4bc8c4a568.summary: At level 18, Wizards can cast certain level 1 and 2 spells at will without expending slots, replacing them after a long rest; at level 19, they gain an Epic Boon feat; at level 20, they designate two level 3 spells as signature spells, casting them once per rest without slots, with the Wizard spell list organized by level and school, noting special requirements.

parent:093828ec3afa8fb2e287cbfc4945bc6ac.title: D&D Spell Summary
parent:093828ec3afa8fb2e287cbfc4945bc6ac.summary: 'Mislead' creates an illusory double that ends invisibility upon action, 'Misty Step' teleports the caster up to 30 feet, and 'Modify Memory' reshapes a creature's memories within the last 24 hours, with conditions for success and limitations on effects.

parent:81d8ab1336877c32e9581810fd34165b4.title: Black Bear D&D Rulebook Snippet
parent:81d8ab1336877c32e9581810fd34165b4.summary: The Black Bear is a medium, unaligned beast with an AC of 11, initiative +1, 19 HP, and speeds of 30 ft. in walking, climbing, and swimming, possessing darkvision and a Perception skill of +5, and can perform a 'Multiattack' with two 'Rend' attacks dealing 5 slashing damage each.

parent:ca671f2d99ee91e0fba28c72df3fd5084.summary: The first spell allows a bonus action attack causing fire damage with a saving throw, increasing damage with higher-level slots, while the second spell hides a chest on the Ethereal Plane, retrievable by touching a replica, with a chance of ending after 60 days or if the replica is destroyed.

parent:e701cea1422efca14e4b9c22f6b78dbb5.title: Hobgoblin Captain Summary
parent:e701cea1422efca14e4b9c22f6b78dbb5.summary: The Hobgoblin Captain is a Lawful Evil Medium Fey with high AC and HP, equipped with a Greatsword and Longbow, and can grant its allies advantage on attacks and saves within a 10-foot radius, while dealing significant Slashing and Poison damage with its Greatsword and Piercing and Poison damage with its Longbow.

parent:f840571c72f6a2a10c6b319fd4a1e4614.title: Teleport Spell Summary
parent:f840571c72f6a2a10c6b319fd4a1e4614.summary: The 'Teleport' spell, a level 7 Conjuration, allows instantaneous transportation of up to eight willing creatures or a single object within 10 feet to a known destination on the same plane, with success determined by familiarity and potential mishaps causing damage and rerouting.

table:c9ba784e8e8fd0c503c46dcfca43766b8d.summary: The table lists the details of a Level 5 Conjuration spell, including a casting time of 1 minute, a range of 10 feet, and components that require rare inks worth 50+ GP.

parent:715191688285f4e32bf2792790948d7f6.summary: The robes provide various magical benefits such as enhanced vision, spellcasting abilities, and resistance to attacks, but also come with specific drawbacks like vulnerability to light spells or limited uses per day.
