parent:97de7934a7f55742004d6070cd6d7823c.title: Baboon Core Rules and Concepts
parent:97de7934a7f55742004d6070cd6d7823c.summary: The baboon is a small, unaligned beast with a base AC of 12, initiative of +2, and 3 HP, capable of moving and climbing at 30 ft., with passive perception of 11, no language skills, and a CR of 0; it gains attack advantage with allies nearby and can bite for 1 piercing damage.

parent:5d12b3296ec8f85bd22dc0bf756e42b4d.title: D&D Bard Class Features and Spell List Summary
parent:5d12b3296ec8f85bd22dc0bf756e42b4d.summary: As Bards advance in levels, they gain abilities like regaining Bardic Inspiration uses, disrupting mind-influencing effects, accessing spells from multiple classes, and mastering Words of Creation, alongside a structured spell list categorized by level and school of magic.

parent:0193f89c11b11295c504c39d9ef811296.title: D&D Rulebook Snippet Summary
parent:0193f89c11b11295c504c39d9ef811296.summary: The snippet details D&D classes and subclasses, spell lists, character origins, and feats, offering a comprehensive guide to character creation and development.

parent:98fc876c87d3e2e7a4bf0984458ab711b.title: Mummy Lord
parent:98fc876c87d3e2e7a4bf0984458ab711b.summary: The Mummy Lord is a formidable Lawful Evil cleric-type undead with high AC, initiative, and HP, vulnerable to fire but immune to many conditions and damage types, possessing truesight, multiple languages, and a high challenge rating, with abilities like Legendary Resistance, Magic Resistance, and Undead Restoration, and actions including Rotting Fist, Channel Negative Energy, Dreadful Glare, and spellcasting, along with strategic reactions and legendary actions.

parent:07bba2f45470d42cc948978984b8a579b.title: Crocodile Creature Summary
parent:07bba2f45470d42cc948978984b8a579b.summary: The crocodile is a large, unaligned beast with an AC of 12, initiative +0, 13 HP, and speeds of 20 ft. on land and 30 ft. in water, possessing stealth skills and the ability to hold its breath for an hour, capable of grappling and restraining smaller creatures with its bite attack.

parent:f0cac12b9879f20ff7c7b88da6fd50c95.title: Giant Goat Core Rules
parent:f0cac12b9879f20ff7c7b88da6fd50c95.summary: The Giant Goat is a Large Beast with AC 11, initiative +1, 19 HP, and a ram attack that deals 6 bludgeoning damage, with an additional 5 damage and the Prone condition if it charges 20+ feet.

parent:cf3a54a722ab4af9ea4dda6dd971db27c.title: Priest Acolyte Core Rules and Concepts
parent:cf3a54a722ab4af9ea4dda6dd971db27c.summary: The Priest Acolyte is a neutral humanoid with AC 13, HP 11, and skills in Medicine and Religion, capable of melee and ranged attacks, casting spells like Light and Thaumaturgy at will, and using a daily bonus action for spells like Bless and Healing Word.

parent:7d8500f85741744dfd146a060886edcab.title: D&D Rulebook Snippet Summary
parent:7d8500f85741744dfd146a060886edcab.summary: The 'Destroy Water' spell allows the destruction of water or fog within range, with enhanced effects using higher-level spell slots, while 'Create Undead' animates corpses into ghouls under control for 24 hours, extendable by recasting, with higher-level slots increasing the number or power of undead; 'Creation' is an illusion spell forming objects from shadow material, with duration based on material type.

table:190f4b1a14144dc425394e9236f966dad9.summary: The table lists the details of the 'Level 6 Necromancy' spell, which has a casting time of 1 minute, a range of 10 feet, and requires verbal, somatic components, and a 150+ GP black onyx stone as material components.
prose_rows: The level 6 Necromancy spell, accessible to Clerics, Warlocks, and Wizards, has a casting time of 1 minute, a range of 10 feet, and requires verbal, somatic components, and a material component consisting of a 150+ GP black onyx stone.

parent:936e5e154704fce4f609384addde76f77.title: D&D Spell Descriptions
parent:936e5e154704fce4f609384addde76f77.summary: The spells 'Animal Friendship' charms a beast within range, ending if it takes damage; 'Animal Messenger' sends a beast to deliver a message, with duration extendable by higher-level slots; 'Animal Shapes' allows creatures to transform into beasts, retaining certain stats and abilities, with the transformation lasting for a set duration or until ended by the target.

parent:dbcebe2e3662d6b92ee811a0b0bd97cc4.title: D&D Ranger Class Features Summary
parent:dbcebe2e3662d6b92ee811a0b0bd97cc4.summary: Rangers can always have the Hunter's Mark spell prepared, replacing spells after a Long Rest, use Wisdom for spellcasting, and choose a Druidic Focus; they gain weapon mastery, expertise, and language skills at level 1 and 2, respectively, and can select a Fighting Style or Druidic Warrior option, with the latter allowing two Druid cantrips; at level 3, they choose a subclass, and at levels 4, 8, 12, and 16, they receive Ability Score Improvements; they gain Extra Attack at level 5 and increased Speed and mobility at level 6.

parent:7d331db1d22d2341fcbd2d0e86d73d467.title: Ancient Copper Dragon Summary
parent:7d331db1d22d2341fcbd2d0e86d73d467.summary: The Ancient Copper Dragon is a Gargantuan, Chaotic Good creature with high AC, HP, and initiative, skilled in Deception, Perception, and Stealth, immune to acid, and possessing blindsight and darkvision; it communicates in Common and Draconic, has a high CR, Legendary Resistance, and can use Multiattack, Rend, Acid Breath, Slowing Breath, and Spellcasting, with Legendary Actions including Giggling Magic, Mind Jolt, and Pounce.

parent:267d429bf5d62c6e2ab4a62f86a43e0d4.title: Blood Hawk Core Rules
parent:267d429bf5d62c6e2ab4a62f86a43e0d4.summary: The Blood Hawk, a small beast with an AC of 12 and initiative of +2, benefits from pack tactics for attack advantage, flies at 60 ft., and deals increased damage with its beak to Bloodied targets.

parent:011814dd8910ebc6423266ede1d6feca1.title: Homunculus Core Rules and Concepts
parent:011814dd8910ebc6423266ede1d6feca1.summary: The homunculus is a tiny, neutral construct with a high AC and initiative, immune to poison and charm, capable of telepathic communication with its master, and has a bite attack that can poison and potentially render targets unconscious.

parent:af1d499aa4a9d42c902d3c43cf82ba55e.title: D&D Rulebook Snippet Summary
parent:af1d499aa4a9d42c902d3c43cf82ba55e.summary: The Rod of Absorption allows a Reaction to absorb and store spell energy from targeted spells, converting it into spell slots for casting; the Rod of Alertness grants advantages on perception and initiative, and allows casting specific spells, while providing a protective aura; the Rod of Lordly Might, though not fully described, is a legendary rod requiring attunement.

parent:e199e38713dda440aff99c215378a9f32.title: Badger Core Rules and Concepts
parent:e199e38713dda440aff99c215378a9f32.summary: The Badger is a Tiny Beast with AC 11, 5 HP, and a +0 initiative, capable of moving 20 ft. and burrowing 5 ft., with a Perception skill of +3, poison resistance, darkvision up to 30 ft., and a passive perception of 13, and it uses a bite attack dealing 1 piercing damage.

parent:19d12e6880713563428b2bb1ae1950180.title: Gnoll Warrior Core Rules
parent:19d12e6880713563428b2bb1ae1950180.summary: The Gnoll Warrior is a Medium Fiend with Chaotic Evil alignment, possessing an Armor Class of 15, an initiative of +1, 27 hit points, and a speed of 30 ft., capable of using Rend and Bone Bow attacks, with a daily Rampage bonus action allowing an additional Rend attack after damaging a Bloodied creature.

parent:7a58949241772b3ec4aaa563a0a5581f4.title: Nalfeshnee Core Rules and Concepts
parent:7a58949241772b3ec4aaa563a0a5581f4.summary: The Nalfeshnee is a large, chaotic evil demon with high AC, initiative, and HP, capable of flying and possessing resistances and immunities to various conditions, including cold, fire, and lightning, as well as poison and frightened states; it has truesight, telepathy, and can speak Abyssal, with a high challenge rating; its abilities include demonic restoration, magic resistance, multiattack with rend, teleportation, and a horror nimbus that inflicts psychic damage and frightens targets, and it can pursue creatures within a certain range using its teleport ability.

parent:71b7ec422fe7d1abd4af4234edcad3bdc.title: Deer Creature Summary
parent:71b7ec422fe7d1abd4af4234edcad3bdc.summary: The Deer is a Medium Beast with AC 13, initiative +3, 4 HP, 50 ft. speed, Perception +4, darkvision 60 ft., passive perception 14, no languages, and a CR of 0, featuring agility to avoid Opportunity Attacks and a Ram attack dealing 2 (1d4) bludgeoning damage.

parent:99806b303ae7a8cb585ec9eabfcaeb37f.title: Rod of Rulership Summary
parent:99806b303ae7a8cb585ec9eabfcaeb37f.summary: The Rod of Rulership is a rare magical rod that transforms into various weapons and tools, each providing bonuses to attack and damage rolls, and includes abilities like Drain Life, Paralyze, and Terrify, all with usage limitations, as well as the power to command obedience from creatures within a 120-foot range.

parent:50a4761416b0b15bd7fb1a6b0ea60c47d.title: Couatl Core Rules and Concepts
parent:50a4761416b0b15bd7fb1a6b0ea60c47d.summary: The Couatl is a Medium Celestial with high AC, HP, and initiative, capable of flight, possessing resistances and immunities, and having truesight and telepathy; it can bite, constrict, and cast spells like Detect Evil and Good, and has a Shielded Mind trait preventing thought reading and controlling telepathic communication.

parent:486e92d37345c7aafa9380b9453698009.title: D&D Boar Creature Summary
parent:486e92d37345c7aafa9380b9453698009.summary: The Boar is a Medium Beast with AC 11, initiative +0, 13 HP, 40 ft. speed, and passive perception 9, possessing the 'Bloodied Fury' trait for attack advantage when bloodied, and its 'Gore' action deals piercing damage with potential extra damage and a prone condition under certain conditions.

parent:54b866cfc3100f91e355ac067db1182db.title: Adult Black Dragon Core Rules and Concepts
parent:54b866cfc3100f91e355ac067db1182db.summary: The Adult Black Dragon is a large, evil, amphibious dragon with high combat stats, immunities to acid, and special senses; it can breathe air and water, resist failed saving throws, and perform multiattacks with rend and spellcasting, including Acid Arrow and Fear, while also using legendary actions like cloud of insects and frightful presence.

parent:9b5562a6c4cdc34c86a35aa78d5770b34.title: D&D Rulebook Snippet Summary
parent:9b5562a6c4cdc34c86a35aa78d5770b34.summary: The 'Guards and Wards' spell creates a protective ward with effects like fog, locked doors, and webs, lasting 24 hours or indefinitely with daily casting, while 'Guidance' is a divination cantrip that temporarily boosts a creature's skill checks.

table:fae326818febea5d612ff86ace40384147.summary: The table lists a Level 6 Abjuration spell for Bards and Wizards, with a casting time of 1 hour, a touch range, and components including verbal, somatic, and a silver rod worth at least 10 GP.
prose_rows: The Level 6 Abjuration spell, available to Bards and Wizards, has a casting time of 1 hour, a range of touch, and requires verbal, somatic components, and a material component consisting of a silver rod worth at least 10 gold pieces.

parent:45db94cfb809b0399eefb4848f5745d37.title: D&D Bat Core Rules Summary
parent:45db94cfb809b0399eefb4848f5745d37.summary: The Bat is a Tiny Beast with AC 12, Initiative +2, 1 HP, ground speed of 5 ft., fly speed of 30 ft., Blindsight 60 ft., Passive Perception 11, no languages, CR 0 (XP 10; PB +2), and a Bite attack dealing 1 Piercing damage at +4 to hit within 5 ft.

parent:06e7b2aa3e4482c5c2377b2ff2e800f9e.title: D&D Spell Descriptions
parent:06e7b2aa3e4482c5c2377b2ff2e800f9e.summary: Arcane Eye allows a wizard to create an invisible, invulnerable eye for visual reconnaissance, while Arcane Hand conjures a magical hand for striking, pushing, grappling, or providing cover, with effects enhanced by higher-level spell slots; Arcane Lock magically secures objects until dispelled.

table:1d404397509d221b3aee946d9bacf4c078.summary: The table lists the 'Level 2 Abjuration' spell for Wizards, specifying its casting time as 'Action', range as 'Touch', components as 'V, S, M' with a material component of gold dust worth 25+ GP, and an incomplete description.
prose_rows: The Level 2 Abjuration spell for Wizards has a casting time of Action, a range of Touch, and requires verbal, somatic, and material components, with the material component being gold dust worth at least 25 gold pieces.

table:9fde4b77fe8c6f40c6fd759f209f16eef4.summary: The table lists a spell or ability with an action casting time, a 90-foot range, and components including verbal, somatic, and a miniature sword worth at least 250 GP.
prose_rows: The casting time for this ability is an action.
The range of this ability is 90 feet.
The components required for this ability are verbal (V), somatic (S), and material (M), which includes a miniature sword worth 250 gold pieces or more.

parent:ccb23177e1d068bc5d468aaf486ab43d6.title: Goblin Minion Core Rules
parent:ccb23177e1d068bc5d468aaf486ab43d6.summary: The Goblin Minion is a small, agile goblinoid with a chaotic neutral alignment, proficient in stealth, equipped with daggers, and capable of using a dagger attack or a nimble escape action.

parent:7906b8b98ab934beb3a16f22dc08005ee.title: Dire Wolf Core Rules and Concepts
parent:7906b8b98ab934beb3a16f22dc08005ee.summary: The Dire Wolf is a large, unaligned beast with a high AC, initiative, and HP, skilled in perception and stealth, possessing darkvision, and benefiting from Pack Tactics for combat advantage, with a primary action, Bite, that deals piercing damage and can incapacitate smaller creatures.

parent:7151b9a1e14d9ce6843a3bc946b0c35f9.title: The Six Abilities in D&D
parent:7151b9a1e14d9ce6843a3bc946b0c35f9.summary: In D&D, creatures have six abilities—Strength, Dexterity, Constitution, Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma—each scored from 1 to 30, with modifiers applied based on the score to reflect varying levels of capability.

table:b4757b81d09a66b6ae0fd89d0de4f54257.summary: The table shows ability modifiers for scores ranging from 1 to 30, with a score of 1 having a modifier of -5 and a score of 30 having a modifier of +5.
prose_rows: The highest score a player can achieve is 30.
A score of 1 corresponds to an ability modifier of -5.

table:e38b645ca61373d9aac4ceedf22b385b37.summary: The table shows incremental increases in a value by age range, with 24–25 years increasing by 7, 26–27 years by 8, 28–29 years by 9, and 30 years by 10.
prose_rows: At levels 24 to 25, characters receive a +7 increase to their ability scores.
At levels 26 to 27, characters receive a +8 increase to their ability scores.
At levels 28 to 29, characters receive a +9 increase to their ability scores.
At level 30, characters receive a +10 increase to their ability scores.

parent:4203c5301ecfb9e616be706e578d5122f.title: D&D Rulebook Snippet Summary
parent:4203c5301ecfb9e616be706e578d5122f.summary: The demiplane heals visitors and halts aging but limits time spent based on occupancy, while the Rope of Climbing aids in climbing and the Rope of Entanglement restrains creatures, both having durability and immunities.

parent:f081cd6a397f47952405a85023591036a.title: Swarm of Crawling Claws
parent:f081cd6a397f47952405a85023591036a.summary: The 'Swarm of Crawling Claws' is a medium swarm of tiny undead creatures with resistances to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing, immunities to various conditions, and the ability to occupy spaces and move through small openings, attacking with grasping hands that deal necrotic damage and can cause smaller creatures to become prone.

parent:739bbfe66d9ba7a2636e598bb30a2d96f.title: Brown Bear D&D Rulebook Snippet
parent:739bbfe66d9ba7a2636e598bb30a2d96f.summary: The Brown Bear is a large, unaligned beast with AC 11, initiative +1, 22 HP, and speeds of 40 ft. and 30 ft. climbing, possessing darkvision and a perception skill of +3, capable of a multiattack with a bite causing 7 piercing damage and a claw causing 5 slashing damage, potentially rendering smaller targets prone.

parent:b6f274594d807a72707c82778630b24aa.title: Ancient Black Dragon Core Rules and Concepts
parent:b6f274594d807a72707c82778630b24aa.summary: The Ancient Black Dragon is a Gargantuan, Chaotic Evil creature with high AC, HP, and initiative, possessing skills in Perception and Stealth, immunity to Acid, and senses including Blindsight and Darkvision; it communicates in Common and Draconic, has a CR of 21, and features combat abilities like Multiattack, Rend, Acid Breath, and Spellcasting, along with Legendary Resistance and actions such as Cloud of Insects, Frightful Presence, and Pounce.

parent:9d877ff747690764308e72fed1608355d.title: D&D Spell Summary
parent:9d877ff747690764308e72fed1608355d.summary: The 'Gust of Wind' spell creates a wind line that pushes creatures and affects flames, while 'Hallow' infuses an area with holy or unholy power, restricting certain creatures and binding additional effects like Courage or Darkness.

table:ed909e0e274d063f3949afc2218428384b.summary: The table lists the 'Level 5 Abjuration' spell for clerics, detailing its 24-hour casting time, touch range, and components including verbal, somatic components, and incense worth over 1,000 GP.
prose_rows: The Level 5 Abjuration spell, cast by a Cleric, requires a casting time of 24 hours, has a range of touch, and necessitates verbal, somatic components, and a material component consisting of incense worth at least 1,000 gold pieces.

parent:12206c76099a8faf88804b7be1cd5be5a.title: Goblin Warrior Summary
parent:12206c76099a8faf88804b7be1cd5be5a.summary: The Goblin Warrior is a small, fey-aligned goblinoid with a chaotic neutral disposition, equipped with leather armor, a scimitar, a shield, and a shortbow, capable of stealth, darkvision, and bonus actions for disengaging or hiding, with melee and ranged attacks that deal extra damage on advantageous rolls.

parent:b2ef8f7698bb185a96a0cf559c9f59894.title: Draft Horse Attributes and Abilities
parent:b2ef8f7698bb185a96a0cf559c9f59894.summary: The Draft Horse is a large, unaligned beast with an AC of 10, initiative +0, 15 HP, 40 ft. speed, passive perception 10, no languages, and a CR of 1/4, capable of a melee attack with its hooves dealing 6 (1d4+4) bludgeoning damage at a reach of 5 ft.

parent:5b4a1fdce1a1bca72d3b8152be65fd91e.title: Trinkets in D&D
parent:5b4a1fdce1a1bca72d3b8152be65fd91e.summary: The Trinkets table allows players to roll for a Tiny trinket, a mysterious item, which can be used to enhance character creation or enrich game environments with unique and intriguing objects.

parent:b20fcdb47da591603670f0dd87372c477.title: D&D Spell Rules and Concepts
parent:b20fcdb47da591603670f0dd87372c477.summary: The spells described include mental control with conditions, healing with rest benefits, sensory and minor effects, and multi-ray damage, each with specific casting requirements and effects.

parent:0ea46a5cef0e1773265a19b761691e9ab.title: D&D Animation Spell Mechanics
parent:0ea46a5cef0e1773265a19b761691e9ab.summary: In D&D, animated creatures follow issued commands until their task is complete or the 24-hour control period ends, requiring re-casting to maintain control; animated objects, controlled similarly, can be commanded in combat and revert to their original form upon reaching 0 Hit Points, with higher-level spell slots enhancing damage.

parent:f7a8255b2e2c16eaa133b7b50a7b0ee82.title: D&D Magic Items Summary
parent:f7a8255b2e2c16eaa133b7b50a7b0ee82.summary: The snippet outlines magical items including a weapon with attack bonuses, shields with varying Armor Class bonuses and special effects, slippers for climbing, a legendary adhesive, a shield against spells, and scrolls for casting spells.

parent:86d54dab05eb643af5be13e92871bb6e5.title: Cultist Character Summary
parent:86d54dab05eb643af5be13e92871bb6e5.summary: A Cultist is a Medium or Small Humanoid with Neutral alignment, possessing an AC of 12, an initiative of +1, 9 HP, a speed of 30 ft., skills in Deception and Religion, equipped with Leather Armor and a Sickle, and capable of a melee attack with a ritual sickle causing 3 (1d4 + 1) Slashing and 1 Necrotic damage.

parent:53afb634fc57a772b578c6386eb2765ea.title: Camel
parent:53afb634fc57a772b578c6386eb2765ea.summary: The Camel is a Large Beast with AC 10, Initiative -1, 17 HP, 50 ft. speed, darkvision 60 ft., Passive Perception 10, no languages, CR 1/8, and a bite attack dealing 4 bludgeoning damage.

parent:9cfa4464589d9a7f28147e2172e63d751.title: D&D Rulebook Snippet Summary
parent:9cfa4464589d9a7f28147e2172e63d751.summary: The character can use a feature multiple times per Long Rest based on Charisma, gain resistance to a chosen damage type with Fiendish Resilience, and transport a creature through the Lower Planes with Hurl Through Hell, subject to specific conditions and limitations.

parent:4fe18d97b9fc31bac2d071207d0eca503.title: Black Pudding Core Rules
parent:4fe18d97b9fc31bac2d071207d0eca503.summary: The Black Pudding is an amorphous, acid-immune ooze that can move through tight spaces, deals acid damage, destroys nonmagical weapons and armor, and splits into smaller puddings when damaged.

parent:247253ea328c8e94ffc17dfbd3a86fd5c.title: Storm Giant Core Rules and Concepts
parent:247253ea328c8e94ffc17dfbd3a86fd5c.summary: The Storm Giant is a Chaotic Good Huge Giant with high AC, initiative, and HP, capable of flying, swimming, and breathing air and water, with resistances to cold and immunities to lightning and thunder, skilled in Arcana, Athletics, History, and Perception, and can communicate in Common and Giant, featuring multiattacks, spellcasting, and a powerful Lightning Storm ability.

parent:0ff6da552093682ecec4c633c2cc922fe.title: D&D Level 18 Abilities
parent:0ff6da552093682ecec4c633c2cc922fe.summary: At Level 18, players gain 'Defy Death,' offering advantage on Death Saving Throws and a beneficial roll of 18-20, and 'Heroic Rally,' allowing hit point recovery at the start of each turn if bloodied and having at least 1 hit point.

parent:eb1c5109bf632d09e21adc9b56094ab6f.title: D&D Wizard Spells and Evoker Subclass Overview
parent:eb1c5109bf632d09e21adc9b56094ab6f.summary: Wizards at levels 7, 8, and 9 have access to a variety of spells across different schools, with special features noted; the Evoker subclass specializes in evocation spells, gaining abilities to add spells to their book and enhance their effects at levels 3, 6, and 10.

parent:53215925f785dddff3fdd607e71492d17.title: D&D Card Game Effects Summary
parent:53215925f785dddff3fdd607e71492d17.summary: The cards in this D&D rulebook snippet impose various effects such as curses, magical allies, wealth changes, and altered reality, with some effects being permanent or lasting until specific conditions are met, and certain cards can be countered by powerful spells like _Wish_.

table:f293c86e0ac391bb0f05ae392fdb481eb7.summary: The table lists a scenario where drawing a gem card results in receiving either twenty-five pieces of jewelry worth 2,000 GP each or fifty gems worth 1,000 GP each, with the draw not counting towards the player's declared draws.
prose_rows: In the next 72 hours, draw another card; this draw doesn’t count as one of your declared draws.
Twenty-five pieces of jewelry worth 2,000 GP each or fifty gems worth 1,000 GP each appear at.

parent:7664944d27ff794431a2ebbafd8548cc6.title: Goblin Boss Summary
parent:7664944d27ff794431a2ebbafd8548cc6.summary: The Goblin Boss is a Small Fey Goblinoid with a high AC of 17, 21 HP, and a +2 initiative, skilled in Stealth, equipped with a Chain Shirt, Scimitar, Shield, and Shortbow, capable of multiattacks with Scimitar and Shortbow, and can use Nimble Escape and Redirect Attack to evade and manipulate enemy attacks.

parent:c1b3d53c172291322f3835490fc0dcfd2.title: Prismatic Wall Spell Summary
parent:c1b3d53c172291322f3835490fc0dcfd2.summary: The 'Prismatic Wall' spell creates a multicolored wall with seven layers, each causing specific damage and having unique properties; creatures must pass through each layer, making saving throws to avoid effects, and the wall can be destroyed layer by layer under specific conditions.

parent:fc2be4665b8fabb982c52bc39ce7c65f6.title: D&D Cat Creature Summary
parent:fc2be4665b8fabb982c52bc39ce7c65f6.summary: The Cat is a tiny, unaligned beast with AC 12, initiative +2, 2 HP, speeds of 40 ft. on ground and climbing, Perception +3, Stealth +4, darkvision 60 ft., no languages, and a CR of 0; it uses Dexterity for jumping and has a melee attack that deals 1 slashing damage at a reach of 5 ft.

parent:213e1c55417261574729d7093a025535b.title: Cultist Fanatic Core Rules
parent:213e1c55417261574729d7093a025535b.summary: The Cultist Fanatic is a neutral-aligned humanoid with skills in deception and persuasion, equipped with a holy symbol and leather armor, capable of melee attacks with a Pact Blade and casting spells like Light and Thaumaturgy, with a challenge rating of 2.

parent:7c9e7695b6ac8f65b462abac4281cce1e.title: D&D Druid Rulebook Summary
parent:7c9e7695b6ac8f65b462abac4281cce1e.summary: Druids gain enhanced spellcasting, increased Wild Shape capabilities, and longevity, with a structured spell list organized by level and school, including special requirements like Concentration and Material components.

parent:8c3c1d583e19623e1960a629d47fc5b33.title: Blink Dog Core Rules and Concepts
parent:8c3c1d583e19623e1960a629d47fc5b33.summary: The Blink Dog is a Medium Fey creature with Lawful Good alignment, notable for its teleport ability, darkvision, and proficiency in Perception and Stealth, capable of a bite attack and understanding multiple languages.

parent:dc34d6521310e1b65a93a5bcaae19afab.title: D&D Druid Abilities Summary
parent:dc34d6521310e1b65a93a5bcaae19afab.summary: At Level 3, Druids can use 'Land’s Aid' to damage and heal within a sphere; at Level 6, they can recover spell slots after rests; at Level 10, they gain immunity to poison and resistance based on land type; at Level 14, they create a protective area with cover and resistance benefits.

parent:0ae6921a33ae868486356408642a1b2b0.title: Succubus Core Rules and Concepts
parent:0ae6921a33ae868486356408642a1b2b0.summary: The Succubus is a Medium Fiend with high AC, initiative, and HP, capable of flying, possessing strong deception and persuasion skills, and resistances to cold, fire, poison, and psychic damage; it can shape-shift into an Incubus, attack with Fiendish Touch, charm with Dominate Person, and use Draining Kiss to deal damage and reduce a target's HP maximum, while retaining its core stats when shape-shifting.

parent:2601a7924d386f99e1de354bb88b84630.title: D&D Rulebook Snippet Summary
parent:2601a7924d386f99e1de354bb88b84630.summary: Talons cause magic items to disintegrate while artifacts vanish; Throne provides proficiency and a keep with monsters to clear; Void traps the soul, rendering the body inert and revealing the soul's location with a Wish spell.

parent:e14646cfdfb5735d4e9f5d4d51d9540ce.title: Gold Dragon Wyrmling Core Rules and Concepts
parent:e14646cfdfb5735d4e9f5d4d51d9540ce.summary: A Gold Dragon Wyrmling is a Medium Dragon with a lawful good alignment, possessing an Armor Class of 17, initiative of +4, 60 hit points, and the ability to breathe fire and weaken opponents, while being immune to fire and capable of moving through air and water.

parent:128d549621e3371d8a053b2e2b1090a4e.title: D&D Multiclass Spellcasting Rules
parent:128d549621e3371d8a053b2e2b1090a4e.summary: In D&D, multiclass spellcasting involves preparing spells per class, enhancing cantrips based on total character level, and calculating spell slots by combining levels from specific classes, with the ability to use slots interchangeably for prepared spells and Pact Magic slots for spells from classes with the Spellcasting feature.

parent:e029684bdd3fd6e5c182d5500f4b8ebb5.title: D&D Spell Mechanics Summary
parent:e029684bdd3fd6e5c182d5500f4b8ebb5.summary: The spells 'Conjure Fey Spirit,' 'Conjure Minor Elementals,' 'Conjure Woodland Beings,' and 'Contact Other Plane' involve conjuring entities, dealing damage, and interacting with other planes, with effects enhanced by using higher-level spell slots.

parent:d4739d7bad8e88e15f05d2533b7caa00f.title: Darkmantle Core Rules and Concepts
parent:d4739d7bad8e88e15f05d2533b7caa00f.summary: The Darkmantle is a small aberration with a Crush attack that can attach to targets, causing blindness and suffocation, and it can cast a Darkness Aura once per day to create a 15-foot area of magical darkness.

parent:9495d8721a7c7e5bc6ab95c034c8ba053.title: D&D Armor Rules Summary
parent:9495d8721a7c7e5bc6ab95c034c8ba053.summary: In D&D, armor is categorized as Light, Medium, or Heavy, affecting donning/doffing time, base AC, speed, and spellcasting abilities, with training required for effective use and limitations on wearing multiple armors or shields simultaneously.

table:1d454e5e43f0080ef49f62b35d1eba4e08.summary: The table lists various types of armor and a shield, detailing their Armor Class, Strength requirements, Stealth impact, Weight, Cost, and the time needed to don and doff, while noting specific modifiers and disadvantages.
prose_rows: Padded Armor provides an Armor Class of 11 plus the Dexterity modifier, has no Stealth penalty, weighs 8 pounds, and costs 5 gold pieces.
Leather Armor provides an Armor Class of 11 plus the Dexterity modifier, has no Stealth penalty, weighs 10 pounds, and costs 10 gold pieces.
Studded Leather Armor provides an Armor Class of 12 plus the Dexterity modifier, has no Stealth penalty, weighs 13 pounds, and costs 45 gold pieces.
Hide Armor provides an Armor Class of 12 plus the Dexterity modifier (maximum of 2), has no Stealth penalty, weighs 12 pounds, and costs 10 gold pieces.
Chain Shirt provides an Armor Class of 13 plus the Dexterity modifier (maximum of 2), has no Stealth penalty, weighs 20 pounds, and costs 50 gold pieces.
Scale Mail provides an Armor Class of 14 plus the Dexterity modifier (maximum of 2), has a Stealth disadvantage, weighs 45 pounds, and costs 50 gold pieces.
Breastplate provides an Armor Class of 14 plus the Dexterity modifier (maximum of 2), has no Stealth penalty, weighs 20 pounds, and costs 400 gold pieces.
Half Plate Armor provides an Armor Class of 15 plus the Dexterity modifier (maximum of 2), has a Stealth disadvantage, weighs 40 pounds, and costs 750 gold pieces.
Ring Mail provides an Armor Class of 14, has a Stealth disadvantage, weighs 40 pounds, and costs 30 gold pieces.
Chain Mail provides an Armor Class of 16, requires Strength 13, has a Stealth disadvantage, weighs 55 pounds, and costs 75 gold pieces.
Splint Armor provides an Armor Class of 17, requires Strength 15, has a Stealth disadvantage, weighs 60 pounds, and costs 200 gold pieces.
Plate Armor provides an Armor Class of 18, requires Strength 15, has a Stealth disadvantage, weighs 65 pounds, and costs 1,500 gold pieces.
Shield +2 has no Armor Class or Stealth penalty, weighs 6 pounds, and costs 10 gold pieces.

parent:c8ed2990e0f817499701fe6f62606efa4.title: Ettin Core Rules and Concepts
parent:c8ed2990e0f817499701fe6f62606efa4.summary: The Ettin is a Large Giant with Chaotic Evil alignment, immune to several conditions, and uses a Battleaxe and Morningstar in combat, with the Battleaxe causing Prone and the Morningstar inflicting Piercing damage and Disadvantage on the target's next attack.

parent:cd2a70b90c3bc1f41927b8c1b450712fa.title: Tarrasque Core Rules and Concepts
parent:cd2a70b90c3bc1f41927b8c1b450712fa.summary: The Tarrasque is a gargantuan, unaligned monstrosity with high AC, HP, and initiative, featuring resistances and immunities to various damage types and conditions, and abilities like Legendary Resistance, Magic Resistance, and Reflective Carapace. As a Siege Monster, it deals double damage to objects and structures, and its actions include a powerful Multiattack, a grapple-inducing Bite, and damaging Claw and Tail attacks. Its Thunderous Bellow can deafen and frighten targets, while its Swallow ability allows it to consume creatures, causing them damage and restricting their movement, with the potential to regurgitate them if it takes significant damage.

parent:32e965ed0f3666b7b2d96e6e697e0a6e3.title: Core Rules and Concepts of the Monk Class in D&D
parent:32e965ed0f3666b7b2d96e6e697e0a6e3.summary: Monks use Focus Points, determined by their level, to enhance abilities like Flurry of Blows, Patient Defense, and Step of the Wind, regain them after rests, and gain features like increased movement without armor, damage reduction and redirection, and subclass specialization as they level up.

parent:21a60bd148c2e115f6f7cd8502e8cb579.title: D&D Rulebook Snippet Summary
parent:21a60bd148c2e115f6f7cd8502e8cb579.summary: The Avatar of Death is a medium undead with specific immunities and abilities, while the Necklace of Adaptation aids in breathing and poison resistance, the Necklace of Fireballs allows for throwing explosive beads, the Necklace of Prayer Beads offers various spells, and the Nine Lives Stealer weapon enhances attacks and drains life.

parent:b63ad890e468f96f7bb1524e58ad93dfa.title: D&D Rulebook Snippet Summary
parent:b63ad890e468f96f7bb1524e58ad93dfa.summary: The rolling stone trap moves across the floor, causing damage and requiring saving throws, and can be detected, disarmed, slowed, or destroyed, while the spiked pit trapdoor opens when triggered, causing creatures to fall and take damage, and can be detected, disarmed, and escaped from with specific abilities or magic.

parent:b885c5e02bb2cc19ad79c7985eb0d3b49.title: D&D Level Advancement Rules
parent:b885c5e02bb2cc19ad79c7985eb0d3b49.summary: In D&D, characters advance in levels by accumulating experience points, which enhances their capabilities, hit points, proficiency bonuses, and class features, preparing them for more challenging adventures.

parent:81b09e1593a85481f3469f9b3a5f80239.title: D&D Rulebook Snippet Summary
parent:81b09e1593a85481f3469f9b3a5f80239.summary: The Mace of Smiting deals extra damage to constructs, potentially destroying them, while the Mace of Terror causes creatures to become frightened, limiting their actions; the Mantle of Spell Resistance grants advantage on spell saving throws, and the Manuals of Bodily Health and Gainful Exercise enhance Constitution and Strength after study, while the Manual of Golems provides golem-making instructions for qualified spellcasters.

table:ec2bc04938c67914df653c89ea772d7b7b.summary: The table lists different types of golems, their creation time, and cost based on a 1d20 roll, with Clay, Flesh, Stone, and Iron Golems having varying costs and creation durations.
prose_rows: A Clay Golem can be created with a roll of 1–5 on a d20, taking 30 days and costing 65,000 GP.
A Flesh Golem can be created with a roll of 6–17 on a d20, taking 60 days and costing 50,000 GP.
An Iron Golem can be created with a roll of 18 on a d20, taking 120 days and costing 100,000 GP.
A Stone Golem can be created with a roll of 19–20 on a d20, taking 90 days and costing 80,000 GP.

parent:2db0b642c6ec8360538a136ac59dc9899.title: Death Dog Core Rules and Concepts
parent:2db0b642c6ec8360538a136ac59dc9899.summary: The Death Dog is a Medium Monstrosity with Neutral Evil alignment, immune to several conditions, and capable of a Multiattack with two Bite attacks that inflict Poison, reducing the target's maximum Hit Points on subsequent failures unless a saving throw is successful.

parent:b32c1435be2c2694c4278251d9c700176.title: Eagle D&D Rulebook Snippet
parent:b32c1435be2c2694c4278251d9c700176.summary: The Eagle is a small, unaligned beast with AC 12, initiative +2, 4 HP, speeds of 10 ft. and 60 ft. flying, a Perception skill of +6, passive Perception of 16, no languages, CR 0, and uses its talons to deal 4 slashing damage on a successful melee attack.

parent:6435e8418abc61541080d2dd24c5d150f.title: Fire Elemental Core Rules and Concepts
parent:6435e8418abc61541080d2dd24c5d150f.summary: The Fire Elemental is a large, neutral elemental with high AC and initiative, resistant to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing, and immune to fire, poison, and various conditions; it emits a fire aura causing damage and burning, can move through tight spaces, and is vulnerable to water, taking cold damage when in contact with it, and can perform a multiattack with two Burn attacks causing fire damage and burning.

parent:8a1732d1f1cf4835ad33e50b7a4f75d9e.title: D&D Tough Character Summary
parent:8a1732d1f1cf4835ad33e50b7a4f75d9e.summary: The Tough is a Medium or Small Humanoid with an AC of 12, initiative +1, 32 HP, 30 ft. speed, and equipped with a heavy crossbow, leather armor, and a mace, possessing the Pack Tactics trait for attack advantage and capable of melee and ranged attacks.

parent:d31a107819dba44d17bdc5666fc5fa42c.title: D&D Cleric Progression Features
parent:d31a107819dba44d17bdc5666fc5fa42c.summary: At Level 3, Clerics choose a subclass and gain features at specific levels; at Level 4, they improve ability scores; at Level 5, they can deal additional damage to undead; at Level 7, they gain either Divine Strike or Potent Spellcasting; at Level 10, they can cast a level 5 or lower spell without expending resources; at Level 14, their chosen Blessed Strikes ability becomes more potent; at Level 19, they gain an Epic Boon feat; and at Level 20, they can cast 'Wish' with Divine Intervention, requiring a longer rest period before reuse.

parent:771c1b5877b1571b51004f0cf860af3de.title: Satyr Core Rules and Concepts
parent:771c1b5877b1571b51004f0cf860af3de.summary: The Satyr is a Medium Fey creature with Chaotic Neutral alignment, possessing Magic Resistance, and can attack with Hooves to push smaller creatures or use Mockery to inflict Psychic damage, with skills in Perception, Performance, and Stealth, and understanding Common, Elvish, and Sylvan languages.

parent:45c5a4387592b8162b1fa4e9141a2acbb.title: D&D Combat Encounter Design
parent:45c5a4387592b8162b1fa4e9141a2acbb.summary: D&D combat encounters can be enhanced with environmental features like elevation changes and defensive positions, mixed monster groups for strategic depth, and movement incentives, while encounter difficulty is categorized into low, moderate, and high, with a structured XP budget system guiding the inclusion of creatures based on party level and desired challenge.

parent:3f7bd89f7f31b1fada87af42a09b00ba6.title: D&D Rulebook Snippet Summary
parent:3f7bd89f7f31b1fada87af42a09b00ba6.summary: A character can increase their Dexterity by 2 after studying a book for 48 hours within six days, with the book regaining its magic after a century; Marvelous Pigments allows the creation of real objects within a 20-foot cube with value limitations; Medallion of Thoughts enables casting Detect Thoughts using charges that replenish daily; Mirror of Life Trapping can trap creatures in extradimensional cells when they see their reflection, with specific activation and deactivation conditions.

table:5310f0968c6446bf7092b7aba2369a1640.summary: The table lists constraints on object creation using a pot of pigment, including a maximum depth within a 20-foot cube, a value cap of 25 GP per object, and an implied total value limit for all objects.
prose_rows: The entire depth of the pit must lie within a 20-foot cube.
No object created by a pot of pigment can have a value greater than 25 GP.
The total value of all objects created by a pot of pigment cannot exceed 25 GP.

parent:5270a213bc6bf6c68db927aa0a253d33d.title: Deva Core Rules and Concepts
parent:5270a213bc6bf6c68db927aa0a253d33d.summary: The Deva is a celestial being with high defensive and offensive capabilities, including resistances, immunities, and spellcasting, capable of reviving in Mount Celestia upon death, and excelling in combat and magical effects.

parent:f973e664dab8ee43e8cffc88cea97b9f6.title: Elephant Creature Summary
parent:f973e664dab8ee43e8cffc88cea97b9f6.summary: The Elephant is a Huge Beast with AC 12, Initiative -1, 76 HP, 40 ft. speed, and no languages, capable of making two Gore attacks that can cause targets to become Prone, and a Trample action that deals damage to prone targets based on a Dexterity saving throw.

parent:26012276d1ae77ed2065a423767a2ce40.title: Fire Giant Core Rules and Concepts
parent:26012276d1ae77ed2065a423767a2ce40.summary: The Fire Giant is a Huge, Lawful Evil giant with high AC, initiative, and HP, skilled in Athletics and Perception, immune to fire, and can attack with a Flame Sword or Hammer Throw, dealing physical and fire damage, with the Hammer Throw also pushing targets and imposing disadvantage on their next attack.

parent:cc85ea3cb403c20e74514bbf2a117739c.title: Tough Boss Summary
parent:cc85ea3cb403c20e74514bbf2a117739c.summary: The Tough Boss is a Medium or Small Humanoid with AC 16, Initiative +2, 82 HP, 30 ft. speed, equipped with Chain Mail, a Heavy Crossbow, and a Warhammer, possessing Pack Tactics for attack advantages, and can perform a Multiattack with either weapon, dealing Bludgeoning or Piercing damage.

parent:18af77149181c59802a9b8dbcbcd9e890.title: D&D Spider Creature Summary
parent:18af77149181c59802a9b8dbcbcd9e890.summary: The Spider is a tiny, unaligned beast with AC 12, initiative +2, 1 HP, and a speed of 20 ft., capable of climbing and moving through webs, with a bite attack causing piercing and poison damage.

parent:ed18018fce5b674e32add2836ab104b2f.title: D&D Rulebook Snippet Summary
parent:ed18018fce5b674e32add2836ab104b2f.summary: The snippet outlines the use of a Dragon Orb for casting spells and calling dragons, the benefits of Dragon Scale Mail, the enhanced damage of a Dragon Slayer weapon, and the effects of Dust of Disappearance and Dust of Dryness.

parent:83b6f693f6b79a9ec34f1e48a74a7e415.title: Social Interaction in D&D
parent:83b6f693f6b79a9ec34f1e48a74a7e415.summary: In D&D, social interactions involve roleplaying and ability checks to engage with NPCs, whose attitudes range from Friendly to Hostile, and success depends on understanding NPC personalities and leveraging character skills.

parent:be010f02992cedc5de04f1a24f32219d3.title: Scout Core Rules and Concepts
parent:be010f02992cedc5de04f1a24f32219d3.summary: The Scout is a versatile, stealthy humanoid with balanced combat abilities, excelling in nature and survival skills, and equipped with a longbow and shortsword for ranged and melee attacks, respectively.

parent:a3dcbbce2ae86299833a832cf7ab797c9.title: Core Rules for Making an Attack in D&D
parent:a3dcbbce2ae86299833a832cf7ab797c9.summary: An attack in D&D consists of choosing a target, determining modifiers like cover and advantage/disadvantage, and resolving the attack by making an attack roll and applying damage or special effects.

parent:9fd5913d53205cf48485bac513a56d264.title: Core Rules and Concepts for D&D Combat Encounters
parent:9fd5913d53205cf48485bac513a56d264.summary: Design combat encounters by balancing XP budgets, creature counts, and difficulty, adjusting dynamically for player presence and die rolls, and carefully considering the inclusion of powerful or complex creatures, especially for lower-level characters.

parent:85f3ad01ecc617c786414a29e4911e314.title: D&D Rulebook Snippet Summary
parent:85f3ad01ecc617c786414a29e4911e314.summary: The mirror enables communication with trapped creatures and opens a one-way gate to the Astral Plane, mithral armor is lightweight and doesn't hinder stealth or require strength, and the mysterious deck is a legendary item with cards that trigger effects upon drawing, with specific rules for drawing and card reappearance.

parent:b9b53726eed09492156f2f7c7640e7063.title: D&D Warlock Spells and Fiend Patron Subclass Overview
parent:b9b53726eed09492156f2f7c7640e7063.summary: Warlocks have access to a variety of spells across different levels, categorized by school and special features, with the Fiend Patron subclass offering unique abilities like gaining temporary hit points upon reducing enemies to 0 HP and having specific spells ready at certain levels.

parent:64c02cb6ee7ba623d9d7675c2b2bd00bb.title: Behir Core Rules and Concepts
parent:64c02cb6ee7ba623d9d7675c2b2bd00bb.summary: The Behir is a large, neutral evil monstrosity with high AC and HP, capable of multiattacks including a bite that deals piercing and lightning damage, and a constrict ability that grapples and restrains targets; it can breathe lightning, swallow creatures causing damage and conditions, and has immunities to lightning, with specific saving throws and damage details provided.

parent:26f025c6638da5ac6f19542e18c68f985.title: D&D Ghost Creature Summary
parent:26f025c6638da5ac6f19542e18c68f985.summary: The Ghost is a Medium Undead with resistances to various damage types and immunities to conditions like Necrotic and Poison, capable of ethereal sight and incorporeal movement, and can perform actions such as Withering Touch, Etherealness, Horrific Visage, and Possession, each with distinct mechanics and effects.

parent:a9bab0849e0d0494171570f8a60babe3d.title: Djinni Core Rules and Concepts
parent:a9bab0849e0d0494171570f8a60babe3d.summary: The Djinni is a large elemental creature with high AC and HP, immune to lightning and thunder, possessing darkvision and the ability to speak Primordial; it can restore itself if killed outside its plane, has magic resistance, and may know the Wish spell, which it can cast for others; it attacks with Storm Blade and Storm Bolt, can create a whirlwind, and has versatile spellcasting abilities.

parent:9642e6756bdb75c05c94d2f2a73ba0882.title: Elk Creature Summary
parent:9642e6756bdb75c05c94d2f2a73ba0882.summary: The Elk is a Large Beast with AC 10, Initiative +0, 11 HP, 50 ft. speed, Perception +2, Darkvision 60 ft., no languages, CR 1/4, and can perform a Ram attack causing 6 Bludgeoning damage, with extra damage and Prone condition if it charges.

parent:c650a8f1532a509fbee831e451092b0e8.title: Flesh Golem Summary
parent:c650a8f1532a509fbee831e451092b0e8.summary: The Flesh Golem is a Medium Construct with immunities to lightning and poison, a berserk trait triggered by taking damage, Lightning Absorption, Magic Resistance, and attacks that deal Bludgeoning and Lightning damage.

parent:e0bc7ae971e9186ed5466d9c60ff8fa13.title: Treant Core Rules and Concepts
parent:e0bc7ae971e9186ed5466d9c60ff8fa13.summary: The Treant is a Huge Plant, Chaotic Good creature with AC 16, Initiative +3, 138 HP, 30 ft. speed, vulnerabilities to fire, resistances to bludgeoning and piercing, passive perception 13, and languages Common, Druidic, Elvish, Sylvan; it deals double damage to objects and structures, can perform a Multiattack with Slam, a Hail of Bark attack, and animate trees once per day.

parent:d19f7bfc591851a6180d1c8e3bd19dc52.title: Swarm of Bats Core Rules/Concepts
parent:d19f7bfc591851a6180d1c8e3bd19dc52.summary: The 'Swarm of Bats' is a large, unaligned swarm with AC 12, initiative +2, 11 HP, and resistances to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing, with immunities to several conditions, and can occupy spaces and move through small openings, attacking with bites that deal 5 or 2 piercing damage depending on its condition.

parent:d7184956c3742b4b759ac29221836584c.title: Core Rules and Concepts for the Cleric Class in D&D
parent:d7184956c3742b4b759ac29221836584c.summary: Clerics in D&D primarily use Wisdom for spellcasting, gain hit points with a D8 per level, have saving throws in Wisdom and Charisma, and are proficient in simple weapons, light and medium armor, and shields, with skill proficiencies in areas like History and Religion, and gain spellcasting abilities and channel divinity as they level up.

table:dc4915b4ae843ebb57abfb5c7614f29c51.summary: The table lists two starting equipment options for a character: a set of specific items or 110 GP.
prose_rows: Option A for starting equipment includes a chain shirt, shield, mace, holy symbol, priest's pack, and 7 gold pieces.
Option B for starting equipment provides 110 gold pieces.

table:68fc8acc4c092c02b1e4d1a294bf415eac.summary: The table lists the progression of spell slots and class features for a cleric, detailing the number of spell slots available at each level and the acquisition of abilities like 'Spellcasting', 'Channel Divinity', and 'Divine Intervention' at specific levels.
prose_rows: At level 1, players gain a +2 bonus, spellcasting, and Divine Order, with 3 cantrips and 4 first-level spell slots, 2 second-level spell slots, and no higher-level spell slots.
At level 2, players receive a +2 bonus, gain Channel Divinity, have 2 cantrips, 3 first-level spell slots, 5 second-level spell slots, and 3 third-level spell slots, with no higher-level spell slots.

At level 3, players have a +2 bonus, choose a Cleric Subclass, have 2 cantrips, 3 first-level spell slots, 6 second-level spell slots, 4 third-level spell slots, and 2 fourth-level spell slots, with no higher-level spell slots.

At level 4, players receive a +2 bonus, Ability Score Improvement, have 2 cantrips, 4 first-level spell slots, 7 second-level spell slots, 4 third-level spell slots, 3 fourth-level spell slots, and no higher-level spell slots.

At level 5, players gain a +3 bonus, Sear Undead, have 2 cantrips, 4 first-level spell slots, 9 second-level spell slots, 4 third-level spell slots, 3 fourth-level spell slots, 2 fifth-level spell slots, and no higher-level spell slots.

At level 6, players receive a +3 bonus, a Subclass feature, have 3 cantrips, 4 first-level spell slots, 10 second-level spell slots, 4 third-level spell slots, 3 fourth-level spell slots, 3 fifth-level spell slots, and no higher-level spell slots.

At level 7, players gain a +3 bonus, Blessed Strikes, have 3 cantrips, 4 first-level spell slots, 11 second-level spell slots, 4 third-level spell slots, 3 fourth-level spell slots, 3 fifth-level spell slots, 1 sixth-level spell slot, and no higher-level spell slots.

At level 8, players receive a +3 bonus, Ability Score Improvement, have 3 cantrips, 4 first-level spell slots, 12 second-level spell slots, 4 third-level spell slots, 3 fourth-level spell slots, 3 fifth-level spell slots, 2 sixth-level spell slots, and no higher-level spell slots.

At level 9, players gain a +4 bonus, have 3 cantrips, 4 first-level spell slots, 14 second-level spell slots, 4 third-level spell slots, 3 fourth-level spell slots, 3 fifth-level spell slots, 3 sixth-level spell slots, 1 seventh-level spell slot, and no higher-level spell slots.

At level 10, players receive a +4 bonus, Divine Intervention, have 3 cantrips, 5 first-level spell slots, 15 second-level spell slots, 4 third-level spell slots, 3 fourth-level spell slots, 3 fifth-level spell slots, 3 sixth-level spell slots, 2 seventh-level spell slots, and no higher-level spell slots.

At level 11, players gain a +4 bonus, have 3 cantrips, 5 first-level spell slots, 16 second-level spell slots, 4 third-level spell slots, 3 fourth-level spell slots, 3 fifth-level spell slots, 3 sixth-level spell slots, 2 seventh-level spell slots, 1 eighth-level spell slot, and no ninth-level spell slots.

At level 12, players receive a +4 bonus, Ability Score Improvement, have 3 cantrips, 5 first-level spell slots, 16 second-level spell slots, 4 third-level spell slots, 3 fourth-level spell slots, 3 fifth-level spell slots, 3 sixth-level spell slots, 2 seventh-level spell slots, 1 eighth-level spell slot, and no ninth-level spell slots.

At level 13, players gain a +5 bonus, have 3 cantrips, 5 first-level spell slots, 17 second-level spell slots, 4 third-level spell slots, 3 fourth-level spell slots, 3 fifth-level spell slots, 3 sixth-level spell slots, 2 seventh-level spell slots, 1 eighth-level spell slot, and 1 ninth-level spell slot.

At level 14, players receive a +5 bonus, Improved Blessed Strikes, have 3 cantrips, 5 first-level spell slots, 17 second-level spell slots, 4 third-level spell slots, 3 fourth-level spell slots, 3 fifth-level spell slots, 3 sixth-level spell slots, 2 seventh-level spell slots, 1 eighth-level spell slot, and 1 ninth-level spell slot.

At level 15, players gain a +5 bonus, have 3 cantrips, 5 first-level spell slots, 18 second-level spell slots, 4 third-level spell slots, 3 fourth-level spell slots, 3 fifth-level spell slots, 3 sixth-level spell slots, 2 seventh-level spell slots, 1 eighth-level spell slot, and 1 ninth-level spell slot, with an additional ninth-level spell slot.

At level 16, players receive a +5 bonus, Ability Score Improvement, have 3 cantrips, 5 first-level spell slots, 18 second-level spell slots, 4 third-level spell slots, 3 fourth-level spell slots, 3 fifth-level spell slots, 3 sixth-level spell slots, 2 seventh-level spell slots, 1 eighth-level spell slot, and 1 ninth-level spell slot.

At level 17, players gain a +6 bonus, a Subclass feature, have 3 cantrips, 5 first-level spell slots, 19 second-level spell slots, 4 third-level spell slots, 3 fourth-level spell slots, 3 fifth-level spell slots, 3 sixth-level spell slots, 2 seventh-level spell slots, 1 eighth-level spell slot, and 1 ninth-level spell slot, with an additional ninth-level spell slot.

At level 18, players receive a +6 bonus, have 4 cantrips, 5 first-level spell slots, 20 second-level spell slots, 4 third-level spell slots, 3 fourth-level spell slots, 3 fifth-level spell slots, 3 sixth-level spell slots, 3 seventh-level spell slots, 1 eighth-level spell slot, 1 ninth-level spell slot, and an additional ninth-level spell slot.

At level 19, players gain a +6 bonus, Epic Boon, have 4 cantrips, 5 first-level spell slots, 21 second-level spell slots, 4 third-level spell slots, 3 fourth-level spell slots, 3 fifth-level spell slots, 3 sixth-level spell slots, 3 seventh-level spell slots, 2 eighth-level spell slots, 1 ninth-level spell slot, and an additional ninth-level spell slot.

At level 20, players receive a +6 bonus, Greater Divine Intervention, have 4 cantrips, 5 first-level spell slots, 22 second-level spell slots, 4 third-level spell slots, 3 fourth-level spell slots, 3 fifth-level spell slots, 3 sixth-level spell slots, 3 seventh-level spell slots, 2 eighth-level spell slots, 2 ninth-level spell slots, 1 tenth-level spell slot, and an additional tenth-level spell slot.

parent:211bd24ff9af6aed4b2474fb56a4d54b4.title: D&D Rulebook Snippet Summary
parent:211bd24ff9af6aed4b2474fb56a4d54b4.summary: The Dust of Disappearance causes creatures to sneeze and become incapacitated, Dwarven Plate offers armor bonuses and resistance to being moved, Dwarven Thrower enhances attack rolls and deals extra damage, Efficient Quiver holds numerous items without weight, and Efreeti Bottle summons an efreeti with varying effects upon opening.

parent:6b06486a87b7441b9d8d15e999baf87c3.title: D&D Rulebook Snippet Summary
parent:6b06486a87b7441b9d8d15e999baf87c3.summary: The snippet provides page references for young dragons of copper, gold, green, red, silver, and white, as well as zombies, in a D&D rulebook.

parent:e62e562f1a45b82105416934d3ffec174.title: Sea Hag Core Rules and Concepts
parent:e62e562f1a45b82105416934d3ffec174.summary: The Sea Hag is a Medium Fey, Chaotic Evil creature that can breathe air and water, cast spells with allies, frighten creatures with its vile appearance, and perform actions like Claw, Death Glare, and Illusory Appearance.

parent:6a1c4d694aa898b8a758de0251f91999f.title: Berserker Core Rules and Concepts
parent:6a1c4d694aa898b8a758de0251f91999f.summary: The Berserker is a Medium or Small Humanoid with a Neutral alignment, AC 13, Initiative +1, 67 HP, 30 ft. speed, equipped with a greataxe and hide armor, Passive Perception 10, Common language, CR 2, and a Bloodied Frenzy trait granting advantage on attack rolls and saving throws when Bloodied, with a greataxe attack dealing 9 slashing damage.

parent:cd2112481924361f433aa9163ba29f855.title: Magic Items in D&D
parent:cd2112481924361f433aa9163ba29f855.summary: Magic items in D&D can be identified by handling, must be worn or wielded as intended, and have restrictions on wearing multiple items of the same kind or paired items unless both are worn.

parent:4e2c8e793c50d447c047eea502fdafc89.title: Silver Dragon Wyrmling Core Rules and Concepts
parent:4e2c8e793c50d447c047eea502fdafc89.summary: The Silver Dragon Wyrmling is a Medium Dragon with an AC of 17, initiative of +2, 45 HP, and speeds of 30 ft. on land and 60 ft. in flight, possessing Perception and Stealth skills, immunity to cold, blindsight and darkvision, Draconic language, and a CR of 2; it can perform Multiattack with Rend, use Cold Breath causing cold damage, and Paralyzing Breath to incapacitate or paralyze targets.

parent:c0d176fe96509c0072cc73def89ebfaac.title: Ghoul Core Rules and Concepts
parent:c0d176fe96509c0072cc73def89ebfaac.summary: A Ghoul is a Medium Undead with Chaotic Evil alignment, immune to Poison, Charmed, Exhaustion, and Poisoned, possessing Darkvision and the ability to paralyze non-Undead or non-elf creatures with its Claw attack, while its Bite attack deals Piercing and Necrotic damage.

parent:deb15e98432bc66e1b2e3cc1b078eee84.title: Flying Snake Core Rules and Concepts
parent:deb15e98432bc66e1b2e3cc1b078eee84.summary: The Flying Snake is a tiny, unaligned monstrosity with blindsight, capable of flying and swimming, that can fly by without provoking attacks and bites for piercing and poison damage.

parent:8332318485140a163df71f3425d94e267.title: Frost Giant Core Rules and Concepts
parent:8332318485140a163df71f3425d94e267.summary: The Frost Giant, a large neutral evil creature, has high hit points and armor class, can attack with a Frost Axe or Great Bow causing physical and cold damage, is immune to cold, communicates in Giant, and can use a War Cry to grant temporary hit points and attack advantages.

parent:f8bcfbc097d13beda6aa4a9aa08b01bdb.title: D&D Spell Summary
parent:f8bcfbc097d13beda6aa4a9aa08b01bdb.summary: The 'Message' spell allows instant communication across distances and planes with a failure chance on different planes, 'Sequester' makes a target invisible and undetectable, halting aging and needs, with a customizable end condition, while 'Shapechange' lets a caster transform into a creature of equal or lesser challenge rating, retaining core stats and abilities, and 'Shatter' creates a loud noise causing creatures to make a saving throw.

table:55324a85fd8b807f4aec2d34596e832342.summary: The table lists a Level 7 Transmutation spell for Wizards, requiring an action to cast, touch range, and components including verbal, somatic components, and gem dust worth over 5,000 GP.
prose_rows: The Level 7 Transmutation spell for a Wizard requires an action to cast, has a touch range, and necessitates verbal, somatic components, and a material component consisting of gem dust worth at least 5,000 gold pieces.

table:d06d1cb3cda89bb8fc7ca5845e42ebe59c.summary: The table lists a Level 9 Transmutation spell for Druids and Wizards, with an action casting time, self range, and components including a verbal, somatic, and a jade circlet worth at least 1,500 GP.
prose_rows: The Level 9 Transmutation spell, available to Druids and Wizards, requires an action to cast, can only be cast on oneself, and necessitates verbal, somatic components, and a material component consisting of a jade circlet valued at 1,500 gold pieces or more.

parent:e7817baee6a8ce23ccd118ce33011d38b.title: Swarm of Insects
parent:e7817baee6a8ce23ccd118ce33011d38b.summary: The Swarm of Insects is a medium-sized, unaligned swarm with AC 11, initiative +1, 19 HP, speed of 20 ft. (climb or fly), resistances to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing, immunities to various conditions, blindsight, no languages, CR 1/2, and abilities to climb, occupy spaces, and deal poison damage through bites.

parent:4c6d8fe254e652aceb5307e56d40aa6b6.title: D&D Rulebook Snippet Summary
parent:4c6d8fe254e652aceb5307e56d40aa6b6.summary: The snippet outlines the elemental summoning properties of specific gems, and describes various wondrous items, detailing their unique effects, such as enhancing armor, creating smoke clouds, charming individuals, improving vision, and providing perception advantages.

parent:4a7041d5379e87e7552a223b45a404627.title: D&D Warlock Invocations Summary
parent:4a7041d5379e87e7552a223b45a404627.summary: Warlocks can invoke abilities like casting spells without slots, enhancing familiars, and gaining hit points, each with specific prerequisites and limitations, enhancing their versatility and power in combat and exploration.

parent:b413fecb6766dfe655f2ab8d3d2fd4f1a.title: D&D Rulebook Snippet Summary
parent:b413fecb6766dfe655f2ab8d3d2fd4f1a.summary: The snippet covers hirelings, spellcasting, crafting items, spells, gameplay mechanics, magic items, and monsters, detailing their acquisition, use, and related rules.

parent:ac7e72314127f05d4635a538c3306d044.title: Shadow Creature Summary
parent:ac7e72314127f05d4635a538c3306d044.summary: The Shadow is a Medium Undead with Chaotic Evil alignment, vulnerable to radiant damage, resistant to several elements, immune to necrotic and poison, and excels in stealth; it moves through narrow spaces, suffers in sunlight, and can perform a Draining Swipe attack that reduces a target's Strength and can raise new Shadows from slain humanoids.

parent:ceccf9325aa3acbe74d423bc9ec613a86.title: D&D Rulebook Snippet Summary
parent:ceccf9325aa3acbe74d423bc9ec613a86.summary: The snippet describes the 'Shadowy Form' ability granting damage resistance in dim light or darkness, and the 'Boon of Truesight' feat, which allows an ability score increase and truesight at level 19 or higher.

parent:8dd09bdb003a1af996035cd17dfc9a4e1.title: Dryad Core Rules and Concepts
parent:8dd09bdb003a1af996035cd17dfc9a4e1.summary: The Dryad is a Medium Fey creature with Neutral alignment, possessing AC 16, initiative +1, 22 HP, and a speed of 30 ft.; it has skills in Perception and Stealth, senses including darkvision, and can communicate with beasts and plants, has magic resistance, and can cast spells using Charisma, with actions including Vine Lash, Thorn Burst, and Spellcasting, and a bonus action for teleporting between trees.

parent:efc97a6f87478b0d7e63cee364b0b2a19.title: Black Dragon Wyrmling Core Rules and Concepts
parent:efc97a6f87478b0d7e63cee364b0b2a19.summary: The Black Dragon Wyrmling is a Medium Dragon with Chaotic Evil alignment, possessing an Armor Class of 17, an initiative of +4, and 33 hit points; it can move at 30 ft. on land, fly at 60 ft., and swim at 30 ft., with skills in Perception and Stealth, immunity to acid, and senses including blindsight and darkvision; it speaks Draconic, has a challenge rating of 2, and features amphibious traits, multiattack capabilities with Rend attacks causing slashing and acid damage, and an Acid Breath attack with a Dexterity saving throw DC of 11 causing 22 acid damage on a failed save.

parent:79304b931559729409630b537aaa01eb0.title: Young Silver Dragon Core Rules and Concepts
parent:79304b931559729409630b537aaa01eb0.summary: The Young Silver Dragon is a large, lawful good metallic dragon with high AC, initiative, and HP, capable of flying and possessing skills in history, perception, and stealth, immune to cold, with blindsight and darkvision, and can communicate in Common and Draconic; it has a challenge rating of 9 and can perform a multiattack involving three Rend attacks or a Paralyzing Breath, and has a Cold Breath attack that deals significant cold damage, with varying effects based on saving throw success.

parent:f1fb11a066a09ebbe1e77b812329a6785.title: Gibbering Mouther Core Rules
parent:f1fb11a066a09ebbe1e77b812329a6785.summary: The Gibbering Mouther is a Medium Aberration with AC 9, Initiative -1, and 52 HP, capable of moving 20 ft. on land and in water, immune to Prone, with darkvision 60 ft. and no languages; it creates difficult terrain within a 10-foot emanation and forces nearby creatures to make Wisdom saving throws, resulting in various effects upon failure, and can bite to cause Prone or absorb targets, or use Blinding Spittle to deal radiant damage and blind targets on a failed Dexterity saving throw.

parent:d5f058f7d0d5472c5302f827db6b2d6e3.title: D&D Frog Creature Summary
parent:d5f058f7d0d5472c5302f827db6b2d6e3.summary: The Frog is a tiny, unaligned beast with AC 11, initiative +1, 1 HP, and speeds of 20 ft. on land and in water, possessing darkvision and stealth skills, with no language ability, and a CR of 0; it can breathe air and water, leap long distances, and attack with a bite causing 1 piercing damage.

parent:a08ceb9fb52ba8bab7f52586041de3d0e.title: Core Rules and Concepts in D&D
parent:a08ceb9fb52ba8bab7f52586041de3d0e.summary: In D&D, players can become invisible and hidden, perform high jumps based on strength, manage hit points and hit dice for health, encounter hostile creatures with disadvantage in influence checks, hover to avoid falling, experience magical illusions that interact with the environment, gain immunity to certain damage types or conditions, and use improvised weapons in combat.

parent:1bc4e1e53901b16a0721466c3b7395687.title: D&D Spell Summary
parent:1bc4e1e53901b16a0721466c3b7395687.summary: The snippet describes spells like 'Shield of Faith' for AC bonuses, 'Shillelagh' for weapon enhancement, 'Shining Smite' for radiant damage, 'Shocking Grasp' for lightning damage, 'Silence' for sound suppression, and 'Silent Image' for creating illusions, each with specific casting requirements and effects.

parent:623f2d245bc6887669643ca05ba614954.title: Swarm of Piranhas
parent:623f2d245bc6887669643ca05ba614954.summary: The Swarm of Piranhas is a medium-sized, unaligned swarm of tiny beasts with resistances to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage, immunities to several conditions, and the ability to occupy spaces and move through small openings, capable of underwater breathing and attacking with bites that deal varying damage based on the target's health.

parent:bd42d8881879ca2f7018a2c4b8fe2b766.title: Shambling Mound Core Rules and Concepts
parent:bd42d8881879ca2f7018a2c4b8fe2b766.summary: The Shambling Mound is a large, unaligned plant with high AC and HP, resistances to Cold and Fire, and immunities to Lightning, Deafened, and Exhaustion; it regains HP from Lightning damage, attacks with Charged Tendrils or can engulf and damage smaller creatures, imposing multiple conditions.

parent:3d018e51c66dd86044b29cf1de328ce43.title: D&D Rogue Class Features Summary
parent:3d018e51c66dd86044b29cf1de328ce43.summary: At level 2, Rogues gain Cunning Action for quick movement and actions; at level 3, they choose a Rogue subclass and gain Steady Aim for attack advantage; at level 4, they improve ability scores; at level 5, they develop Cunning Strike for enhanced Sneak Attacks and gain Uncanny Dodge for damage reduction; at level 7, they acquire Evasion for improved saving throws and Reliable Talent for better ability checks.

parent:5e8dfc624f2d80452883568723ba3e6b3.title: D&D Warlock Features and Invocations
parent:5e8dfc624f2d80452883568723ba3e6b3.summary: The Warlock features include a weapon bond that ends under certain conditions, a familiar with special forms and attack capabilities, a Book of Shadows with prepared spells and cantrips, and various invocations granting abilities like pushing creatures, extra attacks, and casting specific spells without using slots.

parent:9ae5b54f40908d709d70e65a8446ddccf.title: D&D Rulebook Snippet Summary
parent:9ae5b54f40908d709d70e65a8446ddccf.summary: The snippet outlines transformation spells that alter objects or creatures, True Resurrection which revives dead creatures with full health, True Seeing granting truesight, and True Strike enhancing an attack with magical insight.

table:0b684d1eff6c06c0c304ee9dc559a5726e.summary: The table lists a Level 9 Necromancy spell for clerics and druids, with a casting time of 1 hour, a touch range, and material components including diamonds worth over 25,000 GP.
prose_rows: The level 9 Necromancy spell, available to Clerics and Druids, has a casting time of 1 hour, a range of touch, and requires verbal, somatic components, and material components including diamonds worth 25,000+ GP.

table:5a0205ac997a818166e0de7029be0eb683.summary: The 'Divination Cantrip' is a spell cast as an action at range self, requiring somatic and material components, including a weapon worth at least 1 CP with which the caster is proficient, and is available to Bards, Sorcerers, Warlocks, and Wizards.
prose_rows: The Divination Cantrip can be cast as an action, affects only the caster, and requires a somatic component and a material component, which is a weapon worth at least 1 copper piece that the caster is proficient with.

parent:7465491b4d767cd15dc49e902b4f4f40a.title: D&D Weapon Mechanics and Properties
parent:7465491b4d767cd15dc49e902b4f4f40a.summary: In D&D, weapons can be used with one or two hands, with damage determined by ability modifiers; mastery properties like Cleave and Push enhance attacks, unlocked by character features.

The Greatclub deals 1d8 bludgeoning damage, is two-handed, can push, weighs 10 lb., and costs 2 SP.
The Handaxe deals 1d6 slashing damage, is light and throwable with a range of 20/60, can vex, weighs 2 lb., and costs 5 GP.
The Javelin deals 1d6 piercing damage, is throwable with a range of 30/120, is slow, weighs 2 lb., and costs 5 SP.
The Light Hammer deals 1d4 bludgeoning damage, is light and throwable with a range of 20/60, can nick, weighs 2 lb., and costs 2 GP.
The Mace deals 1d6 bludgeoning damage, can sap, weighs 4 lb., and costs 5 GP.
The Quarterstaff deals 1d6 bludgeoning damage, is versatile (1d8), can topple, weighs 4 lb., and costs 2 SP.
The Sickle deals 1d4 slashing damage, is light, can nick, weighs 2 lb., and costs 1 GP.
The Spear deals 1d6 piercing damage, is throwable with a range of 20/60, is versatile (1d8), can sap, weighs 3 lb., and costs 1 GP.
The Dart deals 1d4 piercing damage, has finesse, is throwable with a range of 20/60, can vex, weighs 1/4 lb., and costs 5 CP.

The Flail deals 1d8 bludgeoning damage and can sap, weighs 2 lb., and costs 10 GP.
The Glaive deals 1d10 slashing damage, is heavy, has reach, is two-handed, can graze, weighs 6 lb., and costs 20 GP.
The Greataxe deals 1d12 slashing damage, is heavy, two-handed, can cleave, weighs 7 lb., and costs 30 GP.
The Greatsword deals 2d6 slashing damage, is heavy, two-handed, can graze, weighs 6 lb., and costs 50 GP.
The Halberd deals 1d10 slashing damage, is heavy, has reach, is two-handed, can cleave, weighs 6 lb., and costs 20 GP.
