parent:cc05f2e1c1215a096624abf40095c5b2e.title: D&D Feats Overview
parent:cc05f2e1c1215a096624abf40095c5b2e.summary: Feats in D&D are categorized into Origin, General, Fighting Style, or Epic Boon, each with prerequisites, benefits, and repeatability rules, exemplified by feats like Alert, Magic Initiate, Savage Attacker, and Skilled, which offer specific combat and skill enhancements.

parent:a6d3187a7a867ccf2afcc8f665bb657ee.title: Core Rules/Concepts of Exploration in D&D
parent:a6d3187a7a867ccf2afcc8f665bb657ee.summary: In D&D, exploration involves using equipment to interact with the environment, with vision and light affecting perception and actions, and specific rules governing hiding and object interaction.

parent:732122a304f1bf8efc3d7c6ab746c7ba5.title: Blue Dragon Wyrmling Core Rules and Concepts
parent:732122a304f1bf8efc3d7c6ab746c7ba5.summary: The Blue Dragon Wyrmling is a Medium, Lawful Evil dragon with AC 17, Initiative +2, 65 HP, and movement speeds of 30 ft., 15 ft. burrowing, and 60 ft. flying; it has Perception +4, Stealth +2, immunity to lightning, Blindsight 10 ft., Darkvision 60 ft., and speaks Draconic, with a CR of 3; it attacks with two Rend attacks causing Slashing and Lightning damage, and a Lightning Breath attack that deals 21 (6d6) Lightning damage in a line, with a saving throw to halve the damage.

parent:6885f88ec85e599da7eb265805b7590e6.title: Green Dragon Wyrmling Core Rules and Concepts
parent:6885f88ec85e599da7eb265805b7590e6.summary: The Green Dragon Wyrmling is a Medium-sized, Lawful Evil Chromatic Dragon with specific stats for AC, Initiative, HP, and Speed, immunities to poison, special senses, Draconic language, and abilities including Amphibious traits, Multiattack with Rend, and Poison Breath causing Poison damage.

parent:3b23a544ab9866a335d001b345fcdb614.title: Giant Seahorse Core Rules
parent:3b23a544ab9866a335d001b345fcdb614.summary: The Giant Seahorse is a large, unaligned beast with an AC of 14, 16 HP, and a CR of 1/2, capable of breathing only underwater, performing a Ram attack with variable damage, and using Bubble Dash to move swiftly underwater without provoking attacks.

parent:c9f7725f6bca1ee51959325e2f55df0ed.title: Gorgon Core Rules and Concepts
parent:c9f7725f6bca1ee51959325e2f55df0ed.summary: The Gorgon is a large, unaligned construct with high AC and HP, capable of moving quickly and perceiving its surroundings well, immune to exhaustion and petrification, and uses melee attacks to knock down smaller targets, a petrifying breath to restrain or petrify creatures, and a trample action to damage prone creatures.

parent:7159923e045905b3a3b53c6f62c852615.title: Wyvern Core Rules and Concepts
parent:7159923e045905b3a3b53c6f62c852615.summary: The Wyvern is a large, unaligned dragon with an Armor Class of 14, Initiative +0, 127 HP, ground speed of 30 ft., and flight speed of 80 ft., possessing darkvision and a Perception skill of +4, and it attacks with a Bite causing 13 piercing damage and a Sting causing 11 piercing plus 24 poison damage, also inducing the Poisoned condition.

parent:d6a2de34f402297c752ddca6a3357807a.title: D&D Rulebook Snippet Summary
parent:d6a2de34f402297c752ddca6a3357807a.summary: Rock Gnomes can create and use three Tiny clockwork devices with effects from the _Prestidigitation_ spell, while Goliaths possess unique ancestral boons, a transformation ability to Large size, and a powerful build that grants advantages in specific situations.

parent:0a6af98985e4648d6a1cff6a4002517e5.title: D&D Wondrous Items Summary
parent:0a6af98985e4648d6a1cff6a4002517e5.summary: The brazier summons a Fire Elemental that obeys commands and acts on your turn, disappearing after an hour or when dismissed, and can't be reused until dawn; bracers enhance archery and defense, while other items offer resistance, immunity, flight, and spellcasting advantages.

parent:9f34ddbb07258c492194acf145e138203.title: D&D Rulebook Snippet Summary
parent:9f34ddbb07258c492194acf145e138203.summary: The haversack is destroyed if torn, losing its contents except for Artifacts, and can be turned inside out to spill its contents without harm; it holds air for 10 minutes divided by the number of creatures inside, and placing it in an extradimensional space opens a one-way gate to the Astral Plane; the Hat of Disguise allows casting Disguise Self, the Headband of Intellect boosts Intelligence to 19, and the Helm of Brilliance provides benefits like Diamond Light, Fire Opal Flames, Ruby Resistance, spellcasting using its gems, and a special effect when taking Fire damage.

parent:477cc2235f9221530b88ad016dcc7b97f.title: Azer Sentinel Core Rules and Concepts
parent:477cc2235f9221530b88ad016dcc7b97f.summary: The Azer Sentinel is a Medium Elemental with Lawful Neutral alignment, immune to fire and poison, possessing a Fire Aura that damages nearby creatures and an Illumination ability, and can attack with a Burning Hammer dealing both bludgeoning and fire damage.

parent:d1f7a06e6aef4881f628d997b2b8d7afe.title: Vampire Core Rules and Concepts
parent:d1f7a06e6aef4881f628d997b2b8d7afe.summary: The Vampire is a Lawful Evil Medium or Small Undead with high AC, initiative, and HP, possessing resistances, skills, and senses, and speaking multiple languages; it has traits like Legendary Resistance and Misty Escape, weaknesses such as Forbiddance and Sunlight, and actions including Multiattack and Bite, which can transform a Humanoid into a Vampire Spawn, along with a Charm bonus action.

parent:095763adb424688b4eb8f1c408c689952.title: Scribing Spell Scrolls in D&D
parent:095763adb424688b4eb8f1c408c689952.summary: A spellcaster can create a Spell Scroll by spending time and money based on the spell's level, requiring proficiency in Arcana or Calligrapher’s Supplies, having the spell prepared daily, and possessing necessary Material components, with cantrips on scrolls functioning as if cast by the scribe's level.

table:48d2c6d4bf62480a152573b1d2d24a3a72.summary: The table provides the gold piece cost and creation time for spell scrolls of different spell levels, with the scroll's effectiveness matching the caster's level.
prose_rows: A spell scroll functions as if the caster were at your level.
A cantrip-level spell scroll takes 1 day to create and costs 15 GP.
A level 1 spell scroll takes 1 day to create and costs 25 GP.
A level 2 spell scroll takes 3 days to create and costs 100 GP.
A level 3 spell scroll takes 5 days to create and costs 150 GP.
A level 4 spell scroll takes 10 days to create and costs 1,000 GP.
A level 5 spell scroll takes 25 days to create and costs 1,500 GP.
A level 6 spell scroll takes 40 days to create and costs 10,000 GP.
A level 7 spell scroll takes 50 days to create and costs 12,500 GP.
A level 8 spell scroll takes 60 days to create and costs 15,000 GP.
A level 9 spell scroll takes 120 days to create and costs 50,000 GP.

parent:a3f5958045b85c2cab6383b28560e101d.title: Young Blue Dragon Core Rules and Concepts
parent:a3f5958045b85c2cab6383b28560e101d.summary: The Young Blue Dragon is a Lawful Evil Large Dragon with high AC, initiative, and HP, capable of multiattacks with Rend and a powerful Lightning Breath, immune to lightning, and possessing blindsight and darkvision.

parent:fcabb5441dd331cc97cd7d146d64b1a90.title: Young Green Dragon Core Rules and Concepts
parent:fcabb5441dd331cc97cd7d146d64b1a90.summary: The Young Green Dragon is a large, lawful evil chromatic dragon with high AC, initiative, and HP, capable of flying, swimming, and breathing both air and water, possessing skills in deception, perception, and stealth, immune to poison, with blindsight and darkvision, and can communicate in Common and Draconic, featuring a multiattack with rend and poison breath attacks.

parent:3f2c2e95390a93fabd6e68d3020bfcff8.title: Giant Shark Core Rules and Concepts
parent:3f2c2e95390a93fabd6e68d3020bfcff8.summary: The Giant Shark is a large, unaligned beast with high AC and initiative, capable of swimming fast and possessing blindsight, requiring underwater breathing, and can make two powerful Bite attacks per turn.

parent:d39bfeb8ff4b71fb8ad5eeeb2c0e72842.title: Oni Core Rules and Concepts
parent:d39bfeb8ff4b71fb8ad5eeeb2c0e72842.summary: The Oni is a Large Fiend with Lawful Evil alignment, possessing high AC and HP, resistances to cold, and darkvision; it can regenerate HP, attack with claws or a nightmare ray, shape-shift, and cast spells like Charm Person and Invisibility, with a challenge rating of 7.

parent:de0038626842c83fe8fdf7adf51c6590a.title: D&D Rulebook Snippet Summary
parent:de0038626842c83fe8fdf7adf51c6590a.summary: The Sphere of Annihilation is a legendary item that obliterates matter, can be controlled through an Intelligence check, and interacts with portals or extradimensional spaces in various ways, while the Staff of Charming allows its wielder to cast specific spells, reflect enchantments, and resist enchantments, regaining charges daily.

parent:45d7b0f0f45b0013af6e3ee890a6d862c.title: Gray Ooze Core Rules and Concepts
parent:45d7b0f0f45b0013af6e3ee890a6d862c.summary: The Gray Ooze is an unaligned, medium-sized creature with resistances to acid, cold, and fire, and immunities to various conditions; it can move through narrow spaces, destroy nonmagical ammunition and weapons upon contact, consume nonmagical metal or wood, and attacks with a pseudopod that deals acid damage and weakens nonmagical armor, which can be repaired with the Mending spell.

parent:c7a850e01af3ff3f320ca37e0e2966bc4.title: Xorn Summary
parent:c7a850e01af3ff3f320ca37e0e2966bc4.summary: The Xorn is a Medium Elemental with AC 19, HP 84, and abilities like Earth Glide and Treasure Sense, immune to poison and paralysis, and can perform Multiattack actions including Bite and Claw, with a Bonus Action Charge.

parent:432dd755c06f05029c445bbe65d61aff4.title: D&D Wondrous Items Summary
parent:432dd755c06f05029c445bbe65d61aff4.summary: The snippet describes various wondrous items in D&D, detailing their unique abilities, limitations, and conditions for use, such as the Carpet of Flying's size and capacity, the Censer of Controlling Air Elementals' summoning capability, the Chime of Opening's limited casting of Knock, the Circlet of Blasting's Scorching Ray casting, the Cloak of Arachnida's spider-related benefits, and the Cloak of Displacement's illusionary combat advantage.

parent:8f05444d187720497bc35b661becae017.title: D&D Rulebook Snippet Summary
parent:8f05444d187720497bc35b661becae017.summary: The Helm of Teleportation allows teleportation with daily recharge, the Holy Avenger grants bonuses and creates a protective emanation for Paladins, the Horn of Blasting emits a thunderous blast causing damage and has a risk of explosion, and the Horn of Valhalla summons warrior spirits with varying requirements based on its metal type.

parent:196bbf81f7addff757c25acee21b18fdf.title: Balor Core Rules and Concepts
parent:196bbf81f7addff757c25acee21b18fdf.summary: The Balor is a Huge Fiend with high AC, initiative, and HP, capable of flying and possessing strong resistances and immunities; it explodes on death, emits a fire aura, has legendary and magic resistance, and can perform multiattacks with Flame Whip and Lightning Blade, as well as teleport itself or other demons.

parent:1dc7865a50b69995cd0ee78fe1534e977.title: Sight Rot Contagion Rules
parent:1dc7865a50b69995cd0ee78fe1534e977.summary: Sight Rot can be cured with three doses and ointment applications over 72 hours, and spreads through skin contact, requiring a DC 15 Constitution saving throw for Humanoids to avoid infection, with temporary immunity to that specific infected creature for 24 hours upon a successful save.

parent:65ec4cee119d6ff79bdd1d7d8f4c203f6.title: Adult Blue Dragon Core Rules and Concepts
parent:65ec4cee119d6ff79bdd1d7d8f4c203f6.summary: The Adult Blue Dragon is a formidable lawful evil creature with high AC, initiative, and HP, capable of flying, burrowing, and possessing strong perception and stealth skills, immune to lightning, with blindsight and darkvision, and can communicate in Common and Draconic, featuring legendary resistance, multiattack with rend and spellcasting, lightning breath, and various spells, along with legendary actions like cloaked flight, sonic boom, and tail swipe.

parent:3c52f579c5d3821462fd8172cfe49fbe2.title: Adult Green Dragon Core Rules and Concepts
parent:3c52f579c5d3821462fd8172cfe49fbe2.summary: The Adult Green Dragon is a large, lawfully evil chromatic dragon with high AC, initiative, and HP, capable of flying, swimming, and breathing both air and water, immune to poison, with blindsight and darkvision, and can communicate in Common and Draconic; it has a high challenge rating, legendary resistance, and can perform multiattacks, poison breath, and legendary actions like mind invasion and noxious miasma, while its pounce action allows it to move and attack.

parent:3adfe59f2648ef338daf35beda9b7fe5d.title: Core Rules for Wizard Spellcasting in D&D
parent:3adfe59f2648ef338daf35beda9b7fe5d.summary: Wizards start with six level 1 spells, gain two new spells per level, prepare a list of spells for casting, regain spell slots after a long rest, and have features like Ritual Adept and Arcane Recovery to enhance their spellcasting capabilities.

parent:ea135bf21d04453e994eeb17a32ed3a4e.title: Giant Spider Core Rules and Concepts
parent:ea135bf21d04453e994eeb17a32ed3a4e.summary: The Giant Spider is a large, unaligned beast with abilities to climb and navigate webs, possessing moderate health and speed, and attacks that include a piercing and poison bite and a web that restrains targets, making them vulnerable to fire damage.

parent:680d5d9af0c38f0e5cbdaf530167f5260.title: D&D Rulebook Snippet Summary
parent:680d5d9af0c38f0e5cbdaf530167f5260.summary: The snippet outlines the 'Antilife Shell' spell creating a barrier against non-Construct and Undead creatures, 'Antimagic Field' suppressing magic within a 10-foot radius, and 'Antipathy/Sympathy' causing creatures of a specified kind to become Frightened or attracted when near a target.

parent:535656d3ffeb6ff944e2edf513ee31605.title: Otyugh Core Rules and Concepts
parent:535656d3ffeb6ff944e2edf513ee31605.summary: The Otyugh is a large, neutral aberration with a combat strategy involving multiple attacks, including a bite that inflicts piercing damage and a poisonous condition reducing maximum hit points, and tentacle attacks that can grapple smaller creatures and slam them for bludgeoning damage, potentially stunning them.

parent:c114932557845c3d9b00f1ce420f39f27.title: D&D Staffs: Frost, Healing, and Power
parent:c114932557845c3d9b00f1ce420f39f27.summary: The Staff of Frost grants cold resistance and allows casting cold spells at a charge cost, regaining charges daily, and turning to water if depleted; the Staff of Healing provides healing spells with a charge system, regaining charges daily, and vanishing if depleted; the Staff of Power enhances attack and defense, allows casting various spells, regains charges rapidly, and can be destroyed for a powerful explosion with a chance to escape to another plane.

parent:a2ab2526bc397fde2ede4f2724b4fa306.title: D&D Character Progression Tiers
parent:a2ab2526bc397fde2ede4f2724b4fa306.summary: In D&D, characters progress through four tiers: Tier 2 (Levels 5–10) as full-fledged adventurers facing city and kingdom threats, Tier 3 (Levels 11–16) with reality-altering spells and enhanced attacks confronting regional threats, and Tier 4 (Levels 17–20) as heroic archetypes facing multiverse-level threats.

parent:074c668303bfb59bc984df45f10e5aec4.title: Giant Wasp Core Rules and Concepts
parent:074c668303bfb59bc984df45f10e5aec4.summary: The Giant Wasp is a Medium Beast with AC 13, initiative +2, 22 HP, ground speed of 10 ft., fly speed of 50 ft., Passive Perception 10, no languages, CR 1/2, and the Flyby trait; it attacks with a sting causing 5 piercing and 5 poison damage.

parent:ca72b818b823b8be90e271fa01e982dda.title: Zombie Core Rules and Concepts
parent:ca72b818b823b8be90e271fa01e982dda.summary: A Zombie is a Medium Undead with AC 8, Initiative -2, 15 HP, 20 ft. speed, immunities to poison and exhaustion, darkvision 60 ft., passive perception 8, understands Common and one other language but cannot speak, has a CR of 1/4, and can make a Constitution saving throw to drop to 1 HP instead of dying from non-radiant or non-critical damage, and can perform a melee slam attack dealing 5 bludgeoning damage.

parent:a63a49e44cb2dc18cd6a88f0b0a6a251b.title: D&D Bandit Character Summary
parent:a63a49e44cb2dc18cd6a88f0b0a6a251b.summary: A Bandit is a Medium or Small Humanoid with Neutral alignment, having an AC of 12, initiative of +1, 11 HP, 30 ft. speed, equipped with Leather Armor, a Light Crossbow, and a Scimitar, possessing Passive Perception 10, speaking Common and Thieves’ Cant, with a CR of 1/8, capable of a melee attack with a Scimitar dealing 4 Slashing damage and a ranged attack with a Light Crossbow dealing 5 Piercing damage.

parent:b4bb0946f19b64329f6cdd4635936c011.title: Magmin Core Rules and Concepts
parent:b4bb0946f19b64329f6cdd4635936c011.summary: The Magmin is a small elemental with fire immunity, capable of exploding on death to deal fire damage, attacking with touch to cause fire damage and ignite targets, and using a bonus action to provide light by igniting itself.

parent:23bfaa2c65b4c77444d1a89bf0f0dbf3f.title: Environmental Effects in D&D
parent:23bfaa2c65b4c77444d1a89bf0f0dbf3f.summary: In D&D, environmental conditions such as deep water, extreme cold or heat, heavy precipitation, high altitude, slippery ice, and strong wind impose challenges on creatures, often requiring Constitution or Dexterity saving throws to avoid exhaustion or other penalties, with certain resistances or immunities offering automatic success on these saves.

parent:fd9cc528b22f64aa688fcd763e4dd2997.title: D&D Weapon Summary
parent:fd9cc528b22f64aa688fcd763e4dd2997.summary: The D&D rulebook snippet outlines various melee and ranged weapons, specifying their damage types, special properties (e.g., finesse, reach, versatility), weight, and cost in gold pieces, with ranged weapons further detailed by ammunition type and range.

parent:7c4b0ff04ab5e24975df9a4b62184d47e.title: Ancient Blue Dragon Core Rules and Concepts
parent:7c4b0ff04ab5e24975df9a4b62184d47e.summary: The Ancient Blue Dragon is a formidable lawful evil chromatic dragon with high AC, initiative, and HP, possessing blindsight, darkvision, and lightning immunity, and can use legendary resistance; it attacks with rend, lightning breath, and spells like Detect Magic and Shatter, and performs legendary actions such as cloaked flight and sonic boom.

parent:310d1d46e0b763937891ae556ca0ef674.title: D&D Ranger Class Summary
parent:310d1d46e0b763937891ae556ca0ef674.summary: The Ranger class in D&D emphasizes Dexterity and Wisdom, proficiency with simple and martial weapons, and light to medium armor, gaining spellcasting at level 1, with features like Favored Enemy and Weapon Mastery, and progressively increasing spell slots and abilities as they level up.

parent:658fe9b1542592e41841b82eafdaa0d49.title: D&D Spell Mechanics Summary
parent:658fe9b1542592e41841b82eafdaa0d49.summary: The 'Harm' spell deals necrotic damage and reduces a target's max HP, 'Haste' enhances a target's speed and defenses but leaves them incapacitated afterward, 'Heal' restores HP and cures conditions with increased healing for higher slots, 'Healing Word' provides quick healing with increased effectiveness at higher levels, and 'Heat Metal' damages creatures in contact with a heated metal object.

parent:99e862a852f339442c206ac288ec2ede2.title: Ancient Green Dragon Core Rules and Concepts
parent:99e862a852f339442c206ac288ec2ede2.summary: The Ancient Green Dragon is a Gargantuan, Lawful Evil creature with high AC, HP, and initiative, capable of flying, swimming, and breathing both air and water, immune to poison, with blindsight and darkvision, and can communicate in Common and Draconic; it has a high CR, Legendary Resistance, and powerful actions including multiattack with Rend and Spellcasting, Poison Breath, and Legendary Actions like Mind Invasion, Noxious Miasma, and Pounce.

parent:db7c82a1fb8bf3bcfc8f82452f5c347be.title: Giant Toad Core Rules and Concepts
parent:db7c82a1fb8bf3bcfc8f82452f5c347be.summary: The Giant Toad is an amphibious large beast with a bite attack that can grapple and poison smaller creatures, and a swallow action that restrains and damages a Medium or smaller target while preventing external attacks, but it can only swallow one target at a time and cannot bite while swallowing.

parent:ab35312d3495589fac135e50e8092eec3.title: Giant Weasel Core Rules and Concepts
parent:ab35312d3495589fac135e50e8092eec3.summary: The Giant Weasel is a medium beast with AC 13, initiative +3, 9 HP, and speeds of 40 ft. and 30 ft. climbing, skilled in acrobatics and stealth, with darkvision and a bite attack dealing 5 piercing damage.

parent:90d53c4aec801aa1aeec4ae7cebe58850.title: Owlbear Core Rules and Concepts
parent:90d53c4aec801aa1aeec4ae7cebe58850.summary: The Owlbear is a large, unaligned monstrosity with an AC of 13, initiative +1, 59 HP, speeds of 40 ft. on the ground and climbing, darkvision, no languages, a CR of 3, and can perform a multiattack with two rends causing 14 slashing damage each.

parent:839891ce92aef543e42c03614ab0f72a5.title: D&D Rulebook Snippet Summary
parent:839891ce92aef543e42c03614ab0f72a5.summary: The 'Staff of Swarming Insects' allows the creation of an insect cloud and casting specific spells, regaining charges daily with a risk of destruction, while the 'Staff of the Magi' enhances spellcasting, absorbs spells, regains charges daily, and risks explosion if charges exceed 50.

parent:8020c2643681116832fde82459a54bd58.title: Ogre Zombie Core Rules and Concepts
parent:8020c2643681116832fde82459a54bd58.summary: The Ogre Zombie is a large undead creature with low AC and initiative, high HP, and moderate speed, immune to poison and exhaustion, with darkvision and passive perception, understanding but unable to speak Common and Giant, having a challenge rating of 2, and featuring Undead Fortitude to survive lethal damage, primarily attacking with a melee slam.

parent:404e4340cf0569831da8fd6603fc9ef8d.title: Core Rules of Spellcasting in D&D
parent:404e4340cf0569831da8fd6603fc9ef8d.summary: In D&D, spells have a specified duration, affect targets with clear paths, allow self-targeting unless restricted, and may cover areas of effect; targets are unaware unless the spell is perceptible, and invalid targets result in wasted spell slots, while saving throws and attack rolls determine spell success.

parent:cfff9827c6fe3af80273e1af91a00ef0e.title: Manticore Core Rules and Concepts
parent:cfff9827c6fe3af80273e1af91a00ef0e.summary: The Manticore is a Large Monstrosity with Lawful Evil alignment, possessing an Armor Class of 14, initiative of +3, 68 hit points, speeds of 30 ft. on the ground and 50 ft. flying, darkvision up to 60 ft., Common language, a challenge rating of 3, and can perform a Multiattack with Rend and Tail Spike, dealing 7 Slashing or Piercing damage respectively.

parent:68517ba6ad670786b6791a7a65d475a1c.title: D&D Spell Mechanics Summary
parent:68517ba6ad670786b6791a7a65d475a1c.summary: The snippet describes the spells 'Heroes’ Feast,' 'Heroism,' 'Hex,' and 'Hideous Laughter,' detailing their casting times, ranges, components, durations, effects, and the mechanics for using higher-level spell slots to enhance their power or duration.

table:5eac2ada896d1bb96eafe823dca1eb459c.summary: The table lists a spell with a 10-minute casting time, self-range, and components including verbal, somatic, and a consumed gem-encrusted bowl worth over 1,000 GP.
prose_rows: The spell has a casting time of 10 minutes, a range of self, and requires verbal, somatic, and material components, including a gem-encrusted bowl worth over 1,000 GP that is consumed by the spell.

parent:7ec4b8bf09a703797a054686ac132b152.title: Curses and Magical Contagions in D&D
parent:7ec4b8bf09a703797a054686ac132b152.summary: Curses in D&D are magical burdens with varying durations and effects, ranging from simple spells like Bestow Curse to complex narrative and environmental curses, each with specific rules for removal and impact on gameplay.

parent:1a7cb5db140aa50a4d0a28b77ffc81601.title: Green Hag Core Rules and Concepts
parent:1a7cb5db140aa50a4d0a28b77ffc81601.summary: The Green Hag is a Medium Fey, Neutral Evil creature with amphibious abilities, coven magic for spellcasting near allies, mimicry skills, and actions including multiattacks with claw and poison damage, and spellcasting with spells like Dancing Lights and Invisibility.

parent:18430b1546a4c80504d2b6fbac1e6a931.title: D&D Character Origins and Backgrounds
parent:18430b1546a4c80504d2b6fbac1e6a931.summary: In D&D, character backgrounds provide formative traits, including specific ability score increases, a feat, skill and tool proficiencies, and a choice between a set of equipment or gold, shaping the character's initial capabilities and resources.

table:e4f7330f2646fa886d57090abf33bdae19.summary: Each background provides a choice between a package of equipment and 50 GP.
prose_rows: In Dungeons & Dragons, each background offers a choice between receiving a package of equipment or 50 gold pieces.

parent:0fc44d76f9f16aa330337ddde3afb3282.title: Ancient Bronze Dragon Summary
parent:0fc44d76f9f16aa330337ddde3afb3282.summary: The Ancient Bronze Dragon is a Gargantuan, Lawful Good dragon with high AC, HP, and initiative, possessing skills in Insight, Perception, and Stealth, immunity to lightning, and senses of blindsight and darkvision; it can breathe air and water, has Legendary Resistance, and uses Multiattack, Rend, Lightning Breath, Repulsion Breath, and spellcasting, along with Legendary Actions.

parent:3c5556324ef949e167bac78587bf29977.title: Pegasus Creature Summary
parent:3c5556324ef949e167bac78587bf29977.summary: A Pegasus is a Large Celestial, Chaotic Good creature with an AC of 12, initiative of +2, 59 HP, speeds of 60 ft. on the ground and 90 ft. flying, a Perception skill of +6, passive Perception of 16, understanding of multiple languages but unable to speak, a CR of 2, and an attack with hooves that deals 7 bludgeoning and 5 radiant damage.

parent:515aa4a695cbb8181cea5fcd9a635c850.title: Giant Venomous Snake Core Rules
parent:515aa4a695cbb8181cea5fcd9a635c850.summary: The Giant Venomous Snake is a medium, unaligned beast with AC 14, initiative +4, 11 HP, and speeds of 40 ft. on land and in water, possessing blindsight and a Perception skill of +2; it deals 6 piercing and 4 poison damage with its bite attack, has a CR of 1/4, and grants 50 XP.

parent:9d9af0c539bcba1f62415d092ea0c7fc7.title: Giant Wolf Spider Core Rules
parent:9d9af0c539bcba1f62415d092ea0c7fc7.summary: The Giant Wolf Spider is a medium beast with AC 13, initiative +3, 11 HP, and speeds of 40 ft. on the ground and climbing, excelling in Stealth and Perception, with blindsight and darkvision, and attacks with a bite causing piercing and poison damage.

parent:bfdfbc095fd718bcddd485d68ce5a5405.title: Bandit Captain Summary
parent:bfdfbc095fd718bcddd485d68ce5a5405.summary: The Bandit Captain is a neutral humanoid with an AC of 15, initiative +3, 52 HP, and a speed of 30 ft., skilled in Athletics and Deception, equipped with a pistol, scimitar, and studded leather armor, speaking Common and Thieves’ Cant, with a CR of 2, capable of multiattacks with its weapons and a parry reaction to increase AC against melee attacks.

parent:ca34d0f0fceeaf7e71c2d03fe3dbd0d02.title: Allosaurus Core Rules and Concepts
parent:ca34d0f0fceeaf7e71c2d03fe3dbd0d02.summary: The Allosaurus is a Large Beast with AC 13, HP 51, speed 60 ft., and skills in Perception; it attacks with a bite causing 15 Piercing damage and claws causing 8 Slashing damage, with a special rule that makes a target prone if the Allosaurus moves 30+ feet towards it before a claw hit.

parent:53f8976fac7afbecaa7ae43313c30f547.title: D&D Rulebook Snippet Summary
parent:53f8976fac7afbecaa7ae43313c30f547.summary: The snippet outlines a weapon that allows targeting a sworn enemy with advantage and extra damage, potions like Oil of Etherealness, Oil of Sharpness, and Oil of Slipperiness with unique effects, and wondrous items such as Pearl of Power and Periapt of Health that offer spell slot recovery and hit point restoration, respectively.

parent:230f2d7b5af9f4637809fd65c8c1ac3e5.title: Core Druid Rules and Concepts
parent:230f2d7b5af9f4637809fd65c8c1ac3e5.summary: Druids in D&D prioritize Wisdom, use simple weapons and light armor, and gain spellcasting abilities and features like Wild Shape as they level up, with specific starting equipment and multiclassing options retaining core traits and spellcasting.

table:c8af3e2ab621c4cb39bb55e54e9a25331e.summary: The table lists a character's proficiency in Herbalism Kit and Light Armor and Shields, along with two starting equipment options: Option A with specific items and 9 GP, or Option B with 50 GP.
prose_rows: The character has proficiency with the Herbalism Kit.
The character is trained to wear light armor and shields.
For starting equipment, the character can choose option A: Leather Armor, Shield, Sickle, Druidic Focus (Quarterstaff), Explorer’s Pack, Herbalism Kit, and 9 GP; or option B: 50 GP.

table:1da7ebf54a1f2fa4f451c3428bada36213.summary: The table lists the progression of a Druid class in a role-playing game, detailing class features, spell slots per spell level, and other abilities acquired at each level from 1 to 20.
prose_rows: At level 1, Druids gain +2 bonus to spellcasting and Druidic features, with 2 cantrips and spell slots of 2, 4, and 2 for levels 1, 2, and 3 respectively, and the Primal Order feature.
At level 2, Druids have a +2 bonus, gain Wild Shape, and have 2 cantrips and spell slots of 2, 2, 5, and 3 for levels 1, 2, 3, and 4 respectively, along with the Wild Companion feature.
At level 3, Druids receive a +2 bonus, choose a Druid Subclass, have 2 cantrips, and spell slots of 2, 2, 6, 4, and 2 for levels 1, 2, 3, 4, and 5 respectively.
At level 4, Druids have a +2 bonus, Ability Score Improvement, 2 cantrips, and spell slots of 2, 3, 7, 4, and 3 for levels 1, 2, 3, 4, and 5 respectively.
At level 5, Druids gain a +3 bonus, Wild Resurgence, 2 cantrips, and spell slots of 2, 3, 9, 4, 3, and 2 for levels 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, and 6 respectively.
At level 6, Druids have a +3 bonus, a Subclass feature, 3 cantrips, and spell slots of 3, 3, 10, 4, 3, and 3 for levels 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, and 6 respectively.
At level 7, Druids receive a +3 bonus, Elemental Fury, 3 cantrips, and spell slots of 3, 3, 11, 4, 3, 3, and 1 for levels 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, and 7 respectively.
At level 8, Druids have a +3 bonus, Ability Score Improvement, 3 cantrips, and spell slots of 3, 3, 12, 4, 3, 3, and 2 for levels 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, and 7 respectively.
At level 9, Druids gain a +4 bonus, 3 cantrips, and spell slots of 3, 3, 14, 4, 3, 3, 3, and 1 for levels 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, and 8 respectively.

parent:1f243b067b6e384f13a58a4ba3b01787f.title: Marilith Core Rules and Concepts
parent:1f243b067b6e384f13a58a4ba3b01787f.summary: The Marilith is a large fiend with high AC, initiative, and HP, possessing resistances to cold, fire, and lightning, and immunities to poison; it can revive in the Abyss upon death, has advantage on saving throws against magic, can take a reaction each turn, and uses a Multiattack involving Pact Blade and Constrict, with teleportation and parry abilities.

parent:f52935d238a13e71123b011ec8b5e8064.title: D&D Rulebook Snippet: Magical Contagions
parent:f52935d238a13e71123b011ec8b5e8064.summary: Cackle Fever affects Humanoids with fever and uncontrollable laughter, spreading through proximity and ending after three successful saves post-Long Rest, while Sewer Plague causes fatigue, weakness, and restlessness, spreading through wounds or contact with contaminated materials, and requiring daily saving throws to fight.

parent:7065bde9246947519f93ab0f88d0e5924.title: Giant Vulture Core Rules
parent:7065bde9246947519f93ab0f88d0e5924.summary: The Giant Vulture, a large neutral evil monstrosity, has an AC of 10, 25 HP, and can fly; it gains an attack advantage in packs, resists necrotic damage, and its gouge attack deals piercing damage and poisons the target.

parent:3e6af5c712ad3a08a2dcbb94d1597fcce.title: Bugbear Stalker Core Rules and Concepts
parent:3e6af5c712ad3a08a2dcbb94d1597fcce.summary: The Bugbear Stalker is a Medium Fey (Goblinoid) creature with Chaotic Evil alignment, featuring an Armor Class of 15, Initiative +2, 65 hit points, and a speed of 30 ft., excelling in Stealth and Survival, equipped with a Chain Shirt, Javelins, and a Morningstar, possessing Darkvision up to 60 ft., a Passive Perception of 11, and speaking Common and Goblin, with a Challenge Rating of 3, capable of abducting without extra movement, performing a multiattack with Javelins or a Morningstar, and using a Quick Grapple bonus action with a Dexterity saving throw DC of 13.

parent:9a064cf3e0280c248b4082d3e4372b2e9.title: Phase Spider Core Rules and Concepts
parent:9a064cf3e0280c248b4082d3e4372b2e9.summary: The Phase Spider is a large, unaligned monstrosity with high stealth and ethereal sight, capable of climbing and web walking, and can teleport between planes, attacking with a poisonous bite that can paralyze its target.

parent:0a8dc5d31dac92e098d1a15a442c16830.title: Goat Creature Summary
parent:0a8dc5d31dac92e098d1a15a442c16830.summary: The Goat is a Medium Beast with AC 10, Initiative +0, 4 HP, 40 ft. speed, 30 ft. climb, Perception +2, Darkvision 60 ft., no languages, CR 0, and a Ram attack that deals 1 or 2 Bludgeoning damage based on movement.

parent:00d4475a09d68ff1a51e119258b9515d9.title: Bard Class Summary
parent:00d4475a09d68ff1a51e119258b9515d9.summary: The Bard is a Charisma-based class proficient in simple weapons and musical instruments, starting with light armor or gold, gaining hit points with a D8, and featuring abilities like Bardic Inspiration and spellcasting, with progression through expertise, subclass features, and ability score improvements.

table:f151e8c870a6cbde4cf382e040943ca80f.summary: The table lists starting equipment options for light armor training, offering either a set of leather armor, daggers, a musical instrument, an entertainer's pack, and 19 GP, or a cash alternative of 90 GP.
prose_rows: The character has training in light armor.
Starting equipment option A includes leather armor, two daggers, a musical instrument of the player's choice, an entertainer's pack, and 19 gold pieces.
Starting equipment option B provides 90 gold pieces.

table:6f6db717ac63f8a4706bc77cce8c78246e.summary: The table lists the progression of a Bard character's spellcasting abilities and class features, including spell slots per level, proficiency bonuses, and additional abilities gained at each level from 1 to 20.
prose_rows: At level 1, a Bard gains a +2 proficiency bonus, Bardic Inspiration, and can use a D6 for spell slots, with 2 cantrips, 4 1st-level spells, and 2 2nd-level spells.
At level 2, a Bard gains a +2 proficiency bonus, Expertise, and can use a D6 for spell slots, with 2 cantrips, 5 1st-level spells, and 3 2nd-level spells.
At level 3, a Bard gains a +2 proficiency bonus, Bard Subclass, and can use a D6 for spell slots, with 2 cantrips, 6 1st-level spells, 4 2nd-level spells, and 2 3rd-level spells.
At level 4, a Bard gains a +2 proficiency bonus, Ability Score Improvement, and can use a D6 for spell slots, with 3 cantrips, 7 1st-level spells, 4 2nd-level spells, and 3 3rd-level spells.

At level 5, a Bard gains a +3 proficiency bonus, Font of Inspiration, and can use a D8 for spell slots, with 3 cantrips, 9 1st-level spells, 4 2nd-level spells, 3 3rd-level spells, and 2 4th-level spells.

At level 6, a Bard gains a +3 proficiency bonus, Subclass feature, and can use a D8 for spell slots, with 3 cantrips, 10 1st-level spells, 4 2nd-level spells, 3 3rd-level spells, and 3 4th-level spells.

At level 7, a Bard gains a +3 proficiency bonus, Countercharm, and can use a D8 for spell slots, with 3 cantrips, 11 1st-level spells, 4 2nd-level spells, 3 3rd-level spells, 3 4th-level spells, and 1 5th-level spell.

At level 8, a Bard gains a +3 proficiency bonus, Ability Score Improvement, and can use a D8 for spell slots, with 3 cantrips, 12 1st-level spells, 4 2nd-level spells, 3 3rd-level spells, 3 4th-level spells, and 2 5th-level spells.

At level 9, a Bard gains a +4 proficiency bonus, Expertise, and can use a D8 for spell slots, with 3 cantrips, 14 1st-level spells, 4 2nd-level spells, 3 3rd-level spells, 3 4th-level spells, 3 5th-level spells, and 1 6th-level spell.

At level 10, a Bard gains a +4 proficiency bonus, Magical Secrets, and can use a D10 for spell slots, with 4 cantrips, 15 1st-level spells, 4 2nd-level spells, 3 3rd-level spells, 3 4th-level spells, 3 5th-level spells, and 2 6th-level spells.

At level 11, a Bard gains a +4 proficiency bonus and can use a D10 for spell slots, with 4 cantrips, 16 1st-level spells, 4 2nd-level spells, 3 3rd-level spells, 3 4th-level spells, 3 5th-level spells, 2 6th-level spells, and 1 7th-level spell.

At level 12, a Bard gains a +4 proficiency bonus, Ability Score Improvement, and can use a D10 for spell slots, with 4 cantrips, 16 1st-level spells, 4 2nd-level spells, 3 3rd-level spells, 3 4th-level spells, 3 5th-level spells, 2 6th-level spells, and 1 7th-level spell.

At level 13, a Bard gains a +5 proficiency bonus and can use a D10 for spell slots, with 4 cantrips, 17 1st-level spells, 4 2nd-level spells, 3 3rd-level spells, 3 4th-level spells, 3 5th-level spells, 2 6th-level spells, 1 7th-level spell, and 1 8th-level spell.

At level 14, a Bard gains a +5 proficiency bonus, Subclass feature, and can use a D10 for spell slots, with 4 cantrips, 17 1st-level spells, 4 2nd-level spells, 3 3rd-level spells, 3 4th-level spells, 3 5th-level spells, 2 6th-level spells, 1 7th-level spell, and 1 8th-level spell.

At level 15, a Bard gains a +5 proficiency bonus and can use a D12 for spell slots, with 4 cantrips, 18 1st-level spells, 4 2nd-level spells, 3 3rd-level spells, 3 4th-level spells, 3 5th-level spells, 2 6th-level spells, 1 7th-level spell, 1 8th-level spell, and 1 9th-level spell.

At level 16, a Bard gains a +5 proficiency bonus, Ability Score Improvement, and can use a D12 for spell slots, with 4 cantrips, 18 1st-level spells, 4 2nd-level spells, 3 3rd-level spells, 3 4th-level spells, 3 5th-level spells, 2 6th-level spells, 1 7th-level spell, 1 8th-level spell, and 1 9th-level spell.

At level 17, a Bard gains a +6 proficiency bonus and can use a D12 for spell slots, with 4 cantrips, 19 1st-level spells, 4 2nd-level spells, 3 3rd-level spells, 3 4th-level spells, 3 5th-level spells, 2 6th-level spells, 1 7th-level spell, 1 8th-level spell, 1 9th-level spell, and 1 10th-level spell.

At level 18, a Bard gains a +6 proficiency bonus, Superior Inspiration, and can use a D12 for spell slots, with 4 cantrips, 20 1st-level spells, 4 2nd-level spells, 3 3rd-level spells, 3 4th-level spells, 3 5th-level spells, 3 6th-level spells, 1 7th-level spell, 1 8th-level spell, 1 9th-level spell, and 1 10th-level spell.

At level 19, a Bard gains a +6 proficiency bonus, Epic Boon, and can use a D12 for spell slots, with 4 cantrips, 21 1st-level spells, 4 2nd-level spells, 3 3rd-level spells, 3 4th-level spells, 3 5th-level spells, 3 6th-level spells, 2 7th-level spells, 1 8th-level spell, 1 9th-level spell, and 1 10th-level spell.

At level 20, a Bard gains a +6 proficiency bonus, Words of Creation, and can use a D12 for spell slots, with 4 cantrips, 22 1st-level spells, 4 2nd-level spells, 3 3rd-level spells, 3 4th-level spells, 3 5th-level spells, 3 6th-level spells, 2 7th-level spells, 2 8th-level spells, 1 9th-level spell, and 1 10th-level spell.

parent:faacc0f0e7f7481f347e1e9cbfe43b48c.title: D&D Rulebook Snippet Summary
parent:faacc0f0e7f7481f347e1e9cbfe43b48c.summary: The soul possession spell allows a caster to attempt to possess a humanoid within 100 feet, replacing the target's soul with the caster's, and controlling the target's body while the target's soul remains in a container; if the container is destroyed or the spell ends, the soul returns to the caster's body or dies if conditions aren't met, while Magic Missile creates darts dealing force damage, and Magic Mouth implants a message in an object to be spoken when triggered.

table:bd2bbee28b8dd06d32ac850bb066f38a63.summary: The table lists the spell 'Level 2 Illusion' for Bards and Wizards, detailing its casting time, range, and components, including a material component of jade dust worth at least 10 GP.
prose_rows: The Level 2 Illusion spell, which can be cast by a Bard or Wizard, requires a casting time of 1 minute or can be performed as a ritual, has a range of 30 feet, and necessitates verbal, somatic components, and material components consisting of jade dust worth at least 10 gold pieces.

parent:e2cda5b937322a0871a9411a76f27e33b.title: Barbed Devil Core Rules and Concepts
parent:e2cda5b937322a0871a9411a76f27e33b.summary: The Barbed Devil is a Lawful Evil fiend with high AC, initiative, and HP, resistant to cold and immune to fire, poison, and poisoned conditions, capable of darkvision and telepathy, and can deal piercing damage to grappled creatures, revive in the Nine Hells, and has advantage on saving throws against magic, using claws, a tail, and hurling flames in combat.

parent:616053968380350e47af4aba7318ac437.title: D&D Rulebook Snippet Summary
parent:616053968380350e47af4aba7318ac437.summary: The philter causes charm towards a creature seen within 10 minutes of consumption, the Pipes of Haunting induce fear in creatures within 30 feet, the Pipes of the Sewers control rat swarms and make rats indifferent, the Plate Armor of Etherealness grants etherealness, and the Portable Hole unfolds into a circular sheet.

parent:9412c2951cfc3c5699207fa3d0837dfce.title: D&D Rulebook Snippet Summary
parent:9412c2951cfc3c5699207fa3d0837dfce.summary: The Whirlpool spell creates a dangerous water vortex that damages creatures within it, Control Weather allows manipulation of local weather conditions for up to 8 hours, and Counterspell can interrupt and nullify a spell being cast by another creature.

parent:a8daf9a3068de9fcf5ed9465774a9b569.title: Medusa Core Rules and Concepts
parent:a8daf9a3068de9fcf5ed9465774a9b569.summary: The Medusa is a Lawful Evil Medium Monstrosity with high AC, initiative, and HP, skilled in Deception, Perception, and Stealth, possessing Darkvision and speaking Common plus one language; it can attack with claws, snake hair, and poison rays, and its Petrifying Gaze can restrain or petrify targets after failed saves.

parent:83d1fbfdde629052ced2a330e9b867418.title: Core Rules for Combat and Skill Checks in D&D
parent:83d1fbfdde629052ced2a330e9b867418.summary: In D&D, a natural 1 on an attack roll always misses; advantage/disadvantage affects d20 rolls by using the higher or lower of two rolls, respectively, without stacking; proficiency bonuses apply once per check and can be modified but not multiplied or divided multiple times.

parent:b8a72aea6a2ad1a5fadea7e4fc0950acf.title: Lamia Core Rules and Concepts
parent:b8a72aea6a2ad1a5fadea7e4fc0950acf.summary: The lamia is a large, chaotic evil fiend with 97 HP, AC 13, and initiative +1, capable of multiattacks including claws and a corrupting touch that inflicts psychic damage and curses, with spellcasting abilities and a leap action.

parent:c5528d033a4cf192034d7b9880136e445.title: Minotaur Skeleton Core Rules
parent:c5528d033a4cf192034d7b9880136e445.summary: The Minotaur Skeleton is a Large Undead, Lawful Evil creature with vulnerabilities to bludgeoning, immunities to poison and exhaustion, and abilities to perform 'Gore' and 'Slam' attacks, with specific conditions for additional damage and effects.

parent:ea207781bf9d65504fed2c8f17b9e3630.title: D&D Rulebook Snippet Summary
parent:ea207781bf9d65504fed2c8f17b9e3630.summary: Shape-shifted creatures revert to their true form in a Cylinder and take half damage on a successful save, while 'Move Earth' reshapes terrain within limits, 'Nondetection' conceals targets from Divination spells, and 'Passwall' creates a stable passage through certain surfaces.

table:e2733c7dead21e7d5d889bae5b9036b83d.summary: The table lists a touch-range spell from System Reference Document 5.2, requiring components V, S, M (a pinch of diamond dust worth 25+ GP, consumed by the spell).
prose_rows: The spell has a range of touch, is referenced in the System Reference Document 5.2, and requires verbal (V), somatic (S), and material (M) components, including a pinch of diamond dust worth 25+ GP, which is consumed by the spell.

parent:dadc05b876e035ac8b03918c994e7350f.title: Paladin Progression Features in D&D
parent:dadc05b876e035ac8b03918c994e7350f.summary: Paladins gain new abilities at specific levels, including Ability Score Improvement, Extra Attack, Faithful Steed, Aura of Protection, Abjure Foes, Aura of Courage, Radiant Strikes, Restoring Touch, Aura Expansion, and Epic Boon, enhancing their combat effectiveness, protective capabilities, and utility.

parent:c597a4523658152496013d9469f72750e.title: Bugbear Warrior Core Rules and Concepts
parent:c597a4523658152496013d9469f72750e.summary: The Bugbear Warrior is a Medium Fey creature with chaotic evil alignment, featuring an Armor Class of 14, initiative +2, 33 hit points, and a speed of 30 feet; it excels in Stealth, has darkvision, and can speak Common and Goblin, with a challenge rating of 1; it can abduct without extra movement and uses 'Grab' and 'Light Hammer' actions to grapple and attack.

parent:079d908d6b49987506093f12920bd17f8.title: D&D Hawk Description
parent:079d908d6b49987506093f12920bd17f8.summary: The Hawk is a Tiny Beast with AC 13, Initiative +3, 1 HP, ground speed of 10 ft., flight speed of 60 ft., Perception +6, Passive Perception 16, no languages, CR 0, and uses Talons for a +5 melee attack with 1 Slashing damage.

parent:713a73f02a64ef7f782ce8c7d0b3648c5.title: Summary of D&D Spells: Conjure Animals, Conjure Celestial, and Conjure Elemental
parent:713a73f02a64ef7f782ce8c7d0b3648c5.summary: Conjure Animals allows druids and rangers to summon spectral animals that provide strength bonuses and can attack nearby creatures, with damage scaling by 1d10 per spell slot level above 3; Conjure Celestial enables clerics to manifest a celestial spirit that can heal or damage creatures within a cylinder, with effects scaling by 1d12 per spell slot level above 7; Conjure Elemental allows druids and wizards to summon elemental spirits that deal damage to creatures within range, with damage scaling by 1d8 per spell slot level above 5.

parent:2cb45826967032da1701e1085d0e75932.title: D&D Rulebook Snippet Summary
parent:2cb45826967032da1701e1085d0e75932.summary: Magic Weapon temporarily enhances a nonmagical weapon with a bonus to attack and damage rolls, Magnificent Mansion conjures a lavish extradimensional dwelling with servants and provisions, and Major Image creates a realistic illusion of an object or creature within a 20-foot cube.

table:2a09a5804e0323d17646834a7b565914d9.summary: The table lists the 'Level 7 Conjuration' spell, which requires 1 minute to cast, has a range of 300 feet, and necessitates verbal, somatic components, and a material component of a miniature door worth at least 15 GP.
prose_rows: The Level 7 Conjuration spell, available to Bards and Wizards, has a casting time of 1 minute, a range of 300 feet, and requires verbal, somatic components, and a material component consisting of a miniature door worth at least 15 gold pieces.

parent:25299e2694375eaaefa91c13b74652c1b.title: Basilisk Core Rules and Concepts
parent:25299e2694375eaaefa91c13b74652c1b.summary: The basilisk is a medium monstrosity with high AC and HP, capable of biting for piercing and poison damage, and using a petrifying gaze that can restrain or petrify creatures on failed saving throws.

parent:0b6ae1f5385efc30abbb4cd143c93e2c9.title: D&D Rulebook Snippet Summary
parent:0b6ae1f5385efc30abbb4cd143c93e2c9.summary: The Portable Hole is a lightweight extradimensional space that allows creatures to escape with a Strength check, and its interaction with similar items opens a one-way gate to the Astral Plane; various potions provide temporary magical effects, such as casting spells, gaining abilities, or altering physical form, each with unique visual characteristics.

parent:53fbd1db3f4eb2a312a6bafb4bb3706e1.title: Dust Mephit Core Rules and Concepts
parent:53fbd1db3f4eb2a312a6bafb4bb3706e1.summary: The Dust Mephit is a small, neutral evil elemental with vulnerabilities to fire, immunities to poison and exhaustion, and abilities including a death burst, claw attacks, blinding breath, and casting sleep, with a challenge rating of 1/2.

parent:dd68515e060553308a5816bf7c439dd3d.title: Lemure Core Rules and Concepts
parent:dd68515e060553308a5816bf7c439dd3d.summary: The Lemure is a Medium Fiend with cold resistance and immunities to fire, poison, charm, fright, and poison, possessing darkvision and understanding Infernal; it revives in the Nine Hells unless killed by a blessed creature or Holy Water, and attacks with Vile Slime causing poison damage.

parent:e7321c1596b3fb665ec1b2167b634e083.title: D&D Rulebook Snippet Summary
parent:e7321c1596b3fb665ec1b2167b634e083.summary: The snippet describes magical items including horseshoes that enhance speed and require a Magic action to remove, an immovable rod that can be fixed and moved with a Strength check, an instant fortress that transforms into a defensive tower, and Ioun Stones that orbit the user's head to confer benefits.

parent:dcc6666cebb8a11442a76fb8b40c01931.title: Solar Core Rules and Concepts
parent:dcc6666cebb8a11442a76fb8b40c01931.summary: The Solar is a large celestial being with high AC, HP, and initiative, possessing immunities and resistances, and abilities like Divine Awareness, Exalted Restoration, Legendary Resistance, and Magic Resistance; it can attack with a Flying Sword and Slaying Bow, cast spells, and use Divine Aid and Legendary Actions such as Blinding Gaze and Radiant Teleport.

parent:9a2d99e6ca02ba8284928dceaccc52469.title: Summary of D&D Illusion Spells
parent:9a2d99e6ca02ba8284928dceaccc52469.summary: The spells 'Phantasmal Image,' 'Phantasmal Killer,' and 'Phantom Steed' allow the caster to create illusions that affect targets' perceptions and actions, with 'Phantasmal Image' and 'Phantasmal Killer' causing targets to interact with and be harmed by illusions, while 'Phantom Steed' provides a quasi-real mount for the caster or an ally.

parent:8e903a39721b905da8645d9c3c360f594.title: Bulette Core Rules and Concepts
parent:8e903a39721b905da8645d9c3c360f594.summary: The Bulette is a large, unaligned monstrosity with high AC and HP, capable of burrowing and leaping to attack, dealing significant damage and potentially causing targets to fall prone or be pushed away.

parent:67f5705acbcd78e354c407a709f081816.title: Hippopotamus Core Rules and Concepts
parent:67f5705acbcd78e354c407a709f081816.summary: The hippopotamus is a large, unaligned beast with an AC of 14, initiative of -2, 82 HP, and speeds of 30 ft. on land and in water, capable of holding its breath for 10 minutes, making two bite attacks with each dealing 16 piercing damage, and having a passive perception of 13.

parent:5be5c93da2ba273a7f190ed8f5c7cb703.title: D&D Rulebook Snippet Summary
parent:5be5c93da2ba273a7f190ed8f5c7cb703.summary: Characters can regain Hit Points based on their Wisdom modifier, usable multiple times and replenished after a Long Rest; Monks gain Fleet Step to use Step of the Wind after a Bonus Action and Quivering Palm to set lethal vibrations in a target's body, causing significant damage when ended.

parent:b22a01df6005437001a717a1b0b3531a5.title: Core Rules and Concepts in D&D Rulebook Snippet
parent:b22a01df6005437001a717a1b0b3531a5.summary: In D&D, finding hidden objects requires a Wisdom (Perception) check, carrying capacity is generally flexible unless specified, fragile objects can be easily broken, hazards include more than just monsters, and travel pace affects distance and imposes game effects.

parent:c0345797facba813d5f45940fbd89fd14.title: Bearded Devil Core Rules and Concepts
parent:c0345797facba813d5f45940fbd89fd14.summary: The Bearded Devil is a Lawful Evil Medium Fiend with high AC and HP, resistant to cold, immune to fire and poison, and possessing darkvision and telepathy; it has magic resistance, attacks with a piercing, poison-inducing Beard, and a slashing, wound-inflicting Infernal Glaive.

parent:62a47f3f25df98e47dec8d6d7fd70eb1a.title: D&D Tools and Proficiency
parent:62a47f3f25df98e47dec8d6d7fd70eb1a.summary: Tools in D&D aid in ability checks and crafting, with proficiency enhancing checks and granting advantages; Artisan's Tools, each requiring separate proficiency, focus on crafting specific items and trades.

table:01186fd53ea6bc67b6bb21abbb63c64571.summary: The table lists 'Alchemist’s Supplies' as a tool priced at 50 GP, used for crafting and trade, requiring separate proficiency.
prose_rows: Alchemist’s Supplies, costing 50 GP, are tools focused on crafting items and pursuing a trade, requiring a separate proficiency.

table:92509acf819eb0a46cb4fc1c23796200e4.summary: The table lists items under 'Craft' and 'Brewer’s Supplies,' with the latter priced at 20 GP.
prose_rows: Crafting Acid requires a DC of 15.
Crafting Alchemist’s Fire requires a DC of 15.
Crafting a Component Pouch requires a DC of 15.
Crafting Oil requires a DC of 15.
Crafting Paper requires a DC of 15.
Crafting Perfume requires a DC of 15.
The total cost for Brewer’s Supplies is 20 GP.

table:ac3458a17d22f2372bb0dcd4512076c6ad.summary: The table outlines a character's intelligence weight, abilities to detect poison and identify alcohol with specific difficulty checks, crafting of antitoxin, and the cost of calligrapher's supplies.
prose_rows: The Intelligence ability weighs 9 lb.
It can be utilized to detect a poisoned drink with a DC of 15 or identify alcohol with a DC of 10.
This ability allows the crafting of an antitoxin.
It includes calligrapher’s supplies priced at 10 GP.

table:78519c73a5390af9947d674f9f556e5ba0.summary: The table lists Carpenter's Tools valued at 8 GP, with a forgery check DC of 15 for crafting ink or a spell scroll, referencing System Reference Document 5.2.
prose_rows: A skill check against forgery requires a DC of 15.
The craft involves using ink and a spell scroll.
This information is referenced in the System Reference Document, section 5.2.
Carpenter’s Tools are valued at 8 gold pieces.

table:b33e80ba5785ea8b6544a355eeca00c8e3.summary: The table describes the 'Strength' ability, its weight, its use for sealing or prying open objects, the items it can craft, and the cost of cartographer's tools.

Using Strength, you can craft items such as a Club, Greatclub, Quarterstaff, Barrel, Chest, Ladder, Pole, Portable Ram, and Torch.

parent:20671043b625381e1cdf8eda3cf465403.title: D&D Core Rules Summary
parent:20671043b625381e1cdf8eda3cf465403.summary: In D&D, players can choose to take actions like opening doors or lowering drawbridges, skip their turn, or end combat when one side is defeated; movement is based on Speed, affected by Difficult Terrain, and can be split across actions; creatures have defined sizes affecting their space on the map, and players can move around other creatures during their turn.

parent:58ccf8958967ca26482408549c0b8423d.title: Lich Core Rules and Concepts
parent:58ccf8958967ca26482408549c0b8423d.summary: A Lich is a powerful undead wizard with high AC, HP, and initiative, possessing resistances and immunities, the ability to reform from a spirit jar, and various attacks and spells, including legendary actions like 'Deathly Teleport' and 'Disrupt Life'.

parent:45f678ea8a0299671b9b1d82ee1c2248d.title: D&D Warlock Features and Rules
parent:45f678ea8a0299671b9b1d82ee1c2248d.summary: Warlocks can replace spells at each level, gain new spells at levels 13, 15, and 17, and regain Mystic Arcanum uses after a Long Rest; at level 19, they gain an Epic Boon feat, and at level 20, they regain Pact Magic spell slots with Magical Cunning; Eldritch Invocations provide various enhancements, such as increased damage, spellcasting without slots, and improved perception.

parent:cf3027a3f15d03c68895782a3bf7e1a66.title: D&D Magical Effects Summary
parent:cf3027a3f15d03c68895782a3bf7e1a66.summary: The rulebook snippet describes various magical items that orbit the user's head, each providing unique enhancements such as increased ability scores, spell cancellation, spell storage, and other benefits, with some items being very rare or legendary.

parent:c976ab0cf898daddf7fd259c92daf28b9.title: Specter Core Rules and Concepts
parent:c976ab0cf898daddf7fd259c92daf28b9.summary: The Specter is a Medium Undead with Chaotic Evil alignment, featuring resistances to various damage types, immunities to several conditions, and abilities like incorporeal movement and sunlight sensitivity, with its primary action being Life Drain, which deals necrotic damage and reduces a creature's hit point maximum.

parent:77291d30d20fa9a9b3c8f471b6426fe14.title: Giant Badger Core Rules and Concepts
parent:77291d30d20fa9a9b3c8f471b6426fe14.summary: The Giant Badger is a medium beast with an AC of 13, 15 HP, and a +3 Perception skill, resistant to poison, with darkvision and a bite attack dealing 6 piercing damage.

parent:c0e69cad6df4d3e408333b520e0c924fd.title: Centaur Trooper Core Rules
parent:c0e69cad6df4d3e408333b520e0c924fd.summary: The Centaur Trooper is a Large Fey, Neutral Good creature with an AC of 16, Initiative +2, 45 HP, and a speed of 50 ft., skilled in Athletics and Perception, equipped with a breastplate, longbow, and pike, and capable of multiattacks and a Trampling Charge.

parent:6a1e3d6ec74241a0cbd86111c0af6b906.title: D&D Spell Summary
parent:6a1e3d6ec74241a0cbd86111c0af6b906.summary: The spells 'Chill Touch,' 'Chromatic Orb,' 'Circle of Death,' 'Clairvoyance,' and 'Clone' involve casting actions with varying ranges and components, producing effects like damage, sensory perception, and cloning, with enhancements available through higher-level spell slots or cantrip upgrades.

parent:f91699efae4b66db51b9b0b2f068eb60b.title: D&D Spell Summary
parent:f91699efae4b66db51b9b0b2f068eb60b.summary: The snippet categorizes D&D spells into levels 3, 4, and 5, detailing their schools of magic and special properties, such as ritual, material, or concentration, with examples including 'Levitate' (Transmutation C) and 'Animate Dead' (Necromancy).

parent:92b8e817a63dfab94db8793ff37f84aab.title: D&D Mage Core Rules and Concepts
parent:92b8e817a63dfab94db8793ff37f84aab.summary: A Mage is a Medium or Small Humanoid with high AC and HP, skilled in Arcana and History, capable of casting spells like Detect Magic and Fireball, and can use Misty Step and Protective Magic as bonus actions and reactions.

parent:0629c1ff1c1007ae07a32ca6f37cc1859.title: D&D Rulebook Snippet Summary
parent:0629c1ff1c1007ae07a32ca6f37cc1859.summary: The Iron Flask is a legendary item that traps creatures from other planes, releasing them to obey commands for an hour; the Javelin of Lightning is an uncommon weapon that deals lightning damage or transforms into a lightning bolt, usable once per day; the Lantern of Revealing is an uncommon wondrous item that provides light and reveals invisible creatures, with adjustable brightness.

parent:62c024db2d08fad033be5f0d04e6752d8.title: D&D Rulebook Snippet Summary
parent:62c024db2d08fad033be5f0d04e6752d8.summary: The Swan Boat, Tree, and Whip are magical items with specific actions and durations, while Feather Tokens and Figurines of Wondrous Power transform into creatures or objects with defined behaviors and limitations.

parent:b712ac8a0acb2d7040d8d40256cf3a0d1.title: Sphinx of Wonder Core Rules and Concepts
parent:b712ac8a0acb2d7040d8d40256cf3a0d1.summary: The Sphinx of Wonder is a Tiny Celestial with Lawful Good alignment, featuring high AC and initiative, moderate HP, flight, skills in Arcana, Religion, and Stealth, resistances to Necrotic, Psychic, and Radiant damage, darkvision, and languages Celestial and Common; it has a CR of 1, Magic Resistance, a Rend attack dealing Slashing and Radiant damage, and a Burst of Ingenuity reaction to aid in ability checks or saving throws.

parent:245ef318f410d43b7a600f9f08700b8b0.title: Core Rules and Concepts from D&D Rulebook Snippet
parent:245ef318f410d43b7a600f9f08700b8b0.summary: The snippet details movement mechanics for mounting, AC and saving throw bonuses based on coverage, rules for ranged attacks including range limitations, controlling mounts with specific actions, falling off mounts, and underwater combat rules including weapon disadvantages and fire resistance.

parent:0f4286cf9ee58c491188d37402ac7608f.title: Giant Bat Core Rules and Concepts
parent:0f4286cf9ee58c491188d37402ac7608f.summary: The Giant Bat is a large, unaligned beast with AC 13, initiative +3, 22 HP, ground speed of 10 ft., fly speed of 60 ft., blindsight 120 ft., passive perception 11, no languages, CR 1/4, and a bite attack dealing 6 piercing damage.

parent:7071d9bfe987f9e26d06313b0babf2e28.title: Chain Devil Core Rules and Concepts
parent:7071d9bfe987f9e26d06313b0babf2e28.summary: The Chain Devil is a Lawful Evil fiend with high defenses and offensive capabilities, including chain attacks that grapple and restrain, conjured fiery chains for binding, and a gaze that can frighten opponents, along with the ability to regenerate in the Nine Hells and resist magical effects.

parent:190a34a76f8f3b0f80f1be819c51e21e8.title: Archmage Core Rules and Concepts
parent:190a34a76f8f3b0f80f1be819c51e21e8.summary: The Archmage is a medium or small humanoid with high AC, HP, and initiative, skilled in Arcana and History, immune to psychic effects and charmed when using Mind Blank, capable of casting a wide array of spells, and possessing actions like Arcane Burst, Misty Step, and Protective Magic, making it a versatile and resilient adversary.

parent:05850454291aa2027b4f7bbfd27d0e34b.title: D&D Rulebook Snippet Summary
parent:05850454291aa2027b4f7bbfd27d0e34b.summary: The 'Private Sanctum' spell creates a secure area with customizable barriers, 'Produce Flame' conjures a harmless, illuminating flame that can be hurled for damage, and 'Programmed Illusion' generates a triggered illusion of an object or creature within a specified range.
