parent:f1a2f37d6454b5d30c9097cfab0f2c11b.title: Life Domain Cleric Abilities in D&D
parent:f1a2f37d6454b5d30c9097cfab0f2c11b.summary: Clerics in the Life Domain gain enhanced healing abilities, including additional hit points from spells, a list of prepared spells at certain levels, and improved healing effects through divine actions and spells, culminating in supreme healing at level 17.

parent:8ac2ee322cc005d0a52c63dd478b435d5.title: D&D Statuette Transformations
parent:8ac2ee322cc005d0a52c63dd478b435d5.summary: The statuettes transform into creatures with specific abilities and limitations: Golden Lions become Lions for 1 hour with a 7-day cooldown, Ivory Goats transform into a Giant Goat with weapons or a Riding Horse with charges, Marble Elephant becomes an Elephant for 24 hours with a 7-day cooldown, Obsidian Steed becomes a Nightmare for 24 hours with a 5-day cooldown and a chance to transport to Hades, and Onyx Dog is not fully described.

parent:335c48374ca4260513bf54c0ccb506ad0.title: D&D Potions and Ring Summary
parent:335c48374ca4260513bf54c0ccb506ad0.summary: Potions of Healing vary in rarity and potency, restoring hit points; Potion of Heroism grants temporary hit points and a Bless effect; Potion of Invisibility makes the drinker invisible for an hour; Potion of Mind Reading allows thought detection; Potion of Poison causes damage and a poisoned condition; Potion of Resistance provides damage resistance; Potion of Speed grants haste without lethargy; Potion of Water Breathing allows underwater breathing; Ring of Animal Influence can cast specific spells affecting animals.

parent:12b0e1dddf46c451544c7a98116e0623b.title: Sphinx of Lore Core Rules and Concepts
parent:12b0e1dddf46c451544c7a98116e0623b.summary: The Sphinx of Lore is a large celestial creature with high AC, initiative, and HP, skilled in Arcana, History, and Religion, possessing truesight, resistances, and immunities, and capable of casting spells; it can avoid detection, choose to succeed on failed saves, and use actions like multiattacks, a mind-rending roar, teleportation, and aging targets.

parent:3952af0206442f2c8a84f4c123942701f.title: Giant Boar Core Rules and Concepts
parent:3952af0206442f2c8a84f4c123942701f.summary: The Giant Boar is a large, unaligned beast with a base AC of 13, initiative of +0, and 42 HP, moving at 40 ft. with a passive perception of 8 and no languages. It has a challenge rating of 2, granting 450 XP, and a proficiency bonus of +2. Its Bloodied Fury trait grants advantage on melee attacks when bloodied, and its Gore action deals 10 Piercing damage with a +5 attack bonus, plus an extra 7 damage and causes the target to become prone if it moved 20+ feet straight toward a Large or smaller target before hitting.

parent:963cd80e1d439cf1de85ab5f3b6d919c2.title: D&D Rulebook Snippet Summary
parent:963cd80e1d439cf1de85ab5f3b6d919c2.summary: At Level 3, players choose between 'Colossus Slayer' for extra damage to weakened foes and 'Horde Breaker' for additional attacks on nearby enemies; at Level 7, options include 'Escape the Horde' for reduced opportunity attack accuracy and 'Multiattack Defense' for disadvantage on subsequent attacks from a creature that hits; at Level 11, 'Superior Hunter’s Prey' allows extra damage to a nearby creature when marking a target; at Level 15, 'Superior Hunter’s Defense' provides resistance to damage of the same type for a turn.

parent:6d21dc22f98b624c6bca64e238a0ac404.title: Chimera Core Rules and Concepts
parent:6d21dc22f98b624c6bca64e238a0ac404.summary: The Chimera is a large, chaotic evil monstrosity with an Armor Class of 14, 114 hit points, and the ability to fly at 60 ft.; it can perform a multiattack with Ram, Bite, and Claw, or use Fire Breath, and has a Perception skill of +8, darkvision, and understands Draconic.

parent:98f395c32b21ebb824595e072cf78c4f8.title: D&D Planar Binding and Task Negotiation
parent:98f395c32b21ebb824595e072cf78c4f8.summary: In D&D, creatures can be bound to perform tasks ranging from simple to complex, with payments varying by task duration and danger level, and the 'Planar Binding' spell allowing binding of certain creatures for up to 366 days using higher-level spell slots.

table:56e542465ef4c892f50174e8cf0345269c.summary: The table lists a payment structure for tasks, with 100 GP per minute for minute-based tasks and 1,000 GP per hour for hour-based tasks.
prose_rows: Creatures might exchange their service for a quest undertaken by you.
A task that can be measured in minutes requires a payment worth 100 GP per minute.
A task measured in hours requires 1,000 GP per hour.

table:f2b8f9bf8287d9b43788e5086ff8668ed3.summary: The table lists the casting time, range, and components required for the 'Wizard' spell, which includes a verbal component, a somatic component, and a material component of a jewel worth at least 1,000 GP.
prose_rows: The Wizard's spell has a casting time of 1 hour, a range of 60 feet, and requires verbal, somatic, and material components, including a jewel worth at least 1,000 gold pieces.

parent:45bc20abb3e4cd5eb4d9c26a0a1d9ff65.title: Character Species in D&D
parent:45bc20abb3e4cd5eb4d9c26a0a1d9ff65.summary: In D&D, a character's species determines their creature type, size, speed, and special traits, with examples like Dragonborn having unique abilities such as Draconic Ancestry and a Breath Weapon, influencing their gameplay and role in the multiverse.

parent:cb28991c8f56019eafb31706f75bd3657.title: Core Rules for Character Creation in D&D
parent:cb28991c8f56019eafb31706f75bd3657.summary: To create a D&D character, choose a class with specific abilities, determine origin including background and species, decide on ability scores, select an alignment, and fill in character details, starting typically at level 1 with 0 XP, and noting any armor training.

parent:35fa3e0a1ff1cd6740749670b3348c792.title: D20 Tests in D&D Rulebook
parent:35fa3e0a1ff1cd6740749670b3348c792.summary: D20 Tests in D&D involve rolling a d20, adding relevant modifiers, and comparing the result to a target number to determine success or failure, with tests categorized as ability checks, saving throws, and attack rolls, each using specific modifiers and target numbers.

parent:157fc99e31318ca37ab98da5acbaf5ceb.title: Damage and Healing in D&D
parent:157fc99e31318ca37ab98da5acbaf5ceb.summary: In D&D, hit points measure a creature's durability, damage is calculated through rolls and modifiers, critical hits double damage dice, saving throws determine damage from effects, and resistance/vulnerability modify damage by halving or doubling it, respectively, with no stacking of multiple instances.

parent:0fd462dbf15f1cdde6f436257e3914da5.title: Red Dragon Wyrmling Core Rules
parent:0fd462dbf15f1cdde6f436257e3914da5.summary: A Red Dragon Wyrmling is a Medium-sized, Chaotic Evil dragon with an Armor Class of 17, Initiative of +2, 75 HP, and abilities including Multiattack, Rend, and Fire Breath, with immunities to fire and enhanced perception and stealth skills.

parent:fd7df15aa8099460019e2c3281a96e08e.title: D&D Spell Summary
parent:fd7df15aa8099460019e2c3281a96e08e.summary: The 'Illusory Duplicate' spell creates an intangible, damage-sensitive copy of the caster; 'Protection from Energy' grants resistance to a chosen damage type; 'Protection from Evil and Good' provides attack and condition advantages against specific creature types; 'Protection from Poison' offers resistance to poison and advantages on saving throws; 'Purify Food and Drink' removes poison and rot from consumables.

table:27ad6337a740c1ae744c0e493e3f018c8d.summary: The table lists the 'Level 5 Necromancy' spell, which requires 1 hour to cast, has a touch range, and necessitates verbal, somatic components, and a diamond worth at least 500 GP.
prose_rows: The level 5 Necromancy spell, available to Bards, Clerics, and Paladins, requires a casting time of 1 hour, has a range of touch, and necessitates components including a verbal component, a somatic component, and a material component of a diamond worth at least 500 gold pieces.

parent:247814f8ffb3756275ea4bfebf7752677.title: D&D Magic Items Summary
parent:247814f8ffb3756275ea4bfebf7752677.summary: The figurine allows casting _Animal Messenger_ in raven form, _Flame Tongue_ weapon engulfs in flames for extra fire damage, _Folding Boat_ transforms into boats with command words, _Frost Brand_ weapon deals cold damage and grants fire resistance, _Gauntlets of Ogre Power_ boost Strength, and _Gem of Brightness_ provides light and a light beam with charges.

table:bd169c93def552552156c53d85eefc566f.summary: The table outlines a magical gem's ability to emit intense light in a 30-foot cone, necessitating saving throws from creatures within, and its conversion to a nonmagical jewel worth 50 GP after all charges are used.
prose_rows: The gem causes intense light to flare in a 30-foot cone, requiring creatures within the cone to make a saving throw as if struck by a beam created with the second command word.
When all of the gem’s charges are expended, it becomes a nonmagical jewel worth 50 gold pieces.

parent:05f208d2eb5d52aa694c01f72443d8913.title: D&D Rings of Djinni Summoning: Core Rules and Concepts
parent:05f208d2eb5d52aa694c01f72443d8913.summary: The 'Ring of Elemental Command' provides advantages against Elementals, compulsion abilities, elemental resistances, and spellcasting based on its linked Elemental Plane, while the 'Ring of Evasion' allows a reaction to mitigate failed Dexterity saving throws by expending charges.

parent:690de52b9cfe182e780260522473b8607.title: Sphinx of Valor Core Rules and Concepts
parent:690de52b9cfe182e780260522473b8607.summary: The Sphinx of Valor is a large celestial creature with high defensive and offensive capabilities, including resistances, immunities, and powerful attacks like multiattacks and roars with varying effects, along with spellcasting and legendary actions that enhance its combat prowess.

parent:35105e3e3d68057675b5ebdce6e9d002d.title: Core Rules and Concepts of the Warlock Class in D&D
parent:35105e3e3d68057675b5ebdce6e9d002d.summary: Warlocks in D&D rely on Charisma for spellcasting, gain hit points with a D8 die, have saving throws in Wisdom and Charisma, and are proficient with simple weapons and light armor; they start with specific equipment choices and gain features like Eldritch Invocations, Pact Magic, and Ability Score Improvement as they level up, with additional subclass features and Mystic Arcana spells at higher levels.

table:afeee1743256d28d72e9202baa76d5a59c.summary: The table lists two starting equipment options for a character: Option A with specific items and 15 GP, or Option B with 100 GP.
prose_rows: Option A for starting equipment includes leather armor, a sickle, two daggers, an arcane focus (orb), a book on occult lore, a scholar’s pack, and 15 gold pieces.
Option B for starting equipment provides 100 gold pieces.

table:c570388993b4cc398b7052b36f0679312f.summary: The table lists the progression of a Warlock's abilities and features, including proficiency bonus, spell slots, and special abilities, from level 1 to level 20 in a role-playing game.
prose_rows: At level 1, a Warlock has a +2 proficiency bonus, gains Eldritch Invocations and Pact Magic, can prepare 1 cantrip, 2 spells, and has 2 spell slots at level 1.
At level 2, a Warlock has a +2 proficiency bonus, gains Magical Cunning, can prepare 3 cantrips, 2 spells, and has 2 spell slots at level 1.
At level 3, a Warlock has a +2 proficiency bonus, gains a Warlock Subclass, can prepare 3 cantrips, 2 spells, and has 2 spell slots at level 2.
At level 4, a Warlock has a +2 proficiency bonus, gains Ability Score Improvement, can prepare 3 cantrips, 3 spells, and has 2 spell slots at level 2.
At level 5, a Warlock has a +3 proficiency bonus, can prepare 5 cantrips, 3 spells, and has 2 spell slots at level 3.
At level 6, a Warlock has a +3 proficiency bonus, gains a Subclass feature, can prepare 5 cantrips, 3 spells, and has 2 spell slots at level 3.
At level 7, a Warlock has a +3 proficiency bonus, can prepare 6 cantrips, 3 spells, and has 2 spell slots at level 4.
At level 8, a Warlock has a +3 proficiency bonus, gains Ability Score Improvement, can prepare 6 cantrips, 3 spells, and has 2 spell slots at level 4.
At level 9, a Warlock has a +4 proficiency bonus, gains Contact Patron, can prepare 7 cantrips, 3 spells, and has 2 spell slots at level 5.
At level 10, a Warlock has a +4 proficiency bonus, gains a Subclass feature, can prepare 7 cantrips, 4 spells, and has 2 spell slots at level 5.
At level 11, a Warlock has a +4 proficiency bonus, gains Mystic Arcanum (level 6 spell), can prepare 7 cantrips, 4 spells, and has 3 spell slots at level 5.
At level 12, a Warlock has a +4 proficiency bonus, gains Ability Score Improvement, can prepare 8 cantrips, 4 spells, and has 3 spell slots at level 5.
At level 13, a Warlock has a +5 proficiency bonus, gains Mystic Arcanum (level 7 spell), can prepare 8 cantrips, 4 spells, and has 3 spell slots at level 5.
At level 14, a Warlock has a +5 proficiency bonus, gains a Subclass feature, can prepare 8 cantrips, 4 spells, and has 3 spell slots at level 5.
At level 15, a Warlock has a +5 proficiency bonus, gains Mystic Arcanum (level 8 spell), can prepare 9 cantrips, 4 spells, and has 3 spell slots at level 5.
At level 16, a Warlock has a +5 proficiency bonus, gains Ability Score Improvement, can prepare 9 cantrips, 4 spells, and has 3 spell slots at level 5.
At level 17, a Warlock has a +6 proficiency bonus, gains Mystic Arcanum (level 9 spell), can prepare 9 cantrips, 4 spells, and has 4 spell slots at level 5.
At level 18, a Warlock has a +6 proficiency bonus, can prepare 10 cantrips, 4 spells, and has 4 spell slots at level 5.
At level 19, a Warlock has a +6 proficiency bonus, gains Epic Boon, can prepare 10 cantrips, 4 spells, and has 4 spell slots at level 5.
At level 20, a Warlock has a +6 proficiency bonus, gains Eldritch Master, can prepare 10 cantrips, 4 spells, and has 4 spell slots at level 5.

parent:f08d69f004a95b8f876924811dc4a84ef.title: Giant Centipede Core Rules
parent:f08d69f004a95b8f876924811dc4a84ef.summary: The Giant Centipede is a small, unaligned beast with AC 14, 9 HP, and a +2 initiative, capable of moving and climbing at 30 ft., with blindsight up to 30 ft., and a passive perception of 8; it bites for 4 piercing damage and poisons the target until its next turn.

parent:7b9f75047a9fba18aa981de023fec4528.title: Chuul Summary
parent:7b9f75047a9fba18aa981de023fec4528.summary: The Chuul is a large, chaotic evil aberration with amphibious abilities, immunity to poison, and the power to sense magic, capable of grappling and poisoning targets with its pincers and tentacles.

parent:0b5521568ca49f422875ebcc759e9bc2e.title: D&D Rulebook Snippet Summary
parent:0b5521568ca49f422875ebcc759e9bc2e.summary: The 'Armor of Vulnerability' grants resistance to one damage type but curses the wearer, causing vulnerability to two others; the 'Arrow-Catching Shield' enhances Armor Class against ranged attacks and allows attack redirection; the 'Bag of Beans' contains explosive beans and can produce random effects when planted and watered.

parent:eb59c0077c01bedd09694df2f002527af.title: D&D Spell Summary
parent:eb59c0077c01bedd09694df2f002527af.summary: 'Plant Growth' can overgrow or enrich plants, 'Poison Spray' deals poison damage with increasing damage at higher levels, and 'Polymorph' transforms a creature into a Beast, altering its stats but retaining core attributes, ending if temporary hit points are depleted.

parent:2add90ce3b7145f30d70b274844097669.title: D&D Rulebook Spell Summary
parent:2add90ce3b7145f30d70b274844097669.summary: The unnamed spell creates a fire sphere causing damage to creatures within range, which can be moved and manipulated; 'Flesh to Stone' attempts to petrify a target, with increased petrification upon repeated failures; 'Floating Disk' conjures a force plane that can hold weight and follow the caster within a certain distance.

parent:836496f05f45eb47c434095e495b24c4a.title: Roc Core Rules and Concepts
parent:836496f05f45eb47c434095e495b24c4a.summary: The Roc is a gargantuan, unaligned monstrosity with high AC, initiative, and HP, capable of flying and possessing strong melee attacks, including a multiattack with beak and talons that can grapple and restrain smaller creatures, and a swoop action to drop grappled creatures from a height.

parent:ad682eddb72f585b9a85860939edbf1a5.title: D&D Druid Wild Shape Rules
parent:ad682eddb72f585b9a85860939edbf1a5.summary: Druids can shape-shift into beasts, gaining temporary hit points equal to their level, adopting the beast's stats while retaining certain abilities, and handling objects based on the new form's limbs; they can't cast spells while shape-shifted, and specific abilities like summoning a familiar and improving ability scores are gained at levels 2, 3, and 4, respectively.

parent:746090e58644c78ab1f56c84c114505d6.title: D&D Bard Spells Overview
parent:746090e58644c78ab1f56c84c114505d6.summary: The D&D rulebook snippet details Bard spells organized by level, highlighting their magical schools and special attributes, showcasing the Bard's diverse magical capabilities.

parent:6800d2f3399f8de37efd8f3db5a0a9952.title: Young Red Dragon Core Rules and Concepts
parent:6800d2f3399f8de37efd8f3db5a0a9952.summary: A Young Red Dragon is a Large, Chaotic Evil Chromatic Dragon with an AC of 18, initiative of +4, 178 HP, speeds of 40 ft. on ground and 80 ft. flying, skills in Perception and Stealth, immunity to fire, blindsight and darkvision, and can speak Common and Draconic, using Multiattack, Rend, and Fire Breath actions.

parent:6610a0239ba64360e63a6cd969ee210ef.title: D&D Rulebook Snippet on Traps
parent:6610a0239ba64360e63a6cd969ee210ef.summary: Traps in D&D should be used sparingly to maintain their charm, with the best being fleeting distractions or puzzles that require skill and teamwork, and they include components like severity, trigger, and duration, with examples like the Collapsing Roof trap.

parent:baba970534c139e02e1c4cac821cc2b28.title: D&D Rings and Their Abilities
parent:baba970534c139e02e1c4cac821cc2b28.summary: The rings described include the 'Ring of Jumping' for self-targeted 'Jump' casting, 'Ring of Mind Shielding' for mind protection and soul communication, 'Ring of Protection' for defensive bonuses, 'Ring of Regeneration' for healing and regrowth, 'Ring of Resistance' for damage resistance, and 'Ring of Shooting Stars' for casting light spells and creating lightning spheres.

parent:60a524e721b5bafdfe31675e1e13d7ffe.title: Night Hag Core Rules and Concepts
parent:60a524e721b5bafdfe31675e1e13d7ffe.summary: The Night Hag is a Medium Fiend with high AC, initiative, and HP, skilled in deception and stealth, immune to charm, resistant to cold and fire, and can cast specific spells within a coven; it has a soul bag for trapping souls and can shape-shift between humanoid forms.

parent:08aca1a1276ce9b330dad10c8636e2254.title: Giant Constrictor Snake Core Rules
parent:08aca1a1276ce9b330dad10c8636e2254.summary: The Giant Constrictor Snake, a large unaligned beast, has an Armor Class of 12, 60 hit points, and can move at 30 ft. on land and swim at the same speed, using its bite and constrict abilities to attack, with the constrict ability potentially grappling and damaging opponents who fail a strength saving throw.

parent:35fcd2edaed09b9ae01d120c348755b6c.title: D&D Rulebook Snippet Summary
parent:35fcd2edaed09b9ae01d120c348755b6c.summary: The snippet describes magical events and items, including toads transforming into monsters, a Bulette attack, a temporary fruit tree with potion-like fruit, rainbow-colored eggs with potential benefits or harm, a pyramid with a mummy, a giant beanstalk leading to various destinations, and two types of bags: a Bag of Holding for storage and a Bag of Devouring that poses a danger to living creatures.

parent:336a9db54ccd208f21a3ce6659c57f1ea.title: Summary of D&D Rulebook Snippet
parent:336a9db54ccd208f21a3ce6659c57f1ea.summary: Fog Cloud creates an expanding fog that obscures vision, Forbiddance establishes a magical barrier preventing teleportation and planar travel while damaging specific creature types, and Forcecage conjures an immobile, invisible cage or box to trap creatures within a designated area.

table:a6cb47682d16a9808ac26fc95d48b992e9.summary: The table lists the 'Level 6 Abjuration' spell for clerics, detailing its casting time, range, and components, including a ritual option and a material component of ruby dust worth at least 1,000 GP.
prose_rows: The Level 6 Abjuration spell, available to Clerics, has a casting time of 10 minutes or can be cast as a ritual, requires touch range, and involves verbal, somatic components, and a material component consisting of ruby dust worth at least 1,000 gold pieces.

table:807e76db89e72480ed2568e728659d261d.summary: The table lists a Level 7 Evocation spell with an action casting time, a range of 100 feet, and components including verbal, somatic, and material (ruby dust worth at least 1,500 GP).
prose_rows: The spell 'Level 7 Evocation' can be cast by Bards, Warlocks, or Wizards, requires an action to cast, has a range of 100 feet, and necessitates verbal, somatic components, and a material component consisting of ruby dust worth at least 1,500 gold pieces.

parent:df1291ee5cfce3fa8ef75eb752eb9ee26.title: Roper Core Rules and Concepts
parent:df1291ee5cfce3fa8ef75eb752eb9ee26.summary: The Roper is a large, neutral evil aberration with high AC and initiative, capable of climbing difficult surfaces without checks, and uses multiattacks involving tentacles that can grapple and poison targets, and a bite attack, with a reel action to pull grappled creatures closer.

parent:3b41856286a9b8cc50f44d0435f095fbc.title: D&D Rulebook Index of Creatures
parent:3b41856286a9b8cc50f44d0435f095fbc.summary: The index lists various creatures and entities from a D&D rulebook, including dragons, elementals, dinosaurs, and other fantasy beings, with corresponding page numbers for detailed information.

parent:405bc43c2dbe691b70af50f61c2aa38d0.title: Guard Captain Summary
parent:405bc43c2dbe691b70af50f61c2aa38d0.summary: The Guard Captain is a versatile combatant with high AC and initiative, skilled in Athletics, equipped with a breastplate, javelins, a longsword, and a shield, capable of both melee and ranged attacks, providing 1,100 XP at CR 4.

parent:db1d7a110daddda75b79ae77907055396.title: Adult Red Dragon Core Rules and Concepts
parent:db1d7a110daddda75b79ae77907055396.summary: The Adult Red Dragon is a formidable, evil creature with high AC, initiative, and HP, capable of flying, climbing, and possessing strong perception and stealth skills, immune to fire, with blindsight and darkvision, and can communicate in Common and Draconic; it has a high challenge rating, can resist failed saving throws, attack with rend and fire breath, cast spells like Command, Detect Magic, and Fireball, and perform legendary actions such as Commanding Presence, Fiery Rays, and Pounce.

parent:40a8684d35a6cb2caebc311cead6df916.title: D&D Monk Progression Summary
parent:40a8684d35a6cb2caebc311cead6df916.summary: Monks gain enhanced unarmed combat abilities, improved evasion, acrobatic movement, focus point benefits, condition removal, attack deflection, saving throw proficiency, and physical and mental enhancements as they progress through levels 6 to 20.

parent:d8e4e94152dcb1d149d15e3f51beb346c.title: D&D Trap Mechanics
parent:d8e4e94152dcb1d149d15e3f51beb346c.summary: The rules describe how to detect and disarm traps using specific checks, set traps with tools and skills, and scale traps for higher levels by increasing damage and area of effect.

parent:ee2f1e83445f3581e74d30740809ae60f.title: Nightmare
parent:ee2f1e83445f3581e74d30740809ae60f.summary: The Nightmare is a large fiend with fire immunity, the ability to confer fire resistance to its rider, emit light, attack with fire-infused hooves, and teleport itself and up to three willing creatures to the Ethereal Plane.

parent:1126c9784e7e5b89c57ed5c4f8aeb508f.title: Core Rules and Concepts of D&D
parent:1126c9784e7e5b89c57ed5c4f8aeb508f.summary: The D&D rulebook snippet details gameplay mechanics including rhythm of play, abilities, various rolls (D20, ability checks, saving throws, attack rolls), combat order, movement, damage, healing, character creation, and class information.

parent:a0bf6d7f7f31616fbd6b852c9dcb1ae23.title: Giant Crab Core Rules and Concepts
parent:a0bf6d7f7f31616fbd6b852c9dcb1ae23.summary: The Giant Crab is an amphibious medium beast with AC 15, +1 initiative, 13 HP, and speeds of 30 ft. on land and in water, possessing a Stealth skill of +3, blindsight, and a CR of 1/8; it attacks with a claw that deals 4 bludgeoning damage and can grapple smaller creatures.

parent:cf4bd2ffe8fe3bf869bd98349670e7e6d.title: D&D Wondrous Items Summary
parent:cf4bd2ffe8fe3bf869bd98349670e7e6d.summary: The Bag of Tricks summons creatures based on its color, the Bead of Force deals damage and traps creatures, and the Belt of Dwarvenkind grants language knowledge, interaction advantage with dwarves, and increased toughness.

parent:2cd24d8b6e18a8017f11191cfb6f6d944.title: Rust Monster Core Rules and Concepts
parent:2cd24d8b6e18a8017f11191cfb6f6d944.summary: The Rust Monster is a medium monstrosity with AC 14, initiative +1, and 33 HP, capable of detecting ferrous metal within 30 feet, biting for 5 piercing damage, using antennae to impose penalties on nonmagical metal objects, and destroying metal objects it touches, with a reflexive reaction to use antennae when hit.

parent:9b69631209cd30bc2741e053d8a971cab.title: Spirit Naga Core Rules and Concepts
parent:9b69631209cd30bc2741e053d8a971cab.summary: The Spirit Naga is a large, chaotic evil fiend with high AC and HP, immune to poison and charm, possessing darkvision and passive perception, and can resurrect in 1d6 days unless stopped by a Wish spell; it attacks with Bite and Necrotic Ray, and can cast spells like Detect Magic and Mage Hand at will, with others like Detect Thoughts and Lightning Bolt twice a day.

parent:5ab3b978bf0d4b6cf63de4851dac34301.title: D&D Creature Index
parent:5ab3b978bf0d4b6cf63de4851dac34301.summary: The snippet provides a list of creatures from a Dungeons & Dragons rulebook, each associated with a specific page number for detailed information.

parent:43a48fbc68b0c1c3db2777e8e46df38dd.title: Half-Dragon Core Rules and Concepts
parent:43a48fbc68b0c1c3db2777e8e46df38dd.summary: A Half-Dragon is a Medium Dragon with an Armor Class of 18, Initiative of +5, 105 HP, 40 ft. speed, skills in Athletics, Perception, and Stealth, resistances to a GM-chosen damage type, blindsight and darkvision, Common and Draconic languages, and abilities including Multiattack, Claw, Dragon’s Breath, and Leap, with a Challenge Rating of 5.

parent:9fe2e807f92084ffc59649cfb0513bff1.title: Ancient Red Dragon Summary
parent:9fe2e807f92084ffc59649cfb0513bff1.summary: The Ancient Red Dragon is a gargantuan, chaotic evil creature with high AC, initiative, and HP, possessing immunities to fire, advanced perception and stealth skills, and the ability to cast powerful spells, breathe fire, and use legendary actions, making it a formidable opponent with a high challenge rating.

parent:11ce930e834d3638d762f3252899a943f.title: D&D Trap Mechanics
parent:11ce930e834d3638d762f3252899a943f.summary: The 'Poisoned Darts' trap activates on pressure plates, causing darts to shoot, and can be detected and disarmed with Wisdom and Dexterity checks, scaling in damage at higher levels; the 'Poisoned Needle' trap activates when a lock is improperly opened, causing a needle to stab, and can be avoided with magic or detected and disarmed with Wisdom and Dexterity checks, scaling in damage and save DC at higher levels.

parent:9b622346e91c87935cf5aeca5f02b63ca.title: D&D Noble Character Summary
parent:9b622346e91c87935cf5aeca5f02b63ca.summary: The Noble is a Medium or Small Humanoid with a neutral alignment, AC 15, initiative +1, 9 HP, speed 30 ft., skilled in Deception, Insight, and Persuasion, equipped with a breastplate and rapier, speaking Common and two other languages, with a passive perception of 12, CR 1/8, capable of a melee attack with its rapier dealing 5 piercing damage, and a Parry reaction that adds 2 to its AC against a melee attack while holding a weapon.

parent:d969de2b1f5c787d994fe9605059f76b1.title: Doppelganger Core Rules and Concepts
parent:d969de2b1f5c787d994fe9605059f76b1.summary: The Doppelganger is a medium monstrosity with high AC and initiative, capable of making two Slam attacks, using Unsettling Visage to frighten opponents, reading thoughts with a Detect Thoughts spell, and shape-shifting into different humanoid forms while retaining its equipment and most stats.

parent:d52478d7835b504054324588f3092c417.title: D&D Rulebook Creature Index
parent:d52478d7835b504054324588f3092c417.summary: The snippet provides a list of creatures and entities from a D&D rulebook, each linked to a specific page number for detailed rules or descriptions.

parent:13d385c80dbb3b05c5fe29992cd900c00.title: Sahuagin Warrior Core Rules and Concepts
parent:13d385c80dbb3b05c5fe29992cd900c00.summary: The Sahuagin Warrior is a Medium Fiend with Lawful Evil alignment, possessing an Armor Class of 12, 22 Hit Points, and speeds of 30 ft. on land and 40 ft. in water, with a Perception skill of +5. It resists Acid and Cold damage, has Darkvision up to 120 ft., and speaks Sahuagin. Its Challenge Rating is 1/2, granting 100 XP with a proficiency bonus of +2. Key traits include Blood Frenzy, Limited Amphibiousness, and Shark Telepathy. Its actions include a Multiattack with two Claw attacks and a Bonus Action Aquatic Charge.

parent:00a0172851bb9eb8889b29d35de48e4c6.title: Sprite Core Rules and Concepts
parent:00a0172851bb9eb8889b29d35de48e4c6.summary: The Sprite is a Tiny Fey creature with Neutral Good alignment, notable for its high AC, initiative, and skills in Perception and Stealth, capable of melee and ranged attacks, discerning emotions and alignment, and casting Invisibility on itself.

parent:a403f27e6cf53927dc042a1afb0be2ca4.title: Harpy Core Rules and Concepts
parent:a403f27e6cf53927dc042a1afb0be2ca4.summary: The Harpy is a Medium Monstrosity with Chaotic Evil alignment, capable of claw attacks and a Luring Song that charms and incapacitates targets within a 300-foot range, compelling them to move towards it unless they succeed on a Wisdom saving throw.

parent:657342b7c7eb724174cb229e198742fd7.title: Remorhaz Core Rules and Concepts
parent:657342b7c7eb724174cb229e198742fd7.summary: The Remorhaz is a large, unaligned monstrosity with high AC and HP, immunities to cold and fire, a heat aura causing fire damage, a bite attack that can grapple and restrain, and a swallow ability that inflicts damage and conditions on swallowed creatures, with the potential to regurgitate them if it takes significant damage or dies.

parent:cd97a085efe6cc47af55ecbd57b59ae71.title: D&D Trinket Descriptions
parent:cd97a085efe6cc47af55ecbd57b59ae71.summary: The snippet describes a variety of unique trinkets, each with distinct and often mysterious characteristics, such as musical fragments, painted eggshells, mechanical devices, and enchanted items, showcasing the imaginative nature of items in Dungeons & Dragons.

parent:de4192d2cd40e54e7b21c875049ab77b9.title: Crafting Nonmagical Items in D&D
parent:de4192d2cd40e54e7b21c875049ab77b9.summary: To craft a nonmagical item in D&D, you need the appropriate tools and proficiency, raw materials worth half the item's purchase cost, and a calculated amount of time based on the item's cost, with the possibility of reducing time through collaboration.

table:314dc1919b32c5e277967eb7727cddbb1e.summary: The table lists the requirement that raw materials needed to craft an item are worth half its purchase cost, rounded down, with an example given for Plate Armor.
prose_rows: To craft an item, you need raw materials worth half its purchase cost, rounded down. For instance, to make Plate Armor, which sells for 1,500 GP, you need 750 GP worth of raw materials. The GM determines the specifics.

table:8fae217a3badc8ce6af036d6e0d3aa1f5c.summary: The table outlines a method to calculate the number of working days needed to craft an item by dividing its purchase cost in GP by 10 and rounding up any fractional days.
prose_rows: To determine the number of days needed to craft an item, divide its purchase cost in gold pieces by 10 and round up any fraction to the nearest whole number; for instance, crafting a Heavy Crossbow, which costs 50 gold pieces, takes 5 days.

parent:b0a2f5f4a29d77b56909bd724f41426f9.title: D&D Spell Rules Summary
parent:b0a2f5f4a29d77b56909bd724f41426f9.summary: The spells 'Cloudkill' creates a poisonous fog causing damage, 'Color Spray' blinds creatures with colorful light, 'Command' forces a creature to follow a one-word order, and 'Commune' allows yes/no questions to a deity, with higher-level slots enhancing 'Cloudkill' and 'Command.'

parent:a5af93e4ed33000467b6188f1b0cbbbb4.title: Ochre Jelly Core Rules
parent:a5af93e4ed33000467b6188f1b0cbbbb4.summary: The Ochre Jelly is an unaligned, large ooze with resistances to acid and immunities to various conditions, capable of squeezing through tight spaces and climbing without checks, and can split into smaller jellies when damaged or bloodied.

parent:25a0d0bbec0a08890109617e7623ad60a.title: Core Rules and Concepts for Dwarves, Elves, and Gnomes in D&D
parent:25a0d0bbec0a08890109617e7623ad60a.summary: Dwarves possess darkvision, poison resistance, increased hit points, and tremorsense on stone; Elves have darkvision, lineage-based supernatural abilities, and can replace cantrips, while Gnomes, though not fully detailed, share the humanoid classification with unique traits.

parent:c9dcc60616a2aab5bf5b0b2840dbb6aa7.title: Dragon Turtle Core Rules and Concepts
parent:c9dcc60616a2aab5bf5b0b2840dbb6aa7.summary: The Dragon Turtle is a gargantuan, neutral dragon with high AC, initiative, and HP, capable of swimming and breathing both air and water, resistant to fire, and using multiattacks including bites and tail attacks, with a steam breath attack that deals significant fire damage unaffected by water resistance.

parent:019e3f04e3cd82cc4c8ad25cdc17853cf.title: D&D Spell Mechanics Summary
parent:019e3f04e3cd82cc4c8ad25cdc17853cf.summary: Fabricate transforms raw materials into objects of the same material within range, Faerie Fire outlines objects and creatures for visibility and attack advantage, Faithful Hound conjures an invisible, intangible watchdog that attacks nearby enemies, and False Life grants temporary hit points, with higher spell slots increasing the amount.

parent:949cca89550297cd3b38c0bd680bef6e8.title: Salamander Core Rules and Concepts
parent:949cca89550297cd3b38c0bd680bef6e8.summary: The salamander is a large, neutral evil elemental with vulnerabilities to cold and immunities to fire, capable of damaging nearby creatures with a fire aura, and attacking with a flame spear or constricting opponents to inflict both physical and fire damage.

parent:8077ae3ddb8b8b3604b1be387ce6bfe3c.title: Priest Character Summary
parent:8077ae3ddb8b8b3604b1be387ce6bfe3c.summary: The Priest is a Medium or Small Humanoid with AC 13, 38 HP, and skills in Medicine, Perception, and Religion, capable of melee and ranged attacks with a Mace and Radiant Flame, and can cast spells like Light and Thaumaturgy at will, with additional spells like Spirit Guardians and Divine Aid available at limited frequencies.

parent:560f8f8fcb1cd0b22f53e0a365f13d48f.title: D&D Spy Character Class Summary
parent:560f8f8fcb1cd0b22f53e0a365f13d48f.summary: The Spy is a Medium or Small Humanoid with AC 12, initiative +4, 27 HP, speed of 30 ft., skills in Deception, Insight, Investigation, Perception, Sleight of Hand, and Stealth, equipped with a hand crossbow, shortsword, and thieves' tools, capable of poison damage attacks and a bonus cunning action.

parent:ca7fe6756d472f56baa023e73d13fac1d.title: Hell Hound Core Rules and Concepts
parent:ca7fe6756d472f56baa023e73d13fac1d.summary: The Hell Hound is a Medium Fiend with Lawful Evil alignment, featuring high AC, initiative, and HP, fire immunity, darkvision, and understanding of Infernal; it benefits from Pack Tactics, can make two Bite attacks with piercing and fire damage, and uses Fire Breath that requires a Dexterity saving throw.

parent:f4dc9c72ae173ca335efaa96089ef4418.title: Adult White Dragon Core Rules and Concepts
parent:f4dc9c72ae173ca335efaa96089ef4418.summary: The Adult White Dragon is a large, chaotic evil chromatic dragon with high AC, initiative, and HP, capable of moving swiftly on various terrains, including icy surfaces without penalty, and possesses strong perception and stealth skills, immunity to cold, and can communicate in Common and Draconic, with powerful combat abilities including multiattacks with Rend, a chilling breath attack, and legendary actions like Freezing Burst and Frightful Presence.

parent:3ad7745b1fc683de5f28868d81e2e976e.title: Otherworldly Steed and Related Spells
parent:3ad7745b1fc683de5f28868d81e2e976e.summary: The 'Otherworldly Steed' is a magical mount with alignment-based abilities, including combat actions and special actions like 'Fell Glare,' 'Fey Step,' and 'Healing Touch,' while 'Find the Path' and 'Find Traps' are spells that aid in navigation and trap detection, each with specific casting requirements and limitations.

table:3dcd984985e469fc5e2ff77188a10d16b6.summary: The spell requires a 1-minute casting time, affects only the caster, and needs verbal, somatic components, and divination tools worth at least 100 GP.
prose_rows: The spell has a casting time of 1 minute, a range of self, and requires verbal, somatic, and material components, including a set of divination tools worth at least 100 GP.

parent:4599f06e61e0576f8535b342b02427064.title: D&D Spell Summary
parent:4599f06e61e0576f8535b342b02427064.summary: The snippet describes spells that disintegrate objects, provide advantages against certain creatures, dispel magic, cause creatures to flee, and enable divination, each with specific casting requirements and enhanced effects when using higher-level spell slots.

table:7d8cea0942d7be3e16b3756d8b510d5fd6.summary: The table lists a Level 4 Divination spell for Clerics, Druids, and Wizards, with an action or ritual casting time, self range, and components including verbal, somatic components, and incense worth at least 25 GP.
prose_rows: The Level 4 Divination spell, available to Clerics, Druids, and Wizards, has a casting time of Action or Ritual, a range of Self, and requires verbal, somatic, and material components, including incense worth at least 25 gold pieces.

parent:4786ac9f137883c204bdb68842154b8a8.title: D&D Spell Mechanics Summary
parent:4786ac9f137883c204bdb68842154b8a8.summary: The snippet outlines spells including 'Levitate' for floating objects, 'Light' for illumination, 'Lightning Bolt' for lightning damage, and divination spells 'Locate Animals or Plants' and 'Locate Creature' for finding specific creatures or plants within set distances.

parent:a2109a01d58622cc338200b71f92aa60d.title: Dretch Summary
parent:a2109a01d58622cc338200b71f92aa60d.summary: The Dretch is a small fiend with resistances to cold, fire, and lightning, immunities to poison, and a daily ability that poisons creatures within a 10-foot emanation, limiting their actions, with a challenge rating of 1/4.

parent:f324f9f6ff59ff7c1c1820a22d2c63cd9.title: Ogre
parent:f324f9f6ff59ff7c1c1820a22d2c63cd9.summary: An Ogre is a Large Giant with Chaotic Evil alignment, possessing an armor class of 11, initiative of -1, 68 hit points, a speed of 40 ft., equipped with a Greatclub and Javelins, having darkvision, passive perception of 8, and speaking Common and Giant, with a challenge rating of 2, capable of melee attacks with a Greatclub and ranged or melee attacks with Javelins.

parent:bd6ffeeca830d4a966130dd008c97cee5.title: D&D Rulebook Snippet Summary
parent:bd6ffeeca830d4a966130dd008c97cee5.summary: The 'Slow Fall' spell reduces the descent speed of falling creatures to 60 feet per round for one minute, preventing fall damage if they land before the spell ends, while 'Find Familiar' allows a caster to summon a spirit familiar in animal form, providing telepathic communication, special senses, and the ability to deliver touch spells, with the familiar acting independently in combat and disappearing when reduced to 0 Hit Points.

table:61737f7bf71ccf8b3bb24a2faf6b0ca02b.summary: The table lists the casting time, range, and components required for the 'Level 1 Conjuration' spell for Wizards.
prose_rows: The level 1 Conjuration spell for a Wizard has a casting time of 1 hour or can be cast as a ritual, requires a range of 10 feet, and needs verbal, somatic components, and a material component consisting of burning incense worth at least 10 gold pieces.

parent:ca63edf9453d9d9457d58fbb97fb6ab23.title: D&D Rulebook Snippet Summary
parent:ca63edf9453d9d9457d58fbb97fb6ab23.summary: The 'Wish' spell in D&D allows for powerful effects but carries risks of partial fulfillment, unforeseen consequences, and significant stress on the caster, potentially leading to damage and inability to cast the spell again, while 'Word of Recall' and 'Zone of Truth' provide teleportation and truth enforcement respectively.

parent:cc1ce971d52fc75cbebbf5118b8cf5425.title: Pseudodragon Core Rules and Concepts
parent:cc1ce971d52fc75cbebbf5118b8cf5425.summary: The pseudodragon is a tiny, neutral good dragon with magic resistance, capable of making two bite attacks or using a sting that can poison and potentially unconscious a target, with blindsight, darkvision, and skills in Perception and Stealth.

parent:0866057d9e965158308590312f5d17485.title: Stirge Core Rules and Concepts
parent:0866057d9e965158308590312f5d17485.summary: The Stirge is a tiny, unaligned monstrosity that attacks with its proboscis, dealing piercing damage and attaching to the target, which then suffers necrotic damage at the start of each of the Stirge's turns, and can be detached by spending movement or by a nearby creature.

parent:1f6e40eeadc878f2407e2d2afc66962e5.title: Hezrou Core Rules and Concepts
parent:1f6e40eeadc878f2407e2d2afc66962e5.summary: The Hezrou is a large, evil demon with high AC, initiative, and HP, resistant to cold, fire, and lightning, immune to poison, and capable of demonic restoration, magic resistance, and emitting a poisonous stench; it attacks with rending claws and can leap long distances.

parent:92fdc699c1baf828271199887ec8970f8.title: Character Creation in D&D
parent:92fdc699c1baf828271199887ec8970f8.summary: In D&D character creation, players can choose any format—printed, digital, or plain paper—to record their character's details, ensuring flexibility in tracking information.

parent:b16f4013c6b6ae544691aa52cd5dac66b.title: Ancient White Dragon Core Rules and Concepts
parent:b16f4013c6b6ae544691aa52cd5dac66b.summary: The Ancient White Dragon is a Gargantuan, Chaotic Evil dragon with high AC, HP, and initiative, capable of flying, burrowing, and swimming, immune to cold, and possessing blindsight and darkvision; it speaks Common and Draconic, has a high challenge rating, and features traits like Ice Walk and Legendary Resistance, with actions including Multiattack, Rend, Cold Breath, and Legendary Actions such as Freezing Burst, Frightful Presence, and Pounce.

parent:b83be98f367adaabcdd2f6171294795e0.title: D&D Spell Mechanics Summary
parent:b83be98f367adaabcdd2f6171294795e0.summary: The spells Wall of Fire, Wall of Force, and Wall of Ice create barriers with specific effects and damage, with damage increasing when cast using higher-level spell slots.

parent:956c5a769c4a61f8e9d21df03adf4e325.title: D&D Spell Mechanics Summary
parent:956c5a769c4a61f8e9d21df03adf4e325.summary: The spells Fire Bolt, Fire Shield, and Fire Storm involve casting fire-based attacks with varying damage outputs and effects, where damage increases with higher-level spell slots, and certain spells provide additional resistances or trigger effects upon specific conditions.

parent:b91a371da628415ecf5c43f3731ed100e.title: D&D Spell Summary
parent:b91a371da628415ecf5c43f3731ed100e.summary: Divine Smite allows Paladins to deal extra radiant damage, increasing with higher spell slots and against fiends or undead; Divine Word forces creatures to save or suffer effects based on hit points, potentially banishing certain creatures; Dominate Beast charms a beast to follow commands, with duration extendable by higher-level spell slots.

parent:1f52543fef0652fe379466f64227e0f5e.title: D&D Spell Summary
parent:1f52543fef0652fe379466f64227e0f5e.summary: Longstrider increases a creature's speed, Mage Armor boosts a creature's AC, Mage Hand manipulates objects, and Magic Circle creates a protective or restrictive area affecting specific creature types.

table:f315274569e42336c5f0ad927e51b0ed23.summary: The table lists a spell's casting time of 1 minute, range of 10 feet, and components including verbal, somatic, and material (salt and powdered silver worth 100+ GP, consumed).
prose_rows: The spell has a casting time of 1 minute, a range of 10 feet, and requires verbal, somatic components, and material components consisting of salt and powdered silver worth 100+ GP, which are consumed by the spell.

table:6e2f83b3a3705a072bf853efeba720050b.summary: The table lists a spell with a casting time of 1 minute, a range of self, and components including verbal, somatic, and a material component worth 500+ GP.
prose_rows: The spell has a casting time of 1 minute, a range of self, and requires verbal, somatic, and material components, including a gem, crystal, or reliquary worth 500+ GP.

parent:009f49383391731d127fb19010a72e705.title: Drider Core Rules and Concepts
parent:009f49383391731d127fb19010a72e705.summary: The Drider is a large, evil monstrosity with high AC and HP, skilled in climbing and stealth, capable of navigating webs, but disadvantaged in sunlight; it attacks with a foreleg and poison burst, and can cast specific spells as a bonus action.

parent:33f9f5914cce4269784dba82eacf18f4b.title: Fear and Mental Stress in D&D
parent:33f9f5914cce4269784dba82eacf18f4b.summary: Adventurers in D&D are less susceptible to fear and mental stress than common folk, but certain creatures and effects can still terrify or mentally strain them, requiring Wisdom saving throws for fear effects and Psychic damage for mental stress, with potential prolonged conditions like Frightened, Incapacitated, or Stunned.

parent:1484d1e863ac5ad5aa740d39af60bb01c.title: D&D Rulebook Glossary Conventions
parent:1484d1e863ac5ad5aa740d39af60bb01c.summary: The glossary uses tags to categorize rules, refers to 'you' as the applicable creature or object, includes cross-references, excludes obsolete terms, and defines specific abbreviations like Attack, Dash, and Disengage.

parent:eab594716c6dc6a365460e437311ed619.title: Purple Worm Core Rules and Concepts
parent:eab594716c6dc6a365460e437311ed619.summary: The Purple Worm is a gargantuan monstrosity with high AC and HP, capable of burrowing, blindsight, and tremorsense, and can attack with a bite that grapples and restrains, and a tail stinger that deals piercing and poison damage, while also being able to swallow up to three creatures, causing them acid damage and potentially regurgitating them if the worm takes significant damage.

parent:c427287bf3030a6e0391ed67b981932d6.title: Stone Giant Core Rules
parent:c427287bf3030a6e0391ed67b981932d6.summary: The Stone Giant, a Huge Neutral Giant with 126 HP, uses a combination of Stone Club and Boulder attacks, can deflect missiles to reduce damage, and can make smaller creatures prone with its Boulder attack.

parent:a20a9b82c116af5573b92b78dfeba480d.title: Wight Core Rules and Concepts
parent:a20a9b82c116af5573b92b78dfeba480d.summary: A Wight is a Medium Undead with AC 14, 82 HP, and a +4 initiative, resistant to Necrotic damage and immune to Poison and Exhaustion, using a Necrotic Sword or Bow for attacks and Life Drain to control up to twelve Zombies, while suffering disadvantages in sunlight.

parent:f9f6ae1b79beba4824b5deb19310e7e82.title: D&D Spells Summary
parent:f9f6ae1b79beba4824b5deb19310e7e82.summary: The 'Wall of Stone' spell creates a solid stone wall that can be shaped and supports itself on existing stone, dealing damage to creatures caught within, while 'Wall of Thorns' conjures a thorny barrier that inflicts piercing damage on creatures within its area and slows movement through it.

table:8911e1e2cc0ac0b8cb14e3915a971bc00c.summary: The table lists the mechanics of a spell or ritual, specifying its casting time as an action, range as touch, and components as verbal, somatic, and material (two platinum rings worth 50+ GP each, worn by both the caster and target).
prose_rows: The casting time for this ability is an action.
The range of this ability is touch.

The components required for this ability include verbal (V), somatic (S), and material (M) components, which consist of a pair of platinum rings worth 50+ GP each that must be worn by both the caster and the target.

parent:19bdc3c7289120bcc435949fc7831d021.title: D&D Bard Class Features Summary
parent:19bdc3c7289120bcc435949fc7831d021.summary: As Bards level up, their Bardic Inspiration die increases from a d6 to a d12, they learn and replace cantrips, gain more spell slots, prepare a growing list of spells, and gain expertise in skills, with Charisma as their spellcasting ability and Musical Instruments as their focus.

parent:0cbb78a210fb8428e2615cddfc874cbaa.title: Druid Character Summary
parent:0cbb78a210fb8428e2615cddfc874cbaa.summary: The Druid is a Medium or Small Humanoid with a base AC of 13, 44 HP, and a speed of 30 ft., skilled in Medicine, Nature, and Perception, equipped with Studded Leather Armor, and capable of multiattacks with Vine Staff and Verdant Wisp, casting spells like Druidcraft and Speak with Animals at will, and Entangle and Thunderwave twice per day, with Animal Messenger, Longstrider, and Moonbeam available once per day.

parent:2c63a4028d611ca561047739ba1d76d06.title: Clay Golem Core Rules and Concepts
parent:2c63a4028d611ca561047739ba1d76d06.summary: The Clay Golem is a large, unaligned construct with high AC and HP, resistant to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing, and immune to acid, poison, psychic, and several conditions; it has darkvision, speaks Common and one other language, and features traits like Acid Absorption, Berserk, Immutable Form, and Magic Resistance, with actions including Multiattack and Slam, and a bonus action Hasten.

parent:59bb8dda9f561f2d99b8c06d09a494042.title: D&D Spell Descriptions
parent:59bb8dda9f561f2d99b8c06d09a494042.summary: Simulacrum creates a construct copy of a creature that obeys commands and lasts until it takes damage, Sleep incapacitates creatures with a Wisdom save, and Sleet Storm creates hazardous weather causing creatures to lose concentration if they fail a Dexterity save.

table:7318fd2c783fd3f625466d13780d3fe7eb.summary: The table lists a level 7 illusion spell for wizards, with a 12-hour casting time, touch range, and components including verbal, somatic components, and a powdered ruby worth at least 1,500 GP.
prose_rows: The Level 7 Illusion spell for Wizards has a casting time of 12 hours, a range of touch, and requires verbal, somatic, and material components, including powdered ruby worth at least 1,500 gold pieces.

table:71230820f19f12fbbe3f3eafa14caf0519.summary: The table outlines the process for restoring a simulacrum's Hit Points, requiring a Long Rest, spending 100 GP per Hit Point, and keeping the simulacrum within 5 feet of the user.
prose_rows: If a simulacrum takes damage, its Hit Points can only be restored by repairing it during a Long Rest, which requires components worth 100 GP per Hit Point restored, and the simulacrum must remain within 5 feet of you during this process.

parent:5bff4bffd65d6c01e1837051bb351e4f2.title: D&D Poison Rules Summary
parent:5bff4bffd65d6c01e1837051bb351e4f2.summary: In D&D, poisons are categorized into contact, ingested, inhaled, and injury types, each with specific methods of application and effects, and can be acquired through illicit means or harvested from creatures, with detailed rules governing their use and consequences.

table:6785e13ec9e5ec0684929776fccf3f2e5e.summary: The table lists poisons alphabetically, detailing their suggested price per dose, type, and effects, exemplified by 'Assassin’s Blood' priced at 150 GP.
prose_rows: Assassin’s Blood is a contact poison priced at 150 GP, known for its debilitating effects.

table:d97595917d02a112efe799ee4b2477bfe1.summary: Burnt Othur Fumes inflict 6 (1d12) Poison damage and a 24-hour Poisoned condition on a creature, with damage halved on a successful save.
prose_rows: The creature takes 6 (1d12) poison damage and is poisoned for 24 hours, but if it makes a successful saving throw, it only takes half the damage.

table:751f65e978c158ed720c91d5e6e6c02774.summary: The table lists a magical item, 'Crawler Mucus,' costing 200 GP, which requires a saving throw each turn, inflicting 3 (1d6) poison damage on failure, ending after three successful saves.
prose_rows: The Crawler Mucus, costing 200 GP, causes a creature to take 3 (1d6) poison damage at the start of each turn until a successful save is made, with each failed save resulting in additional poison damage, and the poison ends after three successful saves.

table:c38b3b067d966c7d56261b1405ada15806.summary: The table lists the 'Essence of Ether,' a magical item costing 300 GP, which allows a creature to repeat a saving throw at the end of each turn, ending the effect on a successful save.
prose_rows: The creature must make a save at the end of each turn, and if successful, the effect ends on itself. This ability is associated with the 'Essence of Ether,' which costs 300 GP.

table:7a4374cc10a9bf45ac63c298645189b343.summary: The table lists a condition named 'Unconscious' that can be caused by poisoning, requiring damage or external action to wake the creature, and mentions 'Malice' valued at 250 GP.
prose_rows: The creature is both Unconscious and Poisoned, and it will wake up if it takes damage or if another creature shakes it awake. This condition is associated with the item 'Malice,' which is valued at 250 GP.

parent:1f48e0fc38f642cbce6506bff001f9c4e.title: D&D Spell Summary
parent:1f48e0fc38f642cbce6506bff001f9c4e.summary: Befuddlement inflicts psychic damage and prevents spellcasting on a failed save, Bestow Curse imposes various disadvantages or extra damage on a target, and Black Tentacles creates difficult terrain with restraining and damaging effects on creatures within its area.

table:48620715bfbaa41d51e3c21e7ef7eefd02.summary: The table lists a spell with an action casting time, a 30-foot range, reference number 113 from the System Reference Document 5.2, and components including verbal, somatic, and a holy symbol worth at least 5 gold pieces.
prose_rows: The casting time for the spell is an action.
The spell has a range of 30 feet.
This information is referenced in the System Reference Document 5.2, page 113.
The components required to cast the spell include verbal (V), somatic (S), and material (M) components, specifically a Holy Symbol worth 5 or more gold pieces (GP).

parent:8bd36a0a9ffc59c30f0408e01a4b7c58b.title: D&D Rulebook Snippet Summary
parent:8bd36a0a9ffc59c30f0408e01a4b7c58b.summary: The snippet describes the 'Fast Wrestler' rule for moving grappled creatures, Fighting Style Feats that enhance combat capabilities, and Epic Boon Feats providing significant benefits like ability score increases and unique combat abilities at level 19+.

parent:0fc33aba60fd776aa61553543fbbb0b84.title: Quasit Core Rules and Concepts
parent:0fc33aba60fd776aa61553543fbbb0b84.summary: The Quasit is a Tiny Fiend with Chaotic Evil alignment, featuring high AC, initiative, and HP, along with resistances to cold, fire, and lightning, and immunities to poison; it can stealth, see in the dark, and speak Abyssal and Common, with abilities including magic resistance, rending attacks, invisibility, scaring creatures, and shape-shifting into a bat, centipede, or toad.

parent:5f9451d4ad8a4e1579de7cf1b2197ddd5.title: Stone Golem Core Rules and Concepts
parent:5f9451d4ad8a4e1579de7cf1b2197ddd5.summary: The Stone Golem is a Large Construct with high AC, HP, and initiative, immune to various conditions, and has darkvision; it understands multiple languages but cannot speak, has a CR of 10, cannot shape-shift, has advantage on saving throws against magic, can perform multiattacks with Slam and Force Bolt, and can cast Slow as a bonus action.

parent:8943b7e79710c2f540f5016e48c98f7c8.title: Will-o’-Wisp Core Rules and Concepts
parent:8943b7e79710c2f540f5016e48c98f7c8.summary: The Will-o’-Wisp is a Tiny Undead with high AC and initiative, flying and resistant to multiple damage types, immune to several conditions, and possessing darkvision; it emits light, moves through objects with potential damage, attacks with lightning, can consume life to regain health, and can vanish to become invisible.

parent:d0b8f31a626a9cd0ff0dd2201daa454bc.title: D&D Spell Summary
parent:d0b8f31a626a9cd0ff0dd2201daa454bc.summary: 'Aura of Life' grants resistance to necrotic damage and healing within a 30-foot radius, 'Awaken' gives intelligence and speech to certain creatures or plants, and 'Bane' imposes penalties on attack rolls and saving throws for creatures that fail a saving throw.

table:4f93b359871077e645d11ce232f7461fdd.summary: The table lists the 'Level 5 Transmutation' spell for Bard and Druid, detailing its 8-hour casting time, touch range, and components including verbal, somatic components, and a costly agate worth over 1,000 GP.
prose_rows: The Level 5 Transmutation spell, available to Bards and Druids, requires 8 hours to cast, has a touch range, and necessitates verbal, somatic components, and a material component consisting of an agate worth at least 1,000 gold pieces.

parent:9e002a869433ab77b75144f00ce8433a2.title: D&D Rogue Subclass Features Summary
parent:9e002a869433ab77b75144f00ce8433a2.summary: The snippet describes a Rogue subclass with abilities enhancing evasion, stealth, and magic item use, including features like 'Obscure' causing blindness, 'Slippery Mind' for saving throw proficiency, 'Elusive' preventing attack advantage, 'Epic Boon' for a feat, and 'Stroke of Luck' for turning failed rolls into successes, alongside Thief-specific skills for agility, lockpicking, climbing, and magic item interaction.

parent:93ce66e5bca556ec22be2c151f4ddd651.title: D&D Rulebook Snippet Summary
parent:93ce66e5bca556ec22be2c151f4ddd651.summary: The mist can pass through spaces but not liquids, is resistant to all damage except sunlight, and the vampire can use three legendary actions per turn, including 'Beguile' to cast Command and 'Deathless Strike' to make a Grave Strike attack.

parent:8fbb4fdd1395aad595764dee78b8c144e.title: D&D Rulebook Snippet Summary
parent:8fbb4fdd1395aad595764dee78b8c144e.summary: The snippet describes spells that manipulate elements, enhance abilities, alter sizes, and restrain creatures, each with specific casting requirements, effects, and conditions.

parent:1f57f7179c201e12b88e3ead88c95d584.title: D&D Equipment: Coins
parent:1f57f7179c201e12b88e3ead88c95d584.summary: In D&D, characters earn and spend coins of different denominations, with values relative to the Gold Piece, and fifty coins weigh a pound.

table:c50af5a833638b9221849b94af9e8a98ff.summary: The table lists various coins and their values in gold pieces, with Copper Piece valued at 1/100 GP, Silver Piece at 1/10 GP, Electrum Piece at 1/2 GP, and Gold Piece at 1 GP.
prose_rows: Coins weigh a pound.
A Copper Piece (CP) is valued at 1/100 of a gold piece.
A Silver Piece (SP) is valued at 1/10 of a gold piece.
An Electrum Piece (EP) is valued at 1/2 of a gold piece.
A Gold Piece (GP) is valued at 1 gold piece.

parent:0a1ec418475c6d663cf3388a1cf71eefa.title: D&D Core Rules and Concepts
parent:0a1ec418475c6d663cf3388a1cf71eefa.summary: The snippet describes D&D conditions, area effects, D20 tests, and damage mechanics, detailing how conditions affect characters, how area effects spread, the role of D20 tests, and the types and thresholds of damage.

parent:deeb5280a4febeb696d4e76733f117638.title: Cloaker Summary
parent:deeb5280a4febeb696d4e76733f117638.summary: The Cloaker is a large, chaotic neutral aberration with AC 14, HP 91, and a speed of 10 ft. and fly 40 ft., possessing light sensitivity, immunity to frightened, and skills in stealth; it attacks with multiattack, attach (causing blindness and damage sharing), and tail attacks, can use 'Moan' to frighten creatures, and casts 'Mirror Image' with 'Phantasms', all while being vulnerable in bright light.

parent:2500ae47a6a8a4d33f2a72a5aa8554482.title: D&D Rulebook Spell Summary
parent:2500ae47a6a8a4d33f2a72a5aa8554482.summary: Sorcerous Burst is a sorcerer cantrip causing damage with potential extra dice, Spare the Dying stabilizes dying creatures with increasing range, Speak with Animals allows communication with beasts for information, Speak with Dead animates corpses for limited questioning, and Speak with Plants enables communication with plants.

parent:c7aeae99f5b777cdf4d0ddd09a020e048.title: Summary of D&D Poison Effects
parent:c7aeae99f5b777cdf4d0ddd09a020e048.summary: The poisons in the D&D rulebook snippet impose the Poisoned condition with varying durations and additional effects, requiring Constitution saving throws of different DCs, and some also cause conditions like Unconscious or Blinded, with specific triggers for recovery.

table:54a18ae69a57447b0f30b56c912dc63bd0.summary: Midnight Tears is a condition costing 1,500 GP that causes a creature to be poisoned for an hour and blinded unless it succeeds on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw.
prose_rows: A creature subjected to Malice must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or become poisoned for 1 hour and blinded while poisoned. This effect is associated with the item Midnight Tears, valued at 1,500 GP.

table:199a078d9442bf357edf160ce5eb1f13c2.summary: The table outlines the consequences of a failed or successful saving throw against poison damage and provides the price of Oil of Taggit.
prose_rows: When exposed to Oil of Taggit, which costs 400 GP, a character takes 31 (9d6) poison damage on a failed saving throw or half as much damage on a successful one.

table:d89ab4199775de2aaaf1678389e4b4023d.summary: The 'Pale Tincture' is a 250 GP item that poisons a creature for 24 hours, causing unconsciousness unless the creature takes damage, which wakes it up.
prose_rows: The Pale Tincture, costing 250 GP, causes a creature to be poisoned for 24 hours and remain unconscious during this time, waking up only if it takes damage.

table:7250c0d893120ec9f48cce7d4f39d2e53f.summary: The table outlines the Purple Worm Poison effect, costing 2,000 GP, which requires seven successful saves for a creature to no longer be poisoned.
prose_rows: The Purple Worm Poison, costing 2,000 GP, affects a creature by keeping it poisoned until it makes seven successful saves against the poison.

table:040303f393e10268ff34c815a013f05349.summary: The table lists the effects of Purple Worm Poison, requiring a DC 21 Constitution saving throw, causing 35 (10d6) Poison damage on a failed save or half on a successful one, valued at 200 GP.
prose_rows: A creature subjected to Purple Worm Poison must make a DC 21 Constitution saving throw, taking 35 (10d6) Poison damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one, and the Serpent Venom costs 200 GP.

table:1d2b4d678a831341b9dfce389d76edd583.summary: Spider’s Sting is a magical item worth 200 GP that deals 10 to 30 poison damage on a failed save or half that amount on a successful save.
prose_rows: The Spider’s Sting, priced at 200 GP, inflicts 10 poison damage on a failed save or 5 damage on a successful one.

table:5d6781b4339b5f287876a3428517c830d4.summary: The table lists a condition named 'Torpor' costing 600 GP, causing creatures to be unconscious and poisoned, waking only upon taking damage or being shaken awake.
prose_rows: If a creature saves by 5 or more, it becomes unconscious while poisoned, and it will wake up if it takes damage or if another creature shakes it awake. This condition is known as Torpor and has a game price of 600 GP.

table:add017ac348d44ecff5d727e620df068a2.summary: The table lists a 'Poisoned' condition that lasts for a variable duration (4d6 hours) and halves a creature's speed, along with a 'Truth Serum' item priced at 150 GP.
prose_rows: The Poisoned condition lasts for 4d6 hours, during which the creature's speed is halved, and it is associated with the item Truth Serum, which costs 150 GP.

table:a137c865f936833b243b58e5358724c477.summary: Wyvern Poison causes a creature to be unable to lie for 1 hour if it fails a DC 11 Constitution saving throw, resulting in the Poisoned condition.
prose_rows: A creature affected by Wyvern Poison, valued at 1,200 GP, must pass a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or suffer from the Poisoned condition for 1 hour, during which it cannot knowingly communicate a lie.

parent:e234049fef7e95e962dea1820d4067477.title: D&D Sorcerer Core Rules and Concepts
parent:e234049fef7e95e962dea1820d4067477.summary: Sorcerers prepare a list of spells matching their level, use Charisma for spellcasting, and can use an Arcane Focus; they gain benefits from Innate Sorcery and manage Sorcery Points for spell slot conversion and creation, with features like Metamagic enhancing their spellcasting.

parent:2b47c3235f8a266b343cf52be46f17bd8.title: Rakshasa Core Rules and Concepts
parent:2b47c3235f8a266b343cf52be46f17bd8.summary: The Rakshasa is a Lawful Evil Medium Fiend with high AC, initiative, and HP, vulnerable to piercing damage from blessed weapons, immune to charm and fright, and possessing truesight and spellcasting abilities; it resists spells, revives in the Nine Hells, and can curse and command enemies.

parent:165eb290662d1649cb1b75331ce951b74.title: D&D Rulebook Snippet Summary
parent:165eb290662d1649cb1b75331ce951b74.summary: The snippet outlines the costs for food, drink, and lodging, explains how to identify and attune to magic items, and details the limitations on attunement, including the maximum number of items one can be attuned to simultaneously.

parent:3fe55f6bdc8d1ce487050a33454dd5650.title: Winter Wolf Core Rules and Concepts
parent:3fe55f6bdc8d1ce487050a33454dd5650.summary: The Winter Wolf is a large, neutral evil monstrosity with high AC, initiative, and HP, possessing immunities to cold, skills in perception and stealth, and abilities like pack tactics, biting attacks, and cold breath, which can cause significant damage.

parent:8ec0197e85a694a01ca685275f06dbaa0.title: Core Rules and Concepts from D&D Rulebook Snippet
parent:8ec0197e85a694a01ca685275f06dbaa0.summary: In D&D, a character's movement can be doubled by dashing, using special speeds like Fly or Swim, and movement in difficult terrain costs extra; a dead creature can only be revived by specific spells, and conditions like being deafened prevent hearing, while dehydration causes exhaustion that requires full water intake to resolve; difficult terrain includes obstacles like creatures, furniture, and slopes, affecting movement cost.

parent:ba6934a31614433d7d28a8bf9b99c65c6.title: Cloud Giant Core Rules and Concepts
parent:ba6934a31614433d7d28a8bf9b99c65c6.summary: The Cloud Giant is a large, neutral-aligned creature with high hit points, capable of melee and ranged attacks with thunder damage, and can cast spells like 'Fog Cloud' and 'Misty Step' using Charisma, with skills in Insight and Perception and the ability to fly.

parent:5f70b6b0143f5b90e07ad11c42073daf0.title: Core Rules and Concepts for Human, Orc, and Tiefling Races in D&D
parent:5f70b6b0143f5b90e07ad11c42073daf0.summary: Humans gain inspiration and skill proficiency, Orcs can dash and survive at 1 HP with darkvision, and Tieflings have darkvision, a supernatural legacy with spellcasting abilities, and an otherworldly presence.

parent:da24385d123c5dd4ad5aa127eebae4509.title: Core Rules on Damage, Healing, and 0 Hit Points in D&D
parent:da24385d123c5dd4ad5aa127eebae4509.summary: In D&D, immunity to a damage type prevents damage of that type, healing restores Hit Points up to a maximum, reaching 0 Hit Points can result in death or unconsciousness with subsequent Death Saving Throws, and stabilization can temporarily halt these throws.

parent:7ce36349cea377d47fc7a0d3edcb48436.summary: The snippet explains that creatures gain Exhaustion from suffocation, are surprised if unawares at combat start, face extra movement costs while swimming unless they have Swim Speed, and can use Telepathy to communicate mentally within range, with specific conditions for initiation and termination; it also describes Teleportation as instant magical transportation that moves the user and their equipment without provoking attacks, and briefly mentions Temporary Hit Points.

parent:dfc986c21233eb8de45de63138f0f7f43.title: Ancient Brass Dragon Core Rules and Concepts
parent:dfc986c21233eb8de45de63138f0f7f43.summary: The Ancient Brass Dragon is a Gargantuan, Chaotic Good dragon with high AC, initiative, and HP, capable of flying, burrowing, and possessing skills in history, perception, persuasion, and stealth, immune to fire, with blindsight and darkvision, speaking Common and Draconic, and a CR of 20, using legendary resistance, multiattack with rend and breath weapons, and casting spells using charisma, with legendary actions including blazing light, pounce, and scorching sands.

parent:38e60b4fb63d964febe1ec4ad24b6d58c.title: Worg Core Rules and Concepts
parent:38e60b4fb63d964febe1ec4ad24b6d58c.summary: A Worg is a Large Fey creature with Neutral Evil alignment, possessing a bite attack that deals piercing damage and grants advantage on the next attack against the target before its next turn, with a base attack bonus of +5, a reach of 5 ft., and a damage output of 7 (1d8 + 3).

parent:35798d31a61bd2f09d618f6a599d82572.summary: Creatures must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw to avoid gaining Exhaustion from insufficient food, with additional levels of Exhaustion accruing after five days without food, and rules for Opportunity Attacks, conditions like Paralyzed, and definitions for game terms such as Monster and Nonplayer Character.

table:51dd3b3db74478fe299e251c0ae1e68695.summary: The table outlines a condition requiring a Dexterity saving throw or becoming prone upon first entry into an area, with a 10-minute recovery time for Ball Bearings, and notes a Barrel valued at 2 GP.

A Basket, costing 4 SP, can hold up to 40 pounds within 2 cubic feet.

table:c3f514c5568bb43285e88ae3d1f804e3fb.summary: The table describes a Bell (1 GP) that allows automatic success on saving throws against extreme cold when in a Bedroll.

table:142e2ec6d3db7d77f50420654ccaa83fbb.summary: The table describes a Block and Tackle that multiplies lifting capacity by four and costs 25 GP.

table:77b6d12aba6c38f53d067ba2d35437fa11.summary: The table lists items such as a glass bottle, a bucket, and a burglar's pack, detailing their capacities and prices.

table:0c59e722464f0d5d47e414e579c951ed4c.summary: The table lists various items such as a backpack, ball bearings, bell, candles, crowbar, hooded lantern, flasks of oil, rations, rope, tinderbox, waterskin, and caltrops priced at 1 GP.

table:821f2fae30bce234ea2ecd4e33e94aae0d.summary: The table outlines that an opponent must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw to avoid taking 1 Piercing damage and having their Speed reduced to 0 until their next turn when encountering Caltrops, with a 10-minute recovery period for the ability.

table:6c3b80afb8e543175b63463929b61a7d36.summary: A Map or Scroll Case can hold up to 10 sheets of paper or 5 sheets of parchment and costs 5 gold pieces.

parent:b7fff1d8c1b8a9451c05782d87da5721f.title: Spellcasting Services Overview
parent:b7fff1d8c1b8a9451c05782d87da5721f.summary: Spellcasting services are available in villages, towns, and cities, with costs ranging from 30 GP for cantrips to 100,000 GP for level 9 spells, and availability decreasing with higher spell levels.

table:b69bceaf19fbde14a2b6dcd33366fbf375.summary: The table lists spellcasting services by spell level, indicating their availability in different locations and the corresponding cost, with higher spell levels being more expensive and less widely available.
