Level 1 spells can be cast by spellcasters in a village, town, or city for a cost of 50 GP.
Level 2 spells can be cast by spellcasters in a village, town, or city for a cost of 200 GP.
Level 3 spells can be cast by spellcasters in a town or city for a cost of 300 GP.
Level 4 to 5 spells can be cast by spellcasters in a town or city for a cost of 2,000 GP.
Level 6 to 8 spells can be cast by spellcasters in a city for a cost of 20,000 GP.
Level 9 spells can be cast by spellcasters in a city for a cost of 100,000 GP.

parent:e53c557f12a982983ffacd6c8a6e35f01.title: Young Bronze Dragon Summary
parent:e53c557f12a982983ffacd6c8a6e35f01.summary: The Young Bronze Dragon is a large, lawful good metallic dragon with AC 17, initiative +3, 142 HP, and speeds of 40 ft. on land, 80 ft. flying, and 40 ft. swimming; it has skills in Insight, Perception, and Stealth, is immune to lightning, senses with blindsight and darkvision, speaks Common and Draconic, and has a CR of 8; it can breathe air and water, attack with Rend and Lightning Breath, and use Repulsion Breath to push and prone enemies.

parent:de8a978488aed59930b231ea72c986d2a.title: D&D Fighter Class Core Rules and Concepts
parent:de8a978488aed59930b231ea72c986d2a.summary: The Fighter class gains abilities like Tactical Mind, Extra Attack, and Indomitable at various levels, with the Champion subclass offering specialized features, and Second Wind providing tactical advantages, all enhancing combat effectiveness.

parent:c68599948b42f26a27f49fddb214a526f.title: Core Rules and Concepts in D&D
parent:c68599948b42f26a27f49fddb214a526f.summary: In D&D, players use ability checks to overcome challenges, manage actions on their turns, and navigate a game world defined by alignment, allies, and areas of effect, all while adhering to rules involving ability scores, modifiers, and various game mechanics.

parent:a50a53a11a8d188ac70c0a8b040e4ed11.title: Aboleth Core Rules and Concepts
parent:a50a53a11a8d188ac70c0a8b040e4ed11.summary: The Aboleth is a large, lawfully evil aberration with high AC and HP, capable of breathing air and water, and possessing telepathic abilities; it can regenerate after death, resist saving throws, and inflict a curse through its mucus cloud, with attacks including tentacle strikes and mind control abilities, enhanced by legendary actions.

parent:d33185d69a2b7338c2660bd198ea945ac.title: Ankheg Core Rules and Concepts
parent:d33185d69a2b7338c2660bd198ea945ac.summary: The Ankheg is a large, unaligned monstrosity with a high AC and HP, capable of burrowing through rock, biting with acid damage and grappling, and using an acid spray attack that requires a Dexterity saving throw.

parent:6a26a8190e8c8a5035751e8fa29f9a899.title: D&D Ranger Progression and Spell List
parent:6a26a8190e8c8a5035751e8fa29f9a899.summary: At level 13, Rangers gain unbreakable concentration on Hunter's Mark; level 14 allows them to become invisible; level 17 grants attack advantage on marked creatures; level 18 provides blindsight; level 19 offers an Epic Boon feat; and level 20 increases Hunter's Mark damage to a d10, alongside a detailed spell list organized by level and special requirements.

parent:b2fb788a8277b6a30dc732fb2a50081c6.title: Water Elemental Summary
parent:b2fb788a8277b6a30dc732fb2a50081c6.summary: The Water Elemental is a large, neutral creature with AC 14, 114 HP, and resistances to acid and fire, possessing immunities to various conditions, and can freeze targets with cold damage, move through narrow spaces, and grapple opponents with its Whelm ability.

parent:f7b8c1a9072b44b03bd2d680b54412769.title: Plesiosaurus Core Rules and Concepts
parent:f7b8c1a9072b44b03bd2d680b54412769.summary: The Plesiosaurus is a large, unaligned dinosaur with a base AC of 13, initiative of +2, and 68 HP, capable of moving at 20 ft on land and 40 ft in water, with skills in Perception and Stealth, no language abilities, a challenge rating of 2, the ability to hold its breath for an hour, and attacks with a bite causing 11 piercing damage.

parent:2073f1cdda01e1713e447bc6d29db48ef.title: Starting at Higher Levels in D&D
parent:2073f1cdda01e1713e447bc6d29db48ef.summary: In D&D, characters can start at higher levels with standard creation steps, potentially more equipment including magic items, and the option to buy expensive items like firearms, all depending on the GM's decisions.

parent:67b6143b2d9e1ec157786244952e048d1.title: D&D Rulebook Snippet Summary
parent:67b6143b2d9e1ec157786244952e048d1.summary: The snippet lists spells organized by level and school, highlighting special properties, and introduces the Circle of the Land Druid subclass, focusing on their guardianship of ancient natural knowledge and rituals.

parent:5f782de945a5dcc7079cb429a547ea4f6.title: Adult Bronze Dragon Core Rules and Concepts
parent:5f782de945a5dcc7079cb429a547ea4f6.summary: The Adult Bronze Dragon is a Huge Lawful Good Metallic Dragon with high AC, initiative, and HP, capable of flying, swimming, and breathing both air and water, with immunities to lightning, and possessing skills in Insight, Perception, and Stealth; it can use multiattacks, breath weapons like Lightning and Repulsion, cast spells like Detect Magic and Shapechange, and has legendary resistance and actions for strategic combat advantages.

parent:10e88f9a99342b408396271693b115655.title: Ice Mephit Core Rules and Concepts
parent:10e88f9a99342b408396271693b115655.summary: The Ice Mephit is a small elemental with vulnerabilities to fire and immunities to cold, poison, exhaustion, and poisoned conditions, capable of exploding on death, attacking with cold-damaging claws, casting fog cloud daily, and using frost breath every six turns.

parent:b62bd7cb1112b54cd95a486105214cf8d.title: Core Rules and Concepts from D&D Rulebook Snippet
parent:b62bd7cb1112b54cd95a486105214cf8d.summary: The snippet explains base AC calculations, armor training effects, attack mechanics, attack rolls, monster attitudes, attunement with magic items, conditions like Blinded and Blindsight, the Bloodied state, and the use of Bonus Actions in D&D.

parent:1e461a99c46d058d8cb016c2d2282e5de.title: Air Elemental Core Rules Summary
parent:1e461a99c46d058d8cb016c2d2282e5de.summary: The Air Elemental is a large, neutral creature with AC 15, 90 HP, and resistances to bludgeoning, lightning, piercing, and slashing, immune to various conditions, capable of multiattacks including Thunderous Slam and Whirlwind, and can move through narrow spaces and hover.

parent:51f950814f8585769bfc8847efebc9ada.title: Assassin Core Rules and Concepts
parent:51f950814f8585769bfc8847efebc9ada.summary: The Assassin is a highly agile and stealthy character with poison resistance, capable of evading damage through a Dexterity save, and can attack with a shortsword or light crossbow, inflicting poison damage, while also having a cunning action for enhanced mobility or concealment.

parent:a1a42f41defa3c35bf52cb476707207ee.title: Werebear Core Rules and Concepts
parent:a1a42f41defa3c35bf52cb476707207ee.summary: The Werebear is a Neutral Good Lycanthrope with high AC and HP, capable of shifting between humanoid and bear forms, using Multiattack, Bite, Handaxe, and Rend, with the Bite attack potentially cursing Humanoids into Werebears under GM control.

parent:8f05ab6882ce9bb185dff182f79ad5a93.title: Polar Bear D&D Rulebook Snippet
parent:8f05ab6882ce9bb185dff182f79ad5a93.summary: The Polar Bear is a large, unaligned beast with an AC of 12, initiative of +2, 42 HP, speeds of 40 ft. on land and in water, Perception and Stealth skills, cold resistance, darkvision, no languages, a CR of 2, and actions including a multiattack with two rend attacks causing 9 slashing damage each.

parent:4ca82c189a939fe922ed46cbb59a94719.title: Core Rules of D&D Combat
parent:4ca82c189a939fe922ed46cbb59a94719.summary: In D&D, combat is organized into rounds and turns, with initiative rolls determining turn order; combat steps include establishing positions, rolling initiative, and taking turns, while surprise affects initiative rolls, and initiative order dictates action sequence, with ties resolved by the GM or players.

parent:a33230cd81e7234e75591b1b2de225e89.title: D&D Rulebook Snippet Summary
parent:a33230cd81e7234e75591b1b2de225e89.summary: The snippet describes a bonus action for sword movement, Arcanist’s Magic Aura for altering creature types or object auras, Astral Projection for traveling to the Astral Plane with a silver cord connection, and Augury for divination.

parent:27cd6c31b201690642fd9cceadbe23fe1.title: D&D Spell Descriptions
parent:27cd6c31b201690642fd9cceadbe23fe1.summary: The 'Charm Person' spell charms a target to follow a suggestion until resisted, completed, or interrupted, while 'Summon Dragon' conjures a dragon spirit as an ally that follows the caster's commands or dodges danger.

table:c1949065be8b12e9732a8ce10c0d609b04.summary: The table lists a spell with an action casting time, a range of 60 feet, and components including verbal, somatic, and a material object with a dragon engraving worth at least 500 GP.
prose_rows: The casting time for this ability is an action.
It has a range of 60 feet.
The components required are verbal (V), somatic (S), and material (M), which includes an object with the image of a dragon engraved on it, valued at 500 gold pieces or more.

parent:38222f4079b47eb6f7139dcf9d63e871c.title: Animated Armor
parent:38222f4079b47eb6f7139dcf9d63e871c.summary: The Animated Armor is a Medium Construct with high AC and HP, immune to various conditions, and can perform two Slam attacks dealing bludgeoning damage.

parent:d07a5fac1993318c80571cbfa6f449edb.title: D&D Core Rules and Concepts
parent:d07a5fac1993318c80571cbfa6f449edb.summary: D&D skills are linked to abilities and have specific uses, saving throw proficiencies add bonuses to certain saves, and equipment proficiencies improve weapon and tool effectiveness.

parent:115a40222232af2328eaba9c502a86199.title: D&D Warlock Spellcasting Rules
parent:115a40222232af2328eaba9c502a86199.summary: Warlocks know two cantrips, gain additional cantrips at levels 4 and 10, have spell slots for levels 1-5 regained after rest, prepare a list of level 1+ spells increasing with levels, use Charisma for spellcasting, and can use an Arcane Focus as a Spellcasting Focus, with subclass features gained at level 3.

parent:5be8337abd409e799d8e6229b5f5ffd28.title: Magma Mephit Core Rules and Concepts
parent:5be8337abd409e799d8e6229b5f5ffd28.summary: The Magma Mephit is a small elemental with vulnerabilities to cold and immunities to fire, poison, exhaustion, and poisoned conditions, capable of exploding upon death to deal fire damage, attacking with claws that cause slashing and fire damage, and using fire breath to damage creatures within a cone.

parent:16714fa87609b97f7a98ba502d9afe967.title: Awakened Shrub
parent:16714fa87609b97f7a98ba502d9afe967.summary: The Awakened Shrub is a small, neutral plant with AC 9, -1 initiative, 10 HP, 20 ft. speed, vulnerabilities to fire, resistances to piercing, passive perception 10, Common plus one language, CR 0 (XP 10; PB +2), and a 'Rake' melee attack dealing 1 Slashing damage at +1 to hit with a 5 ft. reach.

parent:c0280d9ffed57bc1d13f5235e08d412a4.title: D&D Pony Creature Summary
parent:c0280d9ffed57bc1d13f5235e08d412a4.summary: The Pony is a Medium Beast with AC 10, Initiative +0, 11 HP, 40 ft. speed, Passive Perception 10, no languages, CR 1/8, and uses 'Hooves' for a melee attack dealing 4 (1d4 + 2) Bludgeoning damage.

parent:6676b53e401547e6380b0b5f0208e18ca.title: Draconic Spirit and Spells Summary
parent:6676b53e401547e6380b0b5f0208e18ca.summary: The Draconic Spirit, a large dragon with resistances and immunities, can be summoned with a chosen resistance, and it attacks with Rend and Breath Weapon; the spells Sunbeam, Sunburst, and Symbol involve casting radiant damage and creating protective glyphs, each with specific casting requirements and effects.

parent:da43726e48a706b9bdec677f94a4efbd6.title: Animated Flying Sword
parent:da43726e48a706b9bdec677f94a4efbd6.summary: The Animated Flying Sword is a small, unaligned construct with high AC, immunity to several conditions, and the ability to fly and hover, capable of attacking with a 'Slash' that deals 6 damage within a 5-foot range.

parent:2a195ccf3f13a65990feeced885b920ba.title: D&D Creature Summary
parent:2a195ccf3f13a65990feeced885b920ba.summary: The snippet outlines a range of creatures from the D&D rulebook, including undead like Ghasts and Ghosts, various giant creatures such as Ape, Badger, and Bat, and other entities like Glabrezu and Gold Dragon Wyrmling, each associated with specific page numbers for detailed information.
